sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 描述被拦情况时可平实说明原因；礼貌询问可用 Boleh saya tahu mengapa saya dihalang masuk?，意为“请问为什么不让我进去？”。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合安全通报、事件叙述和权限说明。不要仅凭 dihalang 就推断有人遭到拘捕、正式起诉或依法禁止；这些需要额外语境。

etymology.historical_story: Dihalang illustrates a productive Malay grammatical pattern rather than a separate borrowed word. The passive prefix di- places the blocked person or thing at the center of the sentence. The same base, halang, also produces words for obstacles and obstructing agents, connecting physical barriers with restrictions on human action.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: di- 提醒你“被”，halang 提醒你“挡”：dihalang 就是“被挡住、被阻止”。

morphology.pattern_note: 按输入词包保留整词词根标记。实际构词可分析为 degup + -an → degupan；词尾 p 在元音前成为下一音节的声母，不发生鼻音同化。首音节 e 读 /ə/。

senses.zh_definition: 心脏有节律的收缩与舒张；心跳，也可指感受到或听到的心脏搏动。

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 朋友间可用来描述紧张或心动。谈论他人的身体状况时宜客观表达，避免把心跳变化直接说成某种疾病或对某人的爱意。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 这是中性词，适用于日常、文学和正式说明；正式记录常用完整搭配 degupan jantung 或 kadar degupan jantung。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 朋友间可用来描述紧张或心动。谈论他人的身体状况时宜客观表达，避免把心跳变化直接说成某种疾病或对某人的爱意。

etymology.historical_story: Degupan belongs to the sound-imitative family centred on degup, the thudding sound associated with a beating heart or a falling object. Adding -an produces a noun for the beating itself. The learner's dictionary also treats degup and degupan as equivalents for cardiac movement, illustrating how a sound word can name the action producing it. See [DBP: degup](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=degup).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 de-GUP 想成胸口一下“怦”；接上 -an，就记住那一阵阵的心跳。拟声联想仅帮助记忆。

morphology.pattern_note: di- 构成被动态，-i 保留签署动作与文件的关系；词首 t 不脱落。ng 表示 /ŋ/，加 -i 后读作 nga.ni。原包将整词认作词根有误，应分析为 tandatangan 的派生词。此处 circumfix 表示前后附加形式，不主张 di- 与 -i 必须不可分地同时添加。

senses.zh_definition: 被签署；文件、表格或协议上由某人签名。

senses.ms_definition: Dibubuh tandatangan oleh seseorang pada surat, borang, perjanjian atau dokumen lain; bentuk pasif bagi menandatangani.
senses.nuances: di- 表示被动，本身不表示过去或完成：telah ditandatangani 为“已签署”，akan ditandatangani 为“将签署”，perlu ditandatangani 为“须签署”。不得写作 di tandatangani，也不能省去词末 -i。第一、第二人称施事通常采用 borang ini saya tandatangani 等结构。释义依据 [DBP：tandatangan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=155028&keyword=tandatangan)，用法参见 [DBP：ditandatangani](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=ditandatangani)。

etymology.historical_story: The base tandatangan combines tanda, a mark, with tangan, a hand: a person's identifying mark made by hand. Malaysian Malay writes this established compound as one word. The passive ditandatangani shifts attention to the document receiving the signature, making it especially useful in administrative announcements and reports. This explains its structure without assigning an unsupported date of origin. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=155028&keyword=tandatangan).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: tanda“标记”＋tangan“手”＝手写标记“签名”；di- 把镜头转向文件：文件被签署。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词借入；开头的 di- 不是被动前缀。词族列出重叠形式及常见复合表达，不虚构派生词缀。

senses.zh_definition: 同一家族中相继执政的君主世系；王朝、王室统治家族。
senses.en_definition: A succession of rulers belonging to the same family; a ruling house.
senses.ms_definition: Rangkaian pemerintah beraja yang mempunyai pertalian keturunan dalam keluarga yang sama.
senses.nuances: 侧重统治者的家族传承，不能仅凭疆域或政体相同就称为同一 dinasti。中文可按语境译为“王朝”或“王族”。依据 [DBP：dinasti](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=dinasti)。

senses.zh_definition: 一个国家由同一王族连续统治的历史时期；朝代。
senses.en_definition: The period during which a country is ruled by successive members of one royal family.
senses.ms_definition: Zaman sesebuah negara berada di bawah pemerintahan satu keluarga diraja secara berturut-turut.
senses.nuances: 侧重历史分期，常与 zaman、semasa 和 pada zaman 连用。与第一义分别对应“谁的统治世系”和“哪一段统治时期”。依据 [DBP：dinasti](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=dinasti)。

senses.zh_definition: 引申指在政治、商业等领域由家族成员跨代延续权势或影响力的世家。
senses.en_definition: A family whose members retain power or prominence across generations in politics, business, or another field.
senses.ms_definition: Secara kiasan, keluarga yang mengekalkan kuasa atau pengaruh dalam sesuatu bidang merentas generasi.
senses.nuances: 这是现代引申用法，并非输入所引《Kamus Dewan》两项释义的逐字内容。dinasti politik 常带有批评权力家族化的意味；商业语境则可能仅描述家族传承。

etymology.historical_story: Dinasti belongs to an international vocabulary of rulership whose ultimate ancestor is Greek dynasteia, meaning power or sovereignty. The history of this word family connects authority with hereditary succession. In Malay, the two established dictionary senses preserve that connection: a ruling lineage and the historical period identified with its rule. [Etymological study](https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/full/10.1080/23801883.2020.1796233), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=dinasti)。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dinasti 与英语 dynasty 成对记忆：同一家族一代接一代执政，就是“王朝”。

morphology.formula: diperintah + -kan → diperintahkan；完整结构：di- + perintah + -kan → diperintahkan
morphology.pattern_note: 按输入保留直接基底 diperintah；最终词根为 perintah。di- 表被动，-kan 属于对应主动形式 memerintahkan 的构词结构；这里不是 diper- + intah。/p/ 在被动形式中保留，pe 中的 e 读 /ə/。音节、IPA 和 Jawi 为依据标准拼写补全。

senses.zh_definition: 被命令、被指示做某事；接受有权者发出的行动指令。
senses.en_definition: To be ordered or directed by an authority to do something.
senses.ms_definition: Diarahkan oleh pihak yang berkuasa supaya melakukan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 常见结构是 seseorang diperintahkan supaya/untuk melakukan sesuatu。它表示被动，不自行标记过去时；是否已经下令由 telah、sudah 或上下文表达。此被动态释义根据 [DBP：perintah／memerintahkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=memerintah+1) 推导，并非独立词条的逐字引文。

senses.zh_definition: 某项行动或措施被下令实施、被权威要求执行。
senses.en_definition: Of an action or measure, to be ordered or required by an authority.
senses.ms_definition: Tentang sesuatu tindakan atau langkah, ditetapkan melalui perintah supaya dilaksanakan.
senses.nuances: 与第一义属于同一核心意义的不同句法用法：主语可以是受令者，也可以是被要求实施的行动。不要把所有 diperintahkan 都译成“被统治”；“某国由某人统治”通常用 diperintah oleh。构词与核心意义依据 [DBP：perintah／memerintahkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=memerintah+1)。

etymology.historical_story: The story of diperintahkan lies in Malay word formation rather than a separate borrowing. Perintah names an order and also underlies vocabulary for governing. Adding the passive marker di- and the verbal ending -kan presents someone or something as subject to an instruction, explaining its usefulness in administrative and institutional reporting. [DBP: perintah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=memerintah+1)。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 perintah＝命令，再看 di-＝被：diperintahkan 就是“被命令做某事”。

morphology.pattern_note: di- 构成被动式，-kan 保留对应主动词 menyerahkan 的及物结构；词根首音 s 不脱落。此处前后缀组合归入 circumfix。输入包将整词误判为词根，现予纠正。

senses.zh_definition: 被交出、交付或移交给某人或某机构。

senses.ms_definition: Diberikan atau disampaikan kepada seseorang atau sesuatu pihak.
senses.nuances: 适用于文件、款项、物品、土地等的交付。di- 表示被动，不表示过去时；完成与否由 telah、sudah、akan 等或上下文说明。各义根据 [DBP PRPM：serah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=serah) 整理，马来语释义为被动式改写。

collocations.en: documents are submitted or handed over

senses.zh_definition: 工作、责任、权力或事务被交托给某人处理。

senses.ms_definition: Diamanahkan kepada seseorang atau sesuatu pihak untuk diurus atau dilaksanakan.

senses.zh_definition: 自身被交付给某人或某方，表示投降、归顺或接受其支配。
senses.en_definition: To be surrendered or yielded to another, especially of oneself.
senses.ms_definition: Diberikan atau ditundukkan kepada pihak lain, khususnya apabila diri menjadi perkara yang diserahkan.
senses.nuances: 这一义项通常需要 diri、dirinya 等补语及明确语境。日常表达自首更常用 menyerah diri；不能把所有 diserahkan 都解释为自首。

senses.en_definition: To be committed to God in trust and submission.
senses.ms_definition: Dipertaruhkan kepada Allah dengan penuh tawakal, khususnya tentang diri, nasib atau hasil usaha.
senses.nuances: 属于宗教或精神寄托语境；所表达的是托付与信赖，并不自动表示停止努力。

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary record for serah includes examples involving rulers, entrusted work, and submission to God. These contexts connect the physical act of handing something over with the transfer of responsibility or control. Modern diserahkan carries that connection into administrative language: a document, a duty, or a matter can all become what is handed over. [Source: DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=serah).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 serah 的“交出去”：加上 di- 和 -kan，就从“交东西”切换到“东西被交出去”。

morphology.pattern_note: di- 构成被动式，词根 sangka 保持不变；ng 表示 /ŋ/，此处 ngk 读 /ŋk/。对应主动式 menyangka 中，meN- 与词根结合时首音 s 脱落。输入包将整词误判为词根，现予纠正。

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary family of sangka brings together supposition, estimation, and suspicion. That range explains why disangka can describe an innocent expectation in one sentence and an unfavourable suspicion in another. The passive prefix di- changes whose perspective the sentence foregrounds: attention moves from the person making the judgment to the person, event, or situation being judged. [Source: DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=273844&keyword=sangka).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: sangka 是“心里的猜想”，di- 表示“被”：disangka 就是“被猜想、被认为”；加 tak，便是“没想到”。

morphology.pattern_note: 单音节整体记忆，无词缀变化。bermain dil 中的 ber- 加在 main 上，不是加在 dil 上；buah dil 是短语，不是派生词。

etymology.historical_story: Kamus Dewan preserves dil through two useful expressions: buah dil names a hard ball, while bermain dil describes playing with that ball and sticks, much like hockey. etymology.historical_story: Berkat belongs to Malay's Arabic-derived religious vocabulary and is related to Arabic barakah, meaning blessing. Malay integrates the borrowed base into its own grammar: memberkati gives a blessing, while diberkati receives one. The word appears naturally in prayers for livelihoods, marriages and worthwhile efforts, linking spiritual favour with everyday hopes.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: berkat＝福泽；di- 把视角转向接受者：diberkati＝被赐福、蒙福。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根是 dedah；di- 是被动前缀，-kan 构成及物或使动用法，两者可分别分析。di- 不表示过去时，词根辅音不发生鼻音替换。词根和义项依据 [DBP dedah 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107200&keyword=dedah)；词头 Jawi 按该词根与词缀规则补写。

senses.zh_definition: 被揭露；被披露；原先不为人知的信息、事实或行为被公开。

senses.zh_definition: 被揭开或使显露；原先遮盖、隐藏或应受保护的事物被置于可见状态。

senses.nuances: 用于物理显露，如身体部位、表面或覆盖物下的东西。与 terdedah 相比，didedahkan 更突出使其显露的行为；terdedah 更突出已经暴露的状态。

etymology.historical_story: Didedahkan belongs to the Malay family built on dedah. Its meanings connect uncovering something physically with making information known and introducing people to unfamiliar things. This is a semantic connection, rather than a dated account of origin. The passive prefix di- shifts attention toward the person or thing receiving the action. [Source: DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107200&keyword=dedah).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把遮布揭开：物体“被显露”，秘密“被揭露”，学生“被带去接触新知识”。di- 提醒你从承受动作的一方理解；它不等于“已经”。

morphology.pattern_note: 这是 menguasai 的被动形式，词根为 kuasa；输入包将整个词标为词根，现据构词关系校正。di- 不触发鼻音同化，词首 k 保留；词尾 a 与 -i 分别发音。主动形式 meN- + kuasa + -i → menguasai 时，k 脱落。

etymology.historical_story: Dikuasai is formed within Malay from kuasa, a word covering power, authority and ability. Its meanings connect control over territory or property with command of knowledge. In an educational report, something dikuasai is a skill mastered; in a political report, it may be an area controlled. The passive construction foregrounds the affected subject. [Source: DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=244840&keyword=kuasa)

etymology.historical_story: Dauntless is an English formation combining daunt with the suffix -less. Its structure presents courage as freedom from intimidation. English dictionaries associate it with literary praise, especially descriptions of determined people and their spirit. This English history does not establish it as a Malay loanword; Malay normally expresses the idea with phrases such as tidak gentar. Sources: [Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/dauntless), [Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/dauntless).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 英语 daunt 表示使人畏缩，-less 表示没有：dauntless＝吓不退。马来语对应记作 tidak gentar。

etymology.historical_story: Diskaun is a Malay borrowing of English discount, adapted to Malay spelling. The English word has a longer history through French forms connected with counting and deduction. In Malay, the borrowed noun also supports native formations such as mendiskaun and pendiskaunan, showing how an imported commercial term can become part of a productive local word family. [English word history](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/discount).

The ICC records the name in Winifred Duraisingam, providing a documented Malaysian example. etymology.historical_story: Devi reflects Sanskrit devī, meaning goddess, and also appears in personal names. In Hindu religious usage, Devi can designate the divine feminine itself. Malay has the related established word dewi. These connections explain a shared cultural vocabulary, but they do not make every person named Devi a religious reference or establish a Malay suffix in the name. senses.zh_definition: 被讨论、被商议；作为议题受到分析或意见交流。

etymology.historical_story: The useful story here is grammatical rather than a securely established account of the root's remote origin. DBP records bincang alongside berbincang, membincangkan and perbincangan. Adding passive di- to the transitive stem bincangkan puts the topic in focus. This makes dibincangkan especially useful in meeting records, where the discussed matter often matters more than the individual speakers. See [DBP: bincang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=bincang).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 di-bin-cang-kan：抓住 bincang“讨论”，前面的 di- 把议题推到主语位置，记成“某事被讨论”。

morphology.formula: ∅ + Dante → Dante（外来人名，整词记忆）
morphology.pattern_note: 不是马来语加缀词；不能把末尾 -te 当作马来语词缀。所列 IPA 采用意大利语读法，其他姓名持有者可能使用不同读音。

senses.zh_definition: 但丁：意大利语来源的男性名字；在文学语境中，常指意大利诗人但丁·阿利吉耶里。
senses.en_definition: A masculine given name of Italian origin; in literary contexts, often the poet Dante Alighieri.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas lelaki yang berasal daripada bahasa Itali; dalam konteks kesusasteraan, lazimnya merujuk penyair Dante Alighieri.
senses.nuances: 属于专有名词，标准书写为 Dante；保留小写 headword 是为了对应输入键。马来文释义为描述性释义，原包没有 DBP 定义。status 按指定格式保留为 official，不构成 DBP 收录认证。音节与 Jawi 均未提供，保留 null。搭配展示姓名及文学指称的用法，不表示已测得其搭配频率。文学背景参见 [Treccani](https://www.treccani.it/enciclopedia/dante_%28Enciclopedia-dell%27Italiano%29/)。

etymology.historical_story: Dante is generally understood as a shortened form of the Italian name Durante, associated with enduring or remaining steadfast. Treccani describes the shortening as a loss of internal sounds rather than a regular diminutive ending. The poet Dante Alighieri gives the name its especially strong literary association. [Treccani](https://www.treccani.it/enciclopedia/nomi-ipocoristici_%28Enciclopedia-Dantesca%29/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Dante＝但丁：把名字和书本联系起来；看到 karya Dante，就想到“但丁的作品”。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根为 ragu；di- 标记被动，-kan 保留在动词中，词根读音不变。此处 circumfix 表示前后缀组合，并非不可分的单一词缀。

senses.zh_definition: 受到怀疑；其真实性、可靠性或可信程度未获确信。
senses.en_definition: To be doubted or regarded as uncertain in truth, reliability, or credibility.
senses.ms_definition: Tidak diyakini sepenuhnya atau dipandang dengan rasa sangsi tentang kebenaran, kesahihan atau kebolehpercayaannya.
senses.nuances: 是被动形式，不等于主语自己感到犹豫。tidak diragukan 表示不容怀疑。马来西亚正式行文中，表达某事被怀疑时通常更自然地用 diragui；meragukan 则强调使人产生疑虑。释义依据 [DBP 的 ragu 词族说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=meragukan)概括，并非资料包中已有的独立释文。

etymology.historical_story: Diragukan is a transparent Malay formation built from ragu, the base associated with doubt. Its structure links it to meragukan through passive di- and retained -kan. For learners of Malaysian Malay, the neighbouring form diragui is especially useful: it commonly expresses that something is doubted, while meragukan highlights the doubts something causes.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: ragu 是怀疑；前面加被动 di-：某事被放进疑问框。记住 tidak diragukan＝不容怀疑。

morphology.formula: ∅ + dojo → dojo（整词借入：武道训练场）
morphology.pattern_note: 日语借词，在马来语中作为完整词基使用，不拆成马来语词缀。此处采用马来语适应性读音，j 读 /dʒ/；日语原词的长元音不必保留。未列无据的派生词。

senses.zh_definition: 道场；练习或教授柔道、空手道、合气道等日本武道的专用场所。
senses.en_definition: A hall or dedicated space for practising and teaching Japanese martial arts.
senses.ms_definition: Dewan atau ruang khusus untuk mempelajari dan berlatih seni bela diri Jepun seperti judo, karate dan aikido.
senses.nuances: 指训练场所，不是武术项目或运动员名称；也不泛指所有健身房。此处马来语释义为编辑性释义，输入未提供 DBP 定义。场所含义及文化背景参见 [国际柔道联合会](https://www.ijf.org/news/show/the-dojo-a-place-of-study-and-practice)。

etymology.historical_story: Dojo comes from Japanese dōjō, written 道場, literally a place of the Way. Its earlier Buddhist associations concerned spiritual practice and awakening; the name later extended to martial training. Modern martial arts preserve that connection through disciplined practice, courtesy and care for the training space, giving the word a cultural meaning beyond an ordinary exercise hall. [IJF](https://www.ijf.org/news/show/the-dojo-a-place-of-study-and-practice)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 直接连回汉字“道场”：dojo 就是练武之“道”的场所；它是地点，不是招式。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根为 tubuh；输入将 ditubuhkan 标为词根有误。di- 标示被动，-kan 保留派生动词的及物结构，词首 t 不脱落；对应主动形式 menubuhkan 中，meN- 与 t 结合后 t 脱落。di- 与动词连写。

senses.zh_definition: 指组织、委员会、机构或服务设施等被成立、组建或设立。
senses.en_definition: To be founded, established, formed, or set up, especially of an organisation, committee, or institution.
senses.ms_definition: Dibentuk, didirikan atau diwujudkan sebagai persatuan, jawatankuasa, institusi atau kemudahan tertentu.
senses.nuances: menubuhkan 的被动形式，通常以被成立的组织或机构作主语。di- 只标示被动，不自带过去时；akan ditubuhkan 表示将成立，telah ditubuhkan 表示已成立。词义据 [PRPM：menubuhkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=menubuhkan) 改写。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 语体中性偏正式，适合机构介绍、会议记录及新闻。被动句可自然突出成立的机构；需要交代发起者时，用 ditubuhkan oleh…。

etymology.historical_story: Tubuh means a body, while its institutional derivatives describe forming an organised entity. This offers a useful semantic connection: members become a functioning collective. An official historical example is DBP, established in Johor Bahru in 1956 as Balai Pustaka. Its institutional history uses ditubuhkan to mark that founding moment. [DBP：Pengenalan](https://dbp.gov.my/pengenalan/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: tubuh＝身体；把成员组织成一个“整体”，就是成立。di- 提示被动：ditubuhkan＝被组建、获成立。

morphology.pattern_note: 双音节完整词根。加 ber- 形成 berduri，词根不变；加 -an 形成已词汇化的果实名 durian。

senses.zh_definition: 植物上尖硬、能刺伤人的刺状部分。
senses.en_definition: A sharp, stiff projection on a plant; a thorn or prickle.
senses.ms_definition: Bahagian tumbuhan yang keras dan tajam serta boleh mencucuk.
senses.nuances: 日常用语不严格区分植物学上的 thorn、spine 和 prickle。可指玫瑰、藤棕及果壳等处的尖刺。马来语释义依据数据包及 DBP 的物理义释写。

senses.zh_definition: 动物身上尖硬的棘、刺或刺状防御结构。
senses.en_definition: A sharp spine, quill, or similar pointed structure on an animal.
senses.ms_definition: Bahagian tajam pada tubuh binatang, seperti landak atau ikan tertentu.
senses.nuances: 具体英语译法随动物而变；豪猪的刺通常译为 quill，鱼身上的硬刺通常译为 spine，不能一律译作 thorn。

senses.zh_definition: 鱼肉中尖细的骨头；鱼刺。
senses.en_definition: A small, sharp fish bone, especially one encountered while eating.
senses.ms_definition: Tulang ikan yang kecil dan tajam, terutama yang terdapat dalam isinya.
senses.nuances: 饮食语境中的 duri ikan 通常指鱼刺；若脱离语境，duri 也可能指植物刺或动物棘，因此宜明确说 duri ikan。

senses.zh_definition: 比喻令人受苦的困难、障碍或持续造成困扰的隐患。

senses.ms_definition: Kesusahan, kesukaran atau sesuatu yang sentiasa menimbulkan masalah.
senses.nuances: 常见于固定表达。onak dan duri 指艰难险阻；duri dalam daging 指持续存在、难以摆脱的困扰或隐患，也可能指造成这种困扰的人。

etymology.historical_story: Duri belongs to an inherited Austronesian word family reconstructed as Proto-Malayo-Polynesian *duRi. Related words across the region refer to thorns, spines, or fish bones. Malay preserves these closely connected meanings and extends the painful image into expressions about hardship. The familiar fruit name durian also belongs to this family, making its prickly shell a useful vocabulary reminder.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 认识 durian（榴梿），就抓住前面的 duri：想象榴梿壳上的尖刺，再把这个画面扩展到植物刺、动物棘和鱼刺。

morphology.formula: dicipta + -kan → diciptakan；完整结构：di- + cipta + -kan → diciptakan
morphology.pattern_note: root_word 保留资料包的 dicipta，但它是已含被动前缀 di- 的直接基底，最终词根为 cipta。按所给基底分析，本步增加后缀 -kan；整体对应 menciptakan 的被动形式。词根拼写不变，c 读 /t͡ʃ/，di- 与词干连写。

senses.zh_definition: 被创造、设计或制成；某种事物经构思、发明或材料加工而产生。
senses.en_definition: To be created, devised, invented, or made, including from existing materials.
senses.ms_definition: Dihasilkan sebagai sesuatu yang baharu melalui pemikiran, reka bentuk atau pengolahan bahan.
senses.nuances: 这是被动形式，施事者可由 oleh 引出。di- 不表示过去时；是否已经完成须看 sudah、telah 等词或上下文。马来西亚语境也常使用较短的 dicipta。释义依据 DBP 的 cipta 词族整理，并非逐字引文。[PRPM：cipta](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243492&keyword=cipta)。

senses.zh_definition: 被创作出来；指歌曲、诗歌、小说等艺术作品经创作者构思而形成。
senses.en_definition: To be composed or otherwise produced as an artistic or literary work.
senses.ms_definition: Dihasilkan sebagai karya seni atau sastera, misalnya lagu, puisi atau novel.
senses.nuances: 用于歌曲时可译为“被创作、被谱写”，不等于“被演唱”。若需准确区分作曲、作词及编曲，可分别使用 digubah、ditulis 和 disusun。[PRPM：cipta](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243492&keyword=cipta)。

senses.zh_definition: 被营造、建立或促成；指机会、氛围、社会条件等原本不存在的状态得以形成。
senses.en_definition: To be brought about or established, especially an opportunity, atmosphere, or social condition.
senses.ms_definition: Diwujudkan sebagai peluang, suasana atau keadaan yang sebelumnya belum ada.
senses.nuances: 对象可以是抽象状态，而不必是实物。按对象不同，马来西亚正式语体也常用 diwujudkan 或 dibentuk。[PRPM：cipta](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243492&keyword=cipta)。

senses.zh_definition: 〈宗教语境〉被神创造，使之存在。
senses.en_definition: In religious usage, to be brought into existence by God.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam konteks keagamaan, dijadikan atau diwujudkan oleh Tuhan.
senses.nuances: 用于人类、天地或万物的起源陈述。这一宗教义不意味着该词只能用于神；同一词也可指人类的创造和艺术创作。[PRPM：cipta](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243492&keyword=cipta)。

etymology.historical_story: Diciptakan is a Malay grammatical formation built around cipta. The base belongs to an Indic word history associated with Sanskrit citta, meaning mind or thought; research on Javanese describes the development of cipta toward ideas and creation. Malay affixes then express passive creation, connecting an inherited concept of thought with something brought into existence. [Linguistic study](https://doi.nrct.go.th/ListDoi/Download/180309?Resolve_DOI=10.14457%2FMU.the.2010.169).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 cipta＝创造；前面的 di- 把视角转向“被创造的东西”：Lagu itu diciptakan…＝那首歌由……创作。

morphology.pattern_note: di- 表示被动，-kan 参与构成及物动词；这里依字段分类合记为 circumfix，两者各有语法功能。词根 t 保留；主动式 meN- + takut + -kan → menakutkan 中 t 脱落。音节可分析为 di.ta.kut.kan。数据包误将完整派生词列为词根，此处依据 [DBP：takut](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=takut) 及 [menakutkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=menakutkan) 更正。

senses.zh_definition: 被某人或某事吓到；被弄得害怕。
senses.en_definition: To be frightened or made afraid by someone or something.
senses.ms_definition: Dijadikan berasa takut oleh seseorang atau sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 这是 menakutkan“使害怕”的被动形式，主语是受到惊吓的一方。ditakutkan oleh X 表示“被 X 吓到”；不要一概与 ditakuti“被人畏惧”混同。主动词义依据 [DBP：menakutkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=menakutkan)。

senses.zh_definition: 被担心、被惧怕；用于表达对某种不利结果可能发生的忧虑。
senses.en_definition: To be feared or worried about, especially as a possible adverse outcome.
senses.ms_definition: Dibimbangkan atau dikhuatiri akan berlaku, khususnya sesuatu yang tidak diingini.
senses.nuances: 可见于 perkara yang ditakutkan“所担心的事”，也可引出所忧虑的情况。它表达担忧，并不表示事情已经发生。公文中常可改用更明确的 dikhuatiri。DBP 在 menakutkan 的忧虑义下列有 ditakutkan 用例，见 [DBP：menakutkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=menakutkan)。

etymology.historical_story: Ditakutkan is a grammatical formation from takut, rather than an independent borrowed word. Malay builds it with passive di- and verbal -kan. The dictionary records both causing fear and worrying about something under menakutkan, helping explain why the passive form can describe a frightened person or an outcome people fear. See [DBP: menakutkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=menakutkan).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 takut＝怕：-kan 可把“怕”变成“使人怕”，di- 再转成被动；遇到 yang ditakutkan，就想“所担心的”。

morphology.pattern_note: 被动前缀 di- 与词干连写，不引起词首音变化，也不表示过去时。它与分开书写的地点介词 di 不同。输入 Jawi لاين 对应 layan；完整 dilayan 写作 دلاين。

etymology.historical_story: Layan links practical service with social attention: attending to a guest and acknowledging another person belong to the same lexical family. Adding di- presents the recipient's experience. In a shop, dilayan concerns service; in a personal conversation, it can concern recognition. The word's grammar therefore brings the person receiving attention into focus.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: layan＝招呼、理会；di- 把镜头转向接受者：dilayan＝被招呼、被对待。

etymology.historical_story: Diucapkan belongs to the Malay family built around ucap, referring to spoken expression. Its structure also explains a familiar ceremonial style: thanks or wishes become the subject, while the speaker can remain unnamed. Thus a simple passive formation serves both pronunciation lessons and public acknowledgements, connecting the physical act of speaking with socially meaningful expressions. [DBP: ucap](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=ucap).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 ucap“说”：di- 标记被动，-kan 构成动词——话“被说出来”，就是 diucapkan。

morphology.pattern_note: 纠正资料包的自动词根判断：disukai 是 suka 的派生被动形式，不是词根。此处 circumfix 表示前后缀组合：di- 标记被动，-i 保留及物动词结构；di- 连写，词首 s 不脱落，a 与 i 通常分属两个音节。

senses.nuances: 是 menyukai 的被动对应形式，常见于食物、歌曲、活动和产品。disukai ramai 指广受喜爱。它不表示“被使得开心”，也不直接表示“得到正式批准”。释义据 [DBP：suka](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=155028&keyword=suka) 的派生词说明整理。

etymology.historical_story: The root suka belongs to the Sanskrit sukha word family associated with pleasure and happiness, also discussed for Indonesian in [Badan Bahasa's account](https://badanbahasa.kemendikdasmen.go.id/artikel-detail/238/di-balik-suka-dan-duka). Malay forms disukai through its own grammar: di- marks the passive and -i belongs to the transitive verb. The complete word is therefore a Malay formation, not a Sanskrit passive borrowed whole.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: suka＝喜欢；di- 把对象放到前面：Kek ini disukai ramai＝这蛋糕被很多人喜欢。

morphology.formula: di- + guna → diguna；正式推荐形式：di- + guna + -kan → digunakan
morphology.pattern_note: 被动前缀 di- 与词根连写，不引起词根首音变化。输入包将 diguna 标为词根，此处校正为 guna；di.gu.na 为按构词推定的音节划分。

senses.zh_definition: 被使用、被采用；digunakan 的简短变体，正式规范文本宜用 digunakan。
senses.en_definition: To be used or employed; a shorter variant of digunakan, which is preferred in formal standard Malay.
senses.ms_definition: Dipakai atau dimanfaatkan untuk sesuatu tujuan; bentuk yang disarankan dalam bahasa Melayu baku ialah digunakan.
senses.nuances: DBP 的相关答复指出 diguna 与 digunakan 没有意义差别，但推荐使用 digunakan。因此，status 按指定格式保留为 official，并不表示独立形式 diguna 获推荐用于正式行文。以下搭配记录简短形式，正式文本分别写成 boleh digunakan 和 sering digunakan。[DBP 用法答复](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=diguna)。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 日常消息中可理解简短形式；正式通知、学术写作和考试作文使用 digunakan。不要把被动前缀 di- 分写成 di guna。

etymology.historical_story: Diguna illustrates how an attested shorter form can coexist with a fuller standard form. Its structure is the passive prefix di- attached to guna. DBP's usage advice distinguishes meaning from formal preference: diguna and digunakan convey the same basic idea, but digunakan is recommended as the passive counterpart of menggunakan. [DBP usage advice](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=diguna).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: guna 联想“使用”，di- 提示“被”：diguna＝被使用；写正式报告时，把 -kan 补齐成 digunakan。

senses.zh_definition: 两倍的；数量、价格或程度为原来两倍的。

senses.nuances: 常见于马来语夹英语的日常表达。规范马来语宜明确写成 dua kali jumlah asal；原价 RM10 变成 RM20 才是此义。这里的马来语释义为释写，英语对应义可参见 [DBP 英马词典检索](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=menambahkan)。

senses.nuances: 这是菜单、酒店及日常消费语境中的英语用法。burger double 通常指双份肉饼；bilik double 通常涉及双人入住配置，但床型须另行确认，不能自动理解为两张单人床。

etymology.historical_story: Double enters these Malaysian conversations as an English word, rather than as a Malay root with native affixes. Its usefulness is easy to see at a food counter: one short expression can signal an extra patty, a larger portion, or twice the price. Standard Malay expresses those distinctions more precisely with dua, dua lapis, or menggandakan.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 double 和“双份”绑定：一份变两份，数量就是 ×2；具体是双层还是双人，要看后面的商品或服务。

etymology.historical_story: This word belongs to the productive Malay family built around salah, meaning wrong or mistaken. Its structure shifts attention from the person assigning blame to the person receiving it. The dictionary records dipersalahkan within the explanation of mempersalahkan, illustrating how a derived form can be understood through its root family.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: salah＝错；把 dipersalahkan 想成“错误责任被加到身上”，即“被归咎、被责怪”。

morphology.pattern_note: di-...-kan 构成被动动词，词根不发生鼻音同化。输入的 ريساو 仅为词根拼写，此处补全派生词的爪夷文。此义来自表示担忧的 risau，而非输入释文中表示品行不端的另一词条。

senses.nuances: 被动形式通常把担忧的对象放在焦点位置，如 perkara yang dirisaukan。要表达某人感到担忧，通常说 dia risau；表达某事令人担忧，通常说 perkara itu merisaukan。di- 不表示过去时。释义依据 [DBP：risau](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=risau)。

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries record two distinct entries spelled risau: one concerns troublesome conduct, while the other concerns anxiety and disturbance. Dirisaukan belongs to the latter family. Its formation illustrates productive Malay grammar: the passive prefix di- and suffix -kan bring the object of concern into focus, without themselves specifying when the worry occurs.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 risau＝担心；加上 di-...-kan，把镜头转向被担心的事：dirisaukan＝被挂在心上。

etymology.historical_story: Dijanjikan is a grammatical formation around janji, rather than an indivisible root. Janji already appears with meanings including promise and agreement in Crawfurd's 1852 Malay dictionary. The passive construction shifts attention toward what someone expects to receive, making it useful when discussing whether a commitment has been honoured. Historical attestation alone does not establish the root's ultimate origin. [Crawfurd, 1852](https://wallace-online.org/converted/pdf/1852_Crawfurd_WS5.2.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记janji“承诺”：menjanjikan是“承诺给”，换成di-后，dijanjikan就是“被承诺给”；看到yang dijanjikan，就想到“之前答应的那个”。

etymology.historical_story: Diplomatik belongs to the international vocabulary of diplomacy. Its European relatives trace back through forms such as French diplomatique and Latin diploma, a document or letter of introduction. That documentary background offers a useful bridge between its modern meanings: official relations between states, and careful language used to manage relationships between people. [American Heritage Dictionary](https://ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=diplomatic)

etymology.historical_story: Disiarkan belongs to the productive siar family. Its dictionary meanings connect public announcements and printed publication with broader spreading, even including the emission of light. The passive construction puts the transmitted material first. These related meanings offer a useful image: something moves outward from its source until it reaches a wider audience or surrounding space. [DBP: siar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=siar)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按 di-si-ar-kan 分拍：看到 di-，先想“被”；想到 siaran 新闻播报，就把 disiarkan 连成“被播出、被发布”。

morphology.pattern_note: di- 标示被动，-kan 保留于及物动词构式中；词根首音 n 不变。输入包将整个派生词标为词根，应纠正为 nafi。音节可分析为 di.na.fi.kan；syllables 和 jawi 保留输入包的 null。

senses.zh_definition: 被否认；某项说法、指控、事实或存在不获承认。

senses.nuances: 这是 menafikan 的被动形式。dinafikan 只说明有人否认，并不证明被否认的内容为假。tidak dapat dinafikan 常表示“不可否认”，用于承认明显的事实或贡献。马来语释义为依据词典所作的被动式改写。[DBP：nafi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=nafi)

senses.zh_definition: 被剥夺或被拒绝给予某种权利、机会、服务或应有待遇。
senses.en_definition: To be deprived of, or refused, a right, opportunity, service, or entitlement.
senses.ms_definition: Tidak diberikan atau dihalang daripada memperoleh hak, peluang, perkhidmatan atau sesuatu yang sewajarnya diterima.
senses.nuances: 在 seseorang dinafikan hak 或 dinafikan peluang 中，受影响的人是被动句主语；含义是“不给予”，不是“说某事不真实”。这一用法见于 DBP 的权利、社会及公共服务术语。[DBP：dinafikan 的术语用例](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=dinafikan)

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 正式沟通中说明谁否认了什么，比直接指责对方说谎更准确，也更尊重对方。向上级汇报可用 Dakwaan itu telah dinafikan oleh pihak berkenaan。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于新闻澄清、事实讨论及权利议题。不要把“被否认”直接翻译成“已证实为假”；涉及个人权益时，应明确被拒绝给予的具体权利或机会。

etymology.historical_story: DBP identifies nafi as an Arabic borrowing associated with rejection and denial. Malay incorporates this borrowed base into its own productive morphology: menafikan expresses the action, dinafikan presents it passively, and penafian names the act. The everyday expression tidak dapat dinafikan turns this vocabulary of rejection into a strong acknowledgment of something accepted as true. [DBP: nafi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=nafi)

etymology.historical_story: The spelling dae illustrates why regional context matters in Malay lexicography. A Kelantan communication study glosses tok dae as tak sempat, while DBP’s Kedah examples use dae for dahi. These attestations establish different regional meanings, not a shared historical origin. Their deeper relationship cannot be reconstructed from the supplied packet. etymology.historical_story: Historical Malay navigation used a weighted sounding line to discover the depth hidden beneath the water. Dictionaries record batu duga and tali duga alongside meanings involving conjecture and probing. This connection makes an effective learning image: investigate what cannot yet be seen. It illustrates the word's semantic range without proving which meaning developed first or establishing an ultimate borrowing source. Source: [Wilkinson's dictionary](https://www.sabrizain.org/malaya/library/dictwilkinson.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: As a personal name, Dora is a shortened form of Dorothy or Dorothea. Those names ultimately contain Greek elements associated with a gift and a deity. This explains an inherited naming tradition, rather than a Malay lexical meaning. A person called Dora should therefore be identified by the name, rather than described as literally meaning a divine gift. [Source](https://www.etymonline.com/word/Dora)

etymology.historical_story: The image behind timpa is something falling onto another thing. Malay also uses that image for illness and misfortune. The traditional saying sudah jatuh ditimpa tangga pictures someone falling and then being struck by a ladder: one setback followed by another. It makes the connection between physical impact and compounded suffering especially memorable. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=timpa)

etymology.historical_story: Duga brings together sounding water, making a guess, and testing something. These dictionary senses offer a useful conceptual connection: discovering what cannot immediately be seen. The familiar proverb contrasting measurable sea depths with unknowable human hearts makes that connection memorable. This is a semantic illustration, rather than proof of a particular historical sequence. [DBP: duga](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107200&keyword=duga)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: duga 想成向未知处伸出探针；加 di-，便是“被探测、被推测、被考验”。

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 在这里通常是附着于名词后的第三人称领属成分，表示他／她／它的，不标示性别；ny 表示单一辅音 /ɲ/。按本结构的分类记为 suffix，但它不是派生词缀。输入包的 دادا 是词根拼写，完整词形为 داداڽ。

etymology.historical_story: Dadanya has a grammatical story rather than a separate borrowing history: dada names the chest, while -nya links it to someone or something already understood. Malay expressions also make the chest a stage for pride and emotion, as in membusungkan dada. The same attachment works without specifying gender, so translation must recover the owner from the surrounding conversation.

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 正式第三人称被动可用 disiapkan oleh pasukan。标准语中第一、第二人称通常用 Laporan itu saya siapkan 或 Laporan itu perlu anda siapkan；不要把 disiapkan 一概理解为“已经完成”。

etymology.historical_story: Disiapkan illustrates productive Malay word formation rather than a separate borrowed root. The base siap expresses readiness or completion; -kan builds a verb meaning to make something ready or complete it, while di- presents the action passively. DBP records both preparation and completion under menyiapkan, explaining why this passive form naturally occurs with breakfasts, reports, equipment, and buildings.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: siap＝好了；-kan＝把它弄好；di-＝它被弄好。连起来 disiapkan＝被完成／被备妥。

etymology.historical_story: Donald is an English form of the Gaelic name Domhnall, associated historically with ideas of world and power or rule. Patrick Woulfe's Irish name dictionary records Donald as a Scottish anglicisation. In Malay usage, the name identifies its bearer; its historical meaning is not translated whenever the person is mentioned. [Woulfe's name dictionary](https://mail.libraryireland.com/names/men/domhnall-donall.php)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Donald 和具体人物的脸联系起来，整词记住；它是名字，不是可用马来语词缀拆解的普通词。

word_family.gloss: 英语副词：深深地；深切地

senses.zh_definition: 深刻的；有思想深度、值得深入思考的。用于马来语聊天时属于英语夹用。
senses.en_definition: Profound or thought-provoking; used as an English insertion in Malay conversation.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam penggunaan campur kod, menggambarkan idea atau makna yang mendalam dan mengundang renungan; padanan bahasa Melayu ialah mendalam.
senses.nuances: 例如 mesej dia deep 表示“他的话很有深意”。PRPM 将 deep 列于《Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan》的英语词头下，不能据此认定它是规范马来语借词。本条 ms_definition 为马来语释义性改写；搭配中的 ms 字段保留夹语形式。参见 [DBP：deep](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=deep)。

senses.zh_definition: 深奥的；因内容复杂、抽象而不容易理解的。
senses.en_definition: Intellectually complex or difficult to understand.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam penggunaan campur kod, merujuk kepada perkara yang rumit atau sukar difahami; padanannya termasuk mendalam atau sukar difahami mengikut konteks.
senses.nuances: 与“有深意”的赞赏义相邻，但太 deep 可以表示听者跟不上，并非一定在称赞。英语本义参见 [Cambridge：deep](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/deep)。

senses.zh_definition: 深沉的；情感强烈、触及内心的。
senses.en_definition: Emotionally intense or deeply affecting.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam penggunaan campur kod, menggambarkan perasaan atau ungkapan yang menyentuh hati secara mendalam.
senses.nuances: 用于歌词、谈话等时，可能兼有“深刻”和“触动内心”的意思；具体含义由语境决定，不等于单纯“悲伤”。相关英语情感义参见 [Cambridge：deep](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/deep)。

senses.zh_definition: 深的；从表面向下或从外部向内距离大的。此处是英语的空间义。
senses.en_definition: Extending a considerable distance below a surface or inward from an edge.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, mempunyai jarak yang besar dari permukaan ke bawah atau dari bahagian luar ke dalam; padanan bahasa Melayu lazimnya dalam.
senses.nuances: 说水、洞穴等很深时，规范马来语通常用 dalam。不要把空间义的 deep 一律译为 mendalam；后者常用于思想、知识或情感。参见 [DBP：deep](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=deep)。

etymology.historical_story: English deep continues Old English dēop through Middle English forms such as dep and deep. Its physical image of distance below a surface also supports meanings involving thought and feeling. When inserted into Malay conversation, it retains this English identity; standard Malay equivalents depend on the intended sense. See [Mayhew and Skeat](https://www.gutenberg.org/files/10625/10625-h/10625-h.htm) and [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=deep).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 从水面往下是 deep，从话语表面往里想也是 deep：水深用 dalam，思想深刻用 mendalam。

morphology.formula: diperoleh + -i（冗余添加）→ diperolehi；规范形式：diper- + oleh → diperoleh
morphology.pattern_note: 词包的 root_word 是直接比较基底，深层词根为 oleh。添加 -i 后按字面读成 /le.hi/；问题在冗余构词，不能据此推导为规范派生。IPA 仅表示该非规范拼写的预期读法。

senses.zh_definition: 被获得；被取得。为规范形式 diperoleh 的非规范冗余形式。
senses.en_definition: A nonstandard form of diperoleh, meaning obtained, acquired, or gained.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk tidak baku bagi diperoleh, iaitu bentuk pasif memperoleh yang bermaksud didapat atau dicapai.
senses.nuances: DBP 明确建议使用 diperoleh，并将多加的 -i 视为冗余，因此 status 标为 nonstandard。下列搭配保留待纠正形式以便识别；正式例句使用规范形式，或将目标词作为被讨论的字形引用。马来文释义为综合编写。[DBP：diperolehi 的规范判断](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=diperolehi)。

etymology.historical_story: This spelling illustrates how an extra ending can become familiar without becoming standard. DBP analyzes diperoleh as the passive counterpart of memperoleh, formed from oleh with diper-. It explicitly treats the additional -i in diperolehi as redundant. The useful historical lesson is modest: widespread usage and acceptance in formal grammar do not always coincide. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=diperolehi)

word_family.gloss: 用于恢复的工具或装置

senses.zh_definition: 被恢复至原有、正常或较好的状态；被修复、恢复运作或重建。
senses.en_definition: To be restored to a previous, normal or improved condition or brought back into operation.
senses.ms_definition: Dikembalikan kepada keadaan semula atau keadaan yang baik; dibaikkan atau dijadikan berfungsi semula.
senses.nuances: 是 memulihkan 的被动形式，主语为接受恢复作用的对象，可用于服务、生态、关系、健康及资料等。它本身不表示过去时；telah、sedang、akan 等确定时间或体貌。人自行康复通常说 Pesakit itu pulih；强调治疗使健康恢复可说 Kesihatannya dipulihkan。释义据 [DBP：memulihkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=memulihkan+1) 转为被动表述。

senses.zh_definition: 原有的权利、资格、地位或所属财产被恢复或归还。
senses.en_definition: To have a right, status or entitlement reinstated, or property returned to its rightful owner.
senses.ms_definition: Hak, kedudukan atau kelayakan dikembalikan kepada pihak berkenaan, atau harta dipulangkan kepada pemiliknya.
senses.nuances: 强调重新取得原本拥有的事物，常见于正式行政及权利讨论。若只是普通物品归还，dikembalikan 或 dipulangkan 通常更直接。此义对应 [DBP：memulihkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=memulihkan+1) 的归还义。

etymology.historical_story: The word belongs to the Malay pulih family, built around returning to a sound or former condition. Memulihkan presents someone as restoring something; dipulihkan presents that thing as receiving the action. This shared structure connects restored health, repaired services and renewed relationships without requiring a separate root for each field. See [DBP: pulih and memulihkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=memulihkan+1).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 pulih“恢复”，再套 di-…-kan“被使得……”：dipulihkan＝“被恢复”。对照 Lampu menyala“灯亮了”与 Bekalan dipulihkan“供电恢复了”。

morphology.pattern_note: 输入包的 dikatakan 是直接词基，最终词根为 kata。-nya 在此是表示第三人称施事者的附着代词，读 /ɲa/，与前词连写；不是女性专用代词。

senses.ms_definition: Disebut, diucapkan atau disampaikan olehnya; bentuk pasif mengatakan dengan kata ganti nama diri ketiga sebagai pelaku.
senses.nuances: 属于语法上可生成的被动动词形式，不是另一个独立词根。-nya 指说话者，不表示他说的对象，也不标明性别。时态由 telah、sedang、akan 等成分和语境决定。[DBP：mengatakan 的释义与 dikatakannya 用例](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=memarahi)

senses.en_definition: Described, characterized, or regarded by him or her as something.
senses.ms_definition: Disifatkan atau dianggap olehnya sebagai sesuatu atau mempunyai sifat tertentu.

etymology.historical_story: This form illustrates how Malay can pack an action and its speaker into one written word. Kata supplies the idea of speech; di-...-kan builds the passive form; -nya identifies a third-person speaker. In narrative, the structure keeps attention on the words spoken. Everyday conversation often expresses the same relationship more directly with dia kata.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 分三块读：di-katakan-nya＝被说出＋由他／她；看到 -nya，就追问“是谁说的？”

morphology.formula: di- + bicara + -kan → dibicarakan（被讨论；被审理）
morphology.pattern_note: di- 标示被动，-kan 保留及物动词构形；词根首辅音 b 不变化。此处 circumfix 按给定分类表示前后缀组合。数据包将整词判为词根，已纠正。

senses.zh_definition: 被谈论、讨论或论述；某个主题成为交换意见或阐述的对象。
senses.en_definition: To be discussed, talked about, or examined in speech or writing.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadi perkara yang dibincangkan atau dihuraikan melalui percakapan atau penulisan.
senses.nuances: 这是 membicarakan 的被动形式。可用于会议、文章或较深入的议题讨论；马来西亚日常交流中 dibincangkan 往往更常见。本释义依 [DBP 的 bicara 及 membicarakan 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=382696&keyword=bicara)改写，并非逐字引文。

senses.zh_definition: 案件被法院审理，或被告接受法庭审判；不表示已经定罪。

senses.ms_definition: Dijalankan proses pendengaran dan pengadilan di mahkamah, berkenaan kes atau tertuduh.
senses.nuances: 法律义涉及司法审理，不能译成已经判刑或已经定罪。须根据主语区分“案件被审理”和“被告受审”。词义依据 [DBP 的 membicarakan 释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=382696&keyword=bicara)。

etymology.historical_story: The root bicara comes from Sanskrit vicāra, associated with consideration and discussion. Historical Malay usage also connects it with cases and legal proceedings, helping explain the modern link between discussing a subject and trying a case. Dibicarakan adds Malay passive morphology to this borrowed root; its two principal meanings retain that connection. [Source](https://ejournal.usm.my/kajh/article/download/kajh_vol27-no-1-2020_4/pdf/3685)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先认出 bicara“谈、议”，再看 di- 的被动标记：话题被议论，案件被审理。

senses.zh_definition: 被看待、被认为；受到某种评价、重视或轻视。

etymology.historical_story: Dipandang combines the Malay passive prefix di- with pandang, a word for looking that also supports meanings of judgment and regard. Its semantic bridge is easy to follow: how someone is looked at becomes how someone is evaluated. Expressions involving high, low, and light regard make that connection especially memorable. [DBP：pandang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=terpandang+1)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: pandang 是“看”，di- 把镜头转向被看的人或事：dipandang＝被看、被看待。

etymology.historical_story: Dengarnya connects the physical act of hearing with information acquired through other people. The dictionary records dengar-dengar(nya) as a conversational expression for received news. This semantic bridge explains the shorter everyday expression: the speaker presents something heard rather than claiming direct observation. Its formation remains transparent through dengar and -nya. [DBP dictionary](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=254640&keyword=dengar)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: dengar 是“听”，dengarnya 就像先说一句“听来的啊……”再接消息，记住它带有转述意味。

senses.nuances: 被动词形本身不表示过去或完成：sedang dibaiki＝正在修理，telah dibaiki＝已经修好，akan dibaiki＝将被修理。受事通常作主语；施事可用 oleh 引出。DBP 的答复使用 Rumah untuk pekerja-pekerja estet telah dibaiki，见 [DBP：mengangkat，语法答复](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=mengangkat)。

etymology.historical_story: Dibaiki shows how Malay turns an everyday quality into an action: baik means good, while membaiki concerns making something right or serviceable. The passive form shifts attention to the thing receiving that work. A damaged road and a faulty sentence can therefore share the same verb, linking practical repair with the broader idea of putting something right.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: baik＝好，baiki＝修好，di-＝被：dibaiki＝被修理／被改正。是否已经修好，要看 sudah、telah 等时间标记。

etymology.historical_story: Dutchman is an English compound of Dutch and man, rather than a Malay word created with local affixes. Its ordinary personal sense refers to a man from the Netherlands. English also developed specialist repair and theatre senses. The historical reason for the repair name remains disputed, so a colourful national stereotype should not be presented as its proven origin.

senses.en_definition: A non-SI unit of mass, symbol Da, equal to one twelfth of the mass of a free carbon-12 atom at rest in its ground state; the unified atomic mass unit.
senses.ms_definition: Unit jisim bukan SI, bersimbol Da, yang bersamaan dengan satu perdua belas jisim satu atom karbon-12 bebas yang pegun dan berada dalam keadaan asas.
senses.nuances: 常用于原子、分子和蛋白质质量。单位名称写 dalton，符号写 Da；它是质量单位，不能直接当作 g/mol，也不是无量纲的相对分子质量。此马来语定义为编写释义。[BIPM 单位说明](https://www.bipm.org/documents/20126/41489679/SI-App2-mole.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: The unit commemorates John Dalton, whose name is closely associated with atomic theory. It gives scientists a convenient scale for discussing masses far smaller than everyday objects. Biochemists commonly use its larger forms, kilodalton and megadalton, for molecules. Despite its personal-name origin, the unit name is lowercase, while its symbol is Da. [IUPAC unit terminology](https://goldbook.iupac.org/terms/view/D01514)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: dalton 联想到“道尔顿研究原子”：看到 Da，就想到原子与分子的微小质量；Dalton 大写则先考虑人名。

etymology.historical_story: The root izin is an Arabic loan meaning permission, identified as such by DBP. Malay incorporates it into its own grammatical system: mengizinkan grants permission, while diizinkan presents the person or action receiving it. This makes the word a useful example of borrowed vocabulary functioning naturally within Malay morphology. [DBP: izin](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=izin)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 izin＝许可；前面的 di- 把视角转向接受者：diizinkan＝被允许。连写的 ii 提醒你保留 di + izin 的边界。

etymology.historical_story: Decepticon entered international popular culture through Transformers, launched in 1984. Hasbro's account places the Decepticons opposite the Autobots in adventures spanning toys, animation, and comics. Malay speakers retain the franchise name when discussing these characters. Its resemblance to English deception provides a useful association, but does not establish a Malay derivation. [Hasbro](https://newsroom.hasbro.com/node/14491/pdf)

etymology.historical_story: English doesn't contracts does not, combining an auxiliary verb with negation. The supplied sequence doesn lacks the ending of that established spelling. Truncation or token splitting could explain it, but that remains an inference. Without the original passage, the fragment has no recoverable history that can responsibly be presented as Malay etymology. [Source for doesn't: Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/doesn-t?topic=yes-no-and-not).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: doesn 看起来像“还没写完”：先核对原文，再决定是否还原为 doesn't；不要把片段背成马来语单词。

morphology.pattern_note: 院长义读 /de.kan/，首音节为 e taling；竹鼠同形词读 /də.kan/。本词不能分析为 dek + -an：输入包将词根判为 dek 有误，ديک 也缺少完整词形的末尾 ن。院长义与竹鼠义作为同形词分别记忆。义项及 dékan 标音参见 [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=dekan)。

word_family.gloss: 院长职务或院长行政机构

senses.zh_definition: 大学中主管某一学院的院长。

etymology.historical_story: The academic title belongs to the European family of words associated with Latin decanus, originally a leader of ten. Related titles developed institutional roles in religious and university administration. Malay dekan names a faculty head. Its resemblance to dek plus -an is accidental, and the bamboo-rat homonym must not be assigned the academic title's history. See [Lex](https://lex.dk/dekan).

senses.zh_definition: 黎明；清晨天光初现的时段。

senses.nuances: 英语不及物动词；马来语分别用 fajar menyingsing、hari mula terang 或 bermula。[Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/dawn)

etymology.historical_story: English dawn developed from medieval forms connected with Old English dagian, meaning to become day. Its later figurative uses extend the appearance of morning light to beginnings and understanding. Dawn also became a feminine personal name. None of this establishes a Malay borrowing: in Malay prose, fajar or a context-specific translation normally supplies the intended meaning. [Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/dawn)

senses.zh_definition: 被录音、录像或摄录，使声音、影像或事件保存在记录媒介中。

etymology.historical_story: DBP records several meanings in the rakam family: printing patterns on cloth, embroidery, and preserving sound on recording media. These meanings offer a useful image of leaving a lasting impression, whether on fabric or in a recording. Dirakam adds the Malay passive prefix di-, placing the recorded thing at the centre of the sentence. This is a semantic connection, not a demonstrated chronology. [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=perekodan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: rakam 是“录”，di- 把镜头转向承受动作的对象：视频 dirakam，就是“视频被录下来”。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 中性词，可用于地理说明、城市导览和活动通知。作为专名一部分时按名称大写，例如 Dataran Merdeka；泛指广场时写 dataran。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 约见时应说明具体哪座广场及集合点。dataran 不等同于任何空地，也不意味着该场地随时开放或可以自由举办活动。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 中性词，可用于地理说明、城市导览和活动通知。作为专名一部分时按名称大写，例如 Dataran Merdeka；泛指广场时写 dataran。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 约见时应说明具体哪座广场及集合点。dataran 不等同于任何空地，也不意味着该场地随时开放或可以自由举办活动。

etymology.historical_story: Dataran is transparently formed from datar, meaning flat or level, with the noun-forming suffix -an. Its geographical meaning preserves that simple picture: a stretch of level ground. In Malaysian civic life, the word also appears in names of public gathering places. Dataran Merdeka illustrates how a word describing land can become associated with shared public space.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 datar＝平，再加 -an 想成一片地方：dataran＝一片平地；放进城市语境，就是开阔广场。

morphology.formula: di- + jamin → dijamin（获得保证／由人担保）
morphology.pattern_note: 纠正输入中的未拆分分析：dijamin 是 jamin 的 di- 被动形式。前缀与词根连写，词根首音 j /dʒ/ 保留；di- 不表示过去时。

senses.zh_definition: 在品质、安全、真实性或其他条件方面获得保证或保障。
senses.en_definition: To be guaranteed or safeguarded with respect to quality, safety, authenticity, or another condition.
senses.ms_definition: Diberi jaminan tentang keselamatan, mutu, ketulenan atau sesuatu keadaan.
senses.nuances: menjamin 的被动形式；可接 oleh 引出保证者。与 terjamin 相比，dijamin 更容易突出保证行为或责任方。本条各义的马来语释义按主动词义改写，并非 DBP 对 dijamin 的独立原文释义。参见 [DBP：jamin](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?keyword=jamin)。

senses.zh_definition: 由担保人承诺在有关人士未履行义务时承担责任；也用于保释担保。
senses.en_definition: To be backed by a guarantor who undertakes another person's obligations, including in bail arrangements.
senses.ms_definition: Ditanggung oleh penjamin sekiranya pihak berkenaan tidak memenuhi kewajipannya; termasuk dalam urusan ikat jamin.
senses.nuances: 责任承担义，常出现明确担保人。涉及保释时，获得担保并不表示被判无罪。

collocations.en: a loan guaranteed by the government

collocations.zh: 由一名担保人提供担保

senses.zh_definition: 某种结果或待遇得到明确承诺；口语中也用于强调说话者很有把握。
senses.en_definition: To be promised a particular outcome or benefit; conversationally, to be presented as certain.
senses.ms_definition: Dijanjikan sesuatu hasil, manfaat atau layanan.
senses.nuances: 广告中的 dijamin puas hati 表示满意保证；口语中的 dijamin sedap 表示强烈推荐，通常不能单凭该说法认定存在正式担保条款。

senses.zh_definition: 日常生活所需由他人承担或供给。
senses.en_definition: To have one's everyday living needs provided for by someone.
senses.ms_definition: Ditanggung keperluan hidup sehari-hari oleh seseorang atau sesuatu pihak.
senses.nuances: 对应 menjamin 的口语供养义；需由生活、饮食等上下文明确，不宜将所有 dijamin 都译作“供养”。

dijamin sedap 省略保证者，是强调信心的推荐说法。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 商务表达应让保证范围与实际承诺一致。标准语中前缀连写为 dijamin；表示地点的介词 di 才与后面的词分写。

etymology.historical_story: Dijamin illustrates a productive Malay grammatical pattern rather than a separate lexical root: di- places the guaranteed person or thing at the centre of the clause. The jamin family connects a promise, its guarantor, and the resulting assurance. Everyday recommendations extend that assurance into friendly expressions of confidence about food or service. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?keyword=jamin)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: jamin＝保证；前面加 di-，镜头转向接受保证的一方：mutu dijamin＝品质获得保证。

morphology.pattern_note: root_word 字段按资料包保留原值，但该值是表层派生词，并非实际词基；实际词基为 perhati。di-...-kan 构成被动形式，词基首音 p 保留；对应主动形式 memerhatikan 中，meN- 与 p 结合时发生鼻音替代。依据 [DBP 构词说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=diperhatikan)。

senses.zh_definition: 被仔细观察、察看或审视。
senses.en_definition: Be observed, examined, or looked at closely.
senses.ms_definition: Dilihat, diteliti atau diamati dengan cermat.
senses.nuances: 是 memerhatikan 的被动形式，主语是观察对象。dapat diperhatikan 常表示“可以观察到”，不必理解为有人刻意监视。释义依据 [DBP：perhati](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?d=175768&keyword=perhati) 综合表述。

senses.zh_definition: 受到重视或留意；所述事项被认真考虑。
senses.en_definition: Be given attention, heeded, or taken into consideration.
senses.ms_definition: Diberi perhatian, diendahkan atau dipertimbangkan dengan sungguh-sungguh.
senses.nuances: 对象可以是意见、警告或重要事项，强调认知上的关注，不要求用眼睛观看。perlu diperhatikan 常可译成“须注意”。

senses.zh_definition: 受到看护、留意或持续监看。
senses.en_definition: Be watched over or kept under observation.
senses.ms_definition: Diawasi atau dijaga dengan mengikuti keadaan atau pergerakannya.
senses.nuances: 可用于儿童、病人或某人的行动。既可能表示关怀，也可能表示监控，褒贬取决于情境；不自动等于被怀疑犯罪。

etymology.historical_story: Diperhatikan belongs to the perhati family, whose meanings connect attentive looking with concern and supervision. Malay dictionaries also associate this family with hati, the vocabulary of inner feeling and attention. The passive construction shifts the sentence's focus toward whatever receives that attention: a child's behaviour, a warning, or a pattern in research. See [DBP: perhati](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?d=175768&keyword=perhati).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听到 di-per-ha-ti-kan，先认出 di-＝被，再想到 perhati＝留意：diperhatikan 就是“被留意、被观察”。

senses.zh_definition: 被有意做出或安排；出于故意，而非偶然发生。

senses.ms_definition: Dilakukan atau diadakan dengan niat dan kehendak tertentu, bukan secara kebetulan.
senses.nuances: 是被动动词，常见于 yang disengajakan、tidak disengajakan 和 tanpa disengajakan；否定形式表示非故意。释义依据词根及其派生词整理，并非逐字引文。[DBP：sengaja 及其派生词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=kesengajaan)

senses.zh_definition: 表情、动作或表现被刻意做出；带有人为安排或装出来的意味。

senses.nuances: 强调表现经过刻意控制；不一定意味着恶意或欺骗。此用法与 DBP 在 sengaja 条下所举的微笑例子相符。[DBP：sengaja](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=kesengajaan)

etymology.historical_story: Malay builds this word transparently from sengaja, expressing intention, with passive di- and suffix -kan. DBP records menyengajakan and illustrates its passive counterpart through a deliberately assumed smile. This connects purposeful action with consciously managed expression. The account describes documented Malay word formation; it does not establish an earlier donor language. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=kesengajaan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听到 sengaja 就抓住“故意”；前加 di-、后接 -kan，理解成“被故意做出”。

morphology.pattern_note: 纠正数据包的词根分析：ditanya 是被动形式，词根为 tanya。前缀 di- 不改变词根首音；ny 表示单个辅音 /ɲ/。被动前缀 di- 与动词连写。

etymology.historical_story: Ditanya is formed within Malay from tanya, the base associated with asking, and the passive prefix di-. Its structure lets a speaker place the person receiving a question first. This makes the form useful in reporting: a journalist can introduce someone's response with apabila ditanya before presenting the explanation. No separate borrowed origin is needed to explain this formation.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 di-，先想到“被”；tanya 是“问”：di- + tanya → 被问。

morphology.formula: di + mana + pun → di mana pun；表示任意地点时常用 di mana-mana pun
morphology.pattern_note: 这是介词 di、疑问成分 mana 与小品词 pun 的组合，不是加词缀形成的单词。输入连写形不规范；各成分应分写。陈述任意地点时，DBP 建议使用 di mana-mana 或 di mana-mana pun。[DBP：mana pun](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=mana+pun)

senses.zh_definition: 无论在什么地方；在任何地方。输入形式 dimanapun 是非规范连写，规范表达应按句法写为 di mana pun 或 di mana-mana pun。
senses.en_definition: Wherever; anywhere, irrespective of location. A nonstandard fused spelling of a locative expression.
senses.ms_definition: Di mana-mana sahaja atau tanpa mengira tempat seseorang atau sesuatu berada.
senses.nuances: 词性标签表示整个短语的地点状语功能，并非认定它是独立副词。正式例句采用规范分写及适当重叠形式。headword.status 按指定格式保留为 official，但 dimanapun 本身不是获认可的规范拼写。[DBP：拼写与任意地点表达](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=mana+pun)

janji 在这里表示“只要”，标准对应形式为 asalkan。
口语可把地点提前，形成 kat mana-mana pun boleh 的结构。

messages.en: Then let's meet at the café in front of the station. I'm almost there.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 礼貌程度主要取决于人称和语气。对客户可用 di mana-mana pun anda berada；熟人聊天可用 kat mana-mana。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 公文、考试、新闻稿及工作邮件避免连写 dimanapun。表示地点用 di，表示前往的方向用 ke，例如 ke mana-mana。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 礼貌程度主要取决于人称和语气。对客户可用 di mana-mana pun anda berada；熟人聊天可用 kat mana-mana。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 公文、考试、新闻稿及工作邮件避免连写 dimanapun。表示地点用 di，表示前往的方向用 ke，例如 ke mana-mana。

etymology.historical_story: This expression combines three separate Malay elements: di marks location, mana asks which place, and pun contributes emphasis or an unrestricted reading. The fused spelling can conceal that structure. Standard writing keeps the elements separate, while mana-mana supplies an indefinite reference. The expression therefore illustrates how Malay builds meanings through combinations of ordinary grammatical words.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: di 是“在”，mana 是“哪里”，pun 加上“不论哪个也一样”的感觉；三个成分分开写。记任意地点时，用 di mana-mana pun。

morphology.pattern_note: di- 标示被动，-kan 参与构成及物或使动意义；词根 bangun 不变，ng 表示 /ŋ/。本结构可拆解为被动前缀与后缀的组合，格式中归入 circumfix。输入的 dibangun 仍含前缀，实际词根为 bangun。[DBP：bangun](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=bangun)

senses.zh_definition: 被叫醒；因他人的动作、声音或其他刺激而从睡眠中醒来。
senses.en_definition: To be awakened by someone or by a disturbance.
senses.ms_definition: Dikejutkan atau digerakkan sehingga terjaga daripada tidur.
senses.nuances: 是 membangunkan 的被动形式，突出有人或某种刺激使其醒来；bangun 单独表示醒来或起身，terbangun 常强调突然醒来。[DBP：bangun](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=bangun)

senses.zh_definition: 建筑物、设施或聚落被兴建、建造或建立起来。
senses.en_definition: To be built, erected, or established.
senses.ms_definition: Dibina atau didirikan sebagai bangunan, kemudahan atau petempatan.
senses.nuances: 常见于规划、工程及历史叙述。描述单纯施工时，dibina 也很常用；具体译法由主语决定。[DBP：bangun](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=bangun)

collocations.en: be built in a new area
be developed as a training centre

senses.zh_definition: 地区、经济、系统或产品被开发、建设或推动发展。
senses.en_definition: To be developed or brought to a more advanced or functional state.
senses.ms_definition: Diusahakan supaya maju, berkembang atau berfungsi mengikut tujuan.
senses.nuances: 适用于土地开发、社会经济发展及现代技术开发。sistem dibangunkan 通常表示系统被开发，不表示系统被叫醒。[DBP：bangun](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=bangun)

collocations.en: a system that has been developed

collocations.zh: 乡村地区得到开发建设

senses.zh_definition: 兴趣、精神、意识或愿望被激发、唤起。
senses.en_definition: To be aroused or fostered, especially an interest, feeling, or aspiration.
senses.ms_definition: Ditimbulkan atau dibangkitkan, khususnya minat, perasaan atau hasrat.
senses.nuances: 较具书面色彩。日常表达“培养兴趣”时，dipupuk 常更自然；必须根据宾语判断，不能一律译成“开发”。[DBP：bangun](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=bangun)

collocations.en: an interest in reading is fostered
a spirit of self-reliance is fostered

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku dah dibangunkan mak pukul enam tadi, tapi tidur balik lah.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya sudah dibangunkan oleh ibu pada pukul enam pagi tadi, tetapi saya tidur semula.

spoken_features: dah 是 sudah 的口语缩略形式。
mak 是母亲的日常称呼。
口语中可省略施事标记 oleh 及时间介词 pada。
tidur balik 在这里表示“又睡回去”，标准对应为 tidur semula。

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku dah dibangunkan mak pukul enam tadi, tapi tidur balik lah.
messages.ms_standard: Saya sudah dibangunkan oleh ibu pada pukul enam pagi tadi, tetapi saya tidur semula.
messages.zh: 我妈早上六点就叫醒我了，可我又睡回去了。
messages.en: My mum woke me at six this morning, but I went back to sleep.

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Patutlah lambat! Cepat siap, kita nak gerak dah.
messages.ms_standard: Patutlah kamu lewat! Bersiaplah segera kerana kita akan bertolak sebentar lagi.
messages.zh: 难怪迟到了！快准备好，我们马上要出发了。
messages.en: No wonder you're late! Get ready—we're about to leave.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 被动式适合正式报告中突出项目、系统或服务。描述叫醒长辈的情境时，可使用完整称谓和温和措辞，避免直接命令 Bangun!。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 工程报告中应区分 dibangunkan（已被开发或被开发）、sedang dibangunkan（正在开发）与 akan dibangunkan（将开发）；di- 本身不表示过去时或完成。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 被动式适合正式报告中突出项目、系统或服务。描述叫醒长辈的情境时，可使用完整称谓和温和措辞，避免直接命令 Bangun!。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 工程报告中应区分 dibangunkan（已被开发或被开发）、sedang dibangunkan（正在开发）与 akan dibangunkan（将开发）；di- 本身不表示过去时或完成。

etymology.historical_story: Dibangunkan combines bangun with passive di- and the suffix -kan. The word family links waking and rising with building and development. Someone can be made to wake, a structure can be brought into existence, and a community can be helped to advance. These established senses explain why context is essential when translating the passive form.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: bangun 是“起来”，-kan 让对象“起来”，di- 表示对象承受动作：人被叫起来，设施被建起来，系统被开发出来。

morphology.pattern_note: 借词作为完整基础词记忆，不拆成 do + bi。派生时，meN- 在 d 前变为 men-，保留 d：meN- + dobi → mendobi。

senses.zh_definition: 洗衣工；以替顾客清洗、熨烫衣物为职业的人，通常说 tukang dobi。
senses.en_definition: A person whose occupation is washing and ironing customers' clothes.
senses.ms_definition: Orang yang pekerjaannya mencuci dan menggosok pakaian pelanggan; tukang dobi.
senses.nuances: 这是数据包提供的传统核心义。现代交流中，指从业者时说 tukang dobi 或 pekerja dobi 更清楚；单说 dobi 容易被理解为洗衣店。

senses.zh_definition: 洗衣店；提供衣物清洗服务的场所，口语中常省略 kedai。
senses.en_definition: A laundry shop or, in context, a self-service laundrette.
senses.ms_definition: Kedai atau tempat yang menyediakan kemudahan atau perkhidmatan mencuci pakaian.
senses.nuances: kedai dobi 是明确的完整表达。口语 pergi ke dobi 常指去洗衣店。dobi layan diri 特指自助洗衣店；普通 dobi 不保证提供干洗或熨烫。

senses.zh_definition: 衣物洗烫业务或服务；常在复合表达中作名词修饰语。
senses.en_definition: The laundering trade or service, especially as a noun modifier.
senses.ms_definition: Kegiatan atau perkhidmatan mencuci pakaian serta menggosoknya jika termasuk dalam perkhidmatan yang ditawarkan.
senses.nuances: perkhidmatan dobi 等表达中的 dobi 指业务类别，不必另立为可分等级的形容词。英语 laundry 若指待洗衣物，应按语境译作 pakaian kotor 或 kain kotor。[DBP 英马词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=mendobi)

dual_scenarios.zh: 酒店为住客提供另行收费的洗衣服务。
dual_scenarios.en: The hotel provides laundry services for guests at an additional charge.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku nak pergi dobi kat bawah kejap.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya hendak pergi sebentar ke kedai dobi di tingkat bawah.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我想去楼下洗衣店一会儿。
dual_scenarios.en: I'm going to pop down to the laundry.
spoken_features: nak 对应 hendak。
kat 对应 di。
kejap 是 sekejap 的口语简化。
dobi 省略 kedai；pergi 后的方向介词 ke 也可在口语中省略。

messages.speaker: Farah (室友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku nak pergi dobi kat bawah kejap. Kau ada baju nak basuh tak?
messages.ms_standard: Saya hendak pergi sebentar ke kedai dobi di tingkat bawah. Adakah awak mempunyai pakaian yang hendak dibasuh?
messages.zh: 我去楼下洗衣店一会儿，你有衣服要洗吗？
messages.en: I'm popping down to the laundry. Have you got any clothes to wash?

messages.speaker: Amir (室友)
messages.ms_spoken: Ada, tunggu kejap. Aku bawa turun sekali.
messages.ms_standard: Ada, tunggu sebentar. Saya akan membawa pakaian saya ke bawah juga.
messages.zh: 有，等一下，我也把衣服拿下去。
messages.en: Yes, give me a moment. I'll bring mine down too.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 向店员询问可说 Boleh siap esok?（明天能洗好吗？），并以 encik、puan 或合适称呼表示尊重。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: dobi 在马来西亚是中性日常用词，不暗示从业者的族群或身份。送洗时宜明确询问是否包含熨烫、干洗及特殊面料处理。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 向店员询问可说 Boleh siap esok?（明天能洗好吗？），并以 encik、puan 或合适称呼表示尊重。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: dobi 在马来西亚是中性日常用词，不暗示从业者的族群或身份。送洗时宜明确询问是否包含熨烫、干洗及特殊面料处理。

etymology.historical_story: Dobi is traced to Hindi dhobī, meaning a washerman. The borrowed word preserves an occupational meaning, while everyday Malay also uses it for the shop associated with that work. Kedai dobi and dobi layan diri show how a word for a person can accompany changing ways of providing the same service. [Lexical source](https://kaikki.org/dictionary/Malay/meaning/d/do/dobi.html)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 do.bi 两拍和“洗、烫”两步绑定：看见 dobi 招牌，就想到洗衣服务。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根是 pasti；资料包将 dipastikan 标为词根有误。di- 构成被动式，词首 p 保留；主动式 meN- + pasti + -kan → memastikan，p 被鼻音 m 替代。di- 不表示过去时。

senses.zh_definition: 被确认、被查明或被确定；表示某项事实、情况或安排经过核实而得到明确结论。
senses.en_definition: To be ascertained, confirmed, or determined with certainty.
senses.ms_definition: Dinyatakan, ditentukan atau ditetapkan dengan pasti.
senses.nuances: 是 memastikan 的被动形式，常与 dapat、belum dapat、masih belum 连用。belum dapat dipastikan 表示“尚无法确定”，不等于事情已经被否定。释义依据 [PRPM：pasti](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=pasti) 改写。

collocations.en: the cause of the incident has yet to be established
the exact date can be determined

senses.zh_definition: 被确保；表示通过检查或采取措施，使某项条件得到满足或某种状态得以实现。
senses.en_definition: To be ensured or made certain through appropriate checks or measures.
senses.ms_definition: Dijamin atau diusahakan supaya sesuatu keadaan benar-benar wujud atau sesuatu syarat dipenuhi.
senses.nuances: 常见于程序、检查及工作要求，如 perlu dipastikan。关注措施能否落实；与第一义核实既有事实的用法有所区别。口语中也常改用主动句 pastikan。

collocations.zh: 必须确保参与者的安全

collocations.ms: perlu dipastikan bahawa semua pintu berkunci
collocations.zh: 必须确保所有门都已锁好
collocations.en: it must be ensured that all doors are locked

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Punca gangguan bekalan air masih belum dapat dipastikan, dan siasatan sedang dijalankan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 供水中断的原因目前仍无法确定，调查正在进行。
dual_scenarios.en: The cause of the water supply disruption has yet to be established, and an investigation is underway.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Tarikh tu belum dapat dipastikan lagi lah; tunggu jawapan pihak dewan dulu.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Tarikh itu masih belum dapat dipastikan; kita perlu menunggu jawapan daripada pihak pengurusan dewan terlebih dahulu.
dual_scenarios.zh: 那个日期还定不下来啦，先等礼堂管理方回复。
dual_scenarios.en: The date still isn’t confirmed; let’s wait to hear back from the venue first.
spoken_features: tu 是 itu 的口语形式
lah 缓和解释的语气
dulu 对应 terlebih dahulu
省略可由上下文理解的主语

messages.speaker: Amir (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Tarikh majlis dah dapat dipastikan ke?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah tarikh majlis sudah dapat dipastikan?
messages.zh: 活动日期已经能确定了吗？
messages.en: Has the event date been confirmed yet?

messages.speaker: Farah (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Belum lagi lah. Pihak dewan belum balas; nanti aku beritahu kat sini.
messages.ms_standard: Masih belum. Pihak pengurusan dewan belum memberikan jawapan; saya akan memaklumkannya di sini nanti.
messages.zh: 还没呢。礼堂那边还没回复，之后我会在这里通知。
messages.en: Not yet. The venue hasn’t replied; I’ll post an update here when they do.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: belum dapat dipastikan 是正式、审慎的表达，适合向上级、客户或公众说明尚无定论；若能补充下一次更新时间，沟通会更清楚。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合调查、新闻、会议安排及检查程序。对尚未核实的信息使用否定或情态结构；单独说 sudah dipastikan 会传达已有明确依据。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: belum dapat dipastikan 是正式、审慎的表达，适合向上级、客户或公众说明尚无定论；若能补充下一次更新时间，沟通会更清楚。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合调查、新闻、会议安排及检查程序。对尚未核实的信息使用否定或情态结构；单独说 sudah dipastikan 会传达已有明确依据。

etymology.historical_story: Malay builds this word from pasti, meaning certain, through its productive system of affixes. The active memastikan presents someone as establishing certainty; the passive dipastikan places the fact or condition in focus. This perspective suits reports and administrative writing, where what has been established often matters more than naming the person who checked it.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: pasti＝确定；di-＝被；-kan＝使其如此：dipastikan 就是“被确认／被确保”。

morphology.pattern_note: 后缀 -an 构成表示推动结果、作用或动力的名词；词根末尾 ng 表示单一辅音 /ŋ/，接元音后在 do.ro.ngan 中成为末音节声母，不读成 /nɡ/。

senses.zh_definition: 把物体向前推的力量或作用；推力、推挤。
senses.en_definition: A physical push or force that moves something forward.
senses.ms_definition: Sorongan, tolakan atau asakan.
senses.nuances: 指实际施力或推挤。在一般日常叙述中，tolakan 往往更直接；dorongan 也常出现在描述力或运动的语境。基础义项依据：[DBP：dorongan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=dorongan)。

senses.zh_definition: 促使人采取行动或继续努力的鼓励、支持、劝勉或外在推动。
senses.en_definition: Encouragement, support, or an external stimulus that prompts action.
senses.ms_definition: Kiasan: galakan, anjuran, desakan atau perangsang.
senses.nuances: 常指家人、教师、同事或环境给予的激励。多数语境带正面色彩，但词本身也能指促使人做坏事的影响，具体评价取决于上下文。

senses.zh_definition: 促使人产生某种行为的内在动力、欲望或冲动。
senses.en_definition: An inner drive, motive, or urge to act.
senses.ms_definition: Galakan atau desakan dari dalam diri yang menggerakkan seseorang untuk bertindak.
senses.nuances: 这是比喻义在心理活动中的细分。可表示长期动力，也可表示一时冲动；不能仅凭 dorongan 判断行为是否理性或正当。相关心理用法见：[DBP：dorongan 与 drive](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?k=dorongan)。

dual_scenarios.ms: Dorongan daripada pihak pengurusan telah meningkatkan keyakinan kakitangan untuk mencadangkan penambahbaikan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 管理层的鼓励增强了员工提出改进建议的信心。
dual_scenarios.en: Encouragement from management has given staff greater confidence to suggest improvements.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku perlukan dorongan sikit je sebelum nak cuba benda baru ni.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya hanya memerlukan sedikit dorongan sebelum mencuba perkara baharu ini.
dual_scenarios.zh: 尝试这个新东西之前，我只需要有人稍微给我打打气。
dual_scenarios.en: I just need a little encouragement before I try this new thing.
spoken_features: aku 用于关系亲近的人之间。
sikit 对应 sedikit。
je 对应 sahaja。
nak 对应 mahu；ni 对应 ini。

messages.speaker: Hafiz (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku nak mohon kerja tu, tapi rasa tak cukup bagus lah.
messages.ms_standard: Saya mahu memohon pekerjaan itu, tetapi saya berasa diri saya belum cukup layak.
messages.zh: 我想申请那份工作，但总觉得自己还不够好。
messages.en: I want to apply for that job, but I don't feel good enough.

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kau dah ada pengalaman. Cuba je dulu, aku bagi dorongan dari sini!

etymology.historical_story: Dorongan is formed transparently from dorong, to push, and the noun-forming suffix -an. Its meanings connect physical movement with human motivation: a push can move an object, while encouragement can move someone towards action. This connection offers a clear way to understand the word without inventing an ancient origin story or treating every kind of motivation as positive.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: dorong 是推，-an 把它变成名词：推车靠推力，前进靠 dorongan——有人推你一把，也有人给你打气。

etymology.historical_story: Dai is an Arabic loan connected with calling or inviting people to Islam. It belongs to the same Arabic lexical tradition as dakwah, although Malay does not derive dai by adding a local suffix to dakwah. In Malaysian usage, the word identifies a religious communicator, including someone serving a community rather than only addressing large audiences.

etymology.historical_story: Droid is a shortened form of android, rather than a word built with Malay affixes. Star Wars made the term especially familiar through robot characters such as R2-D2. etymology.historical_story: Ditembusi is a transparent Malay formation rather than a separate historical root. It presents the affected object as the subject of a passive verb. Its shared image is passage through a boundary: a projectile crosses a surface, moisture enters material, or an attacker gets through a defence. See [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=tembus).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: di- 想成“被”，tembus 想成“穿透”：ditembusi＝被穿透；市场和防线也能“被突破”。

etymology.historical_story: Direktur reflects Dutch directeur, a title carried into Indonesian administrative and business vocabulary. Malay dictionaries retain the word with the label IB, identifying an Indonesian Dutch borrowing. Its coexistence with Malaysian pengarah illustrates how neighbouring standard languages can name similar institutions differently. The adaptation of Dutch -eur to -ur is discussed in [ASIALEX proceedings](https://badanbahasa.kemendikdasmen.go.id/resource/doc/files/Asialex2021_Proceedings.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 direktur 与英语 director 连起来记：都是机构主管；看到印尼公司的 direktur，想到马来西亚常说的 pengarah。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: Dubai 是中性地名，无特殊敬称要求；正式文件、地址及邮件中应保留首字母大写。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 讨论国籍时应区分城市、酋长国和国家。不要把住在 Dubai 的所有人都称为阿联酋公民，也不宜据此推断其财富或宗教。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: Dubai 是中性地名，无特殊敬称要求；正式文件、地址及邮件中应保留首字母大写。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 讨论国籍时应区分城市、酋长国和国家。不要把住在 Dubai 的所有人都称为阿联酋公民，也不宜据此推断其财富或宗教。

etymology.historical_story: Dubai is an Arabic place name carried into Malay as a proper noun. Its deeper origin remains uncertain: historical accounts offer several competing explanations, including a connection with a place or market called Daba. The name belongs to both a city and its emirate, so a single confident literal translation would be misleading. [Historical account](https://hamdan.ae/en/uae-history)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Dubai 对应“迪拜”：把机票目的地和城市天际线连起来记；遇到 Emiriah Dubai，则把画面扩大到整个酋长国。

morphology.pattern_note: 纠正输入中的词根误标：disekat 是 sekat 加被动前缀 di- 的派生形式。di- 不引起词根首辅音变化，须与词根连写；它本身不表示过去时。

senses.zh_definition: 被挡住、被阻止通过或继续前进；也指扩散或蔓延受到遏制。
senses.en_definition: To be blocked or prevented from passing or advancing; to have one's spread contained.
senses.ms_definition: Dihalang daripada melalui sesuatu atau bergerak maju, atau ditahan supaya tidak merebak atau melimpah.
senses.nuances: 是 menyekat 的被动形式，既可用于道路、行进等具体情境，也可用于遏制扩散。与强调受阻状态的 tersekat 有别。释义依据 [PRPM 的 sekat／menyekat](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=sekat)转换为被动表达。

senses.zh_definition: 被限制或禁止使用、访问、联系或进行某项活动。
senses.en_definition: To be restricted or barred from access, use, communication, or an activity.
senses.ms_definition: Dikenakan halangan atau batasan terhadap akses, penggunaan, perhubungan atau kegiatan.
senses.nuances: 是“阻止、限制”义在网络和行政语境中的常见应用。账号 disekat 不必然表示永久封禁，具体范围和期限须由上下文说明。本义由 [PRPM 的 menyekat“限制、阻止”义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=sekat)引申。

senses.zh_definition: 被用隔板、帘幕或墙体分隔成不同空间。
senses.en_definition: To be partitioned or divided into separate spaces by a barrier.
senses.ms_definition: Dibahagi atau dipisahkan dengan menggunakan sekat seperti dinding atau tabir.
senses.nuances: 常以 disekat menjadi 说明分隔后的结果，以 disekat dengan 说明分隔材料。此义强调空间划分，依据 [PRPM 的 menyekat 第一义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=sekat)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 办公网络通知

dual_scenarios.en: Access to the website is blocked to protect the office network.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Laman tu disekat kat pejabat kita ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah akses ke laman web itu disekat di pejabat kita?

句末 ke 表示口语疑问。
口语可用 laman tu disekat，标准表达可补足为 akses ke laman web itu disekat。

messages.speaker: Farah (同事)

messages.ms_standard: Adakah akses ke laman web itu disekat di pejabat kita? Saya sudah cuba membukanya, tetapi tidak berjaya.

messages.speaker: Amir (同事)

messages.ms_standard: Saya belum pasti. Saya mahu bertanya kepada pihak teknologi maklumat terlebih dahulu.

messages.en: I'm not sure yet. I'll check with IT first.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 职场说明可用 Akses disekat 或 Akaun disekat，先描述情况。若要说明责任方，再补充 oleh 后的施事者。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于道路、网络、行政限制及空间分隔。Saya disekat oleh dia 在社交媒体语境可表示“我被对方拉黑”，但其他情境也可能指实际被拦住，应补足上下文。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 职场说明可用 Akses disekat 或 Akaun disekat，先描述情况。若要说明责任方，再补充 oleh 后的施事者。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于道路、网络、行政限制及空间分隔。Saya disekat oleh dia 在社交媒体语境可表示“我被对方拉黑”，但其他情境也可能指实际被拦住，应补足上下文。

etymology.historical_story: Disekat is a transparent Malay formation rather than an indivisible root. Sekat names a partition or obstacle, while menyekat covers partitioning, blocking and containing. Adding passive di- presents the affected entity as the sentence's focus. Digital uses preserve that barrier image: access to a website can be blocked just as a physical passage can. [PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=sekat)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: di- 记作“被”，sekat 想成一道隔板：disekat 就是“被隔住、被挡住”。

morphology.pattern_note: -mu 是附着书写的第二人称代词，不是派生词缀；此处以 suffix 表示其后附位置。连接时词根读音不变。输入音节为空；常规分节为 de.pan.mu。保留输入爪夷文 دڤن，它对应 depan；完整形式为 دڤنمو。

senses.zh_definition: 你前面的位置或空间；通常用于 di depanmu、ke depanmu 等结构。
senses.en_definition: The space or position in front of you, usually following a spatial preposition.
senses.ms_definition: Bahagian atau ruang di hadapan orang yang disapa sebagai kamu.
senses.nuances: 整体是 depan 加第二人称后附代词 -mu；在 di depanmu 中，表示位置关系的完整介词短语包含 di。不能仅因 depan 有“下一个”用法，就把 depanmu 直接解释成“你的未来”；后者通常说 masa depanmu。本定义依据词根义及构词关系综合表述。[DBP：depan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1/Cari1?d=7120&keyword=depan)

collocations.en: to a position in front of you
