cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于设施、物品、环境、名誉及关系受损的情境。该词不自动表示蓄意行为；只有证据支持时才加 dengan sengaja“故意”。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: dirosakkan 容易引出责任归属。投诉时宜描述可观察到的损坏；若尚不清楚原因，可先说 rosak，避免把推测说成事实。

etymology.historical_story: Dirosakkan illustrates a productive Malay contrast: rosak describes damage as a condition, merosakkan presents the action of causing it, and dirosakkan presents the affected thing as the subject. This makes the passive useful in reports about public property and other losses. The explanation concerns established modern morphology; the consulted sources do not establish a deeper historical origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: rosak＝坏；-kan＝弄坏；di-＝被。三步连起来：dirosakkan＝被弄坏。

morphology.pattern_note: di- 标记被动，-kan 构成及物动词；词根首音 t 保留，ngg 表示 /ŋɡ/。输入包把整个派生词识别为词根，此处按实际构词纠正。

senses.zh_definition: 被推迟到较后的时间；原定进行或履行的事项被延期或暂缓。
senses.en_definition: To be postponed or deferred until a later time.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk pasif menangguhkan: dipindahkan pelaksanaan atau penyelesaiannya kepada waktu yang kemudian.
senses.nuances: 适用于活动、付款、工程和决定等；不自动表示取消，也不保证已有新日期。di- 表示被动，不表示过去时。释义据 [DBP：tangguh](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107200&keyword=tangguh) 编写。

senses.zh_definition: 会议、议会或审讯等已经开始后被宣布暂时结束，留待另一个时间继续。

senses.zh_definition: 事情被有意拖延，迟迟不予处理或完成。
senses.en_definition: To be deliberately delayed or put off.
senses.ms_definition: Sengaja dilewatkan atau tidak disegerakan pengurusannya.
senses.nuances: 刻意拖延的意思须由上下文支持，例如 sengaja、terus 或 berulang kali；该词本身也可用于中性的延期。

etymology.historical_story: The root tangguh belongs to Malay vocabulary for delaying an action or allowing more time. Its derivatives connect everyday requests for an extension with institutional postponements. In ditangguhkan, passive di- places the delayed event in focus. This helps explain its usefulness in notices, where the changed arrangement often matters more than the person responsible.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 /taŋɡuh/ 对应的 tangguh 想成日历上往后移动的事项；外加 di-，就是“这件事被延期”。

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries distinguish landa associated with forceful impact from a homonymous mining word for panning ore. The impact sense also extends to emotions and crises, allowing an inner experience to be described like an outside force. Passive di- places the affected village, institution or person in focus. These dictionary distinctions do not establish a single historical origin for both roots.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 landa 记成“一股力量冲过来”；加上 di-，主语就成了“被冲击的一方”。想到 kampung dilanda banjir：村庄遭洪水侵袭。

etymology.historical_story: Malay tuju links physical direction with intention: a traveller heads towards a place, while a person directs effort towards a goal. Dituju expresses the destination or target through passive morphology. A separate dictionary homonym refers to a harmful spell in traditional belief; that meaning should not be treated as the origin of the everyday directional sense. [DBP: tuju](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=tuju)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: tuju 想成一支“朝目标去”的箭头；加上被动 di-，镜头转到箭头所指的地方：dituju＝被朝向、被前往。

etymology.historical_story: Diatasi belongs to the family of atas, meaning an upper position or level. Its meanings offer a useful spatial connection: overcoming a difficulty or surpassing a rival can be pictured as getting above it. This is a learning interpretation of the related meanings, not a documented account of when those meanings developed.

etymology.historical_story: English disk belongs to a word family reaching back through Latin discus to Greek diskos, a round object or throwing discus. The familiar circular shape later supplied a name for computer storage media. In Malaysian terminology, the computing equivalent is cakera, while disk remains visible in English interfaces and mixed-language technical conversations. See [Oxford’s word history](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/disc) and [DBP terminology](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=cakera).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: disk：想象一张装数据的圆盘；正式马来语换成 cakera，hard disk＝cakera keras。

etymology.historical_story: The recoverable formation here is grammatical: Malay adds the passive prefix di- to rogol. This shifts attention from the perpetrator to the person subjected to the assault. DBP records the related forms merogol, perogol and perogolan. The consulted entry does not establish a deeper historical origin for rogol, so no speculative borrowing story is assigned.

etymology.historical_story: Tangan means hand, while menangani names the act of undertaking or handling something. The connection is easy to picture: work comes into someone's hands. This is a semantic memory image rather than a dated historical claim. DBP also preserves a physical beating sense, illustrating why context matters when reading older uses of ditangani.

etymology.historical_story: Diharap belongs to the Malay harap family, which connects wanting an outcome with depending on someone. The passive prefix di- shifts attention towards what is hoped for or whom one relies on. This explains why the same form appears in courteous notices and judgments of reliability. No specific ancient borrowing origin is established here. See [DBP: harap](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=harap).

etymology.historical_story: Disambar is formed from sambar with the passive prefix di-. Its meanings connect sudden capture, forceful contact and figurative opportunity-taking. Traditional Malay proverbs also place the word in scenes involving eagles and chickens. This provides a cultural link between swift predation and sudden misfortune, without requiring an invented account of the root's prehistoric origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: di- 表示“被”：想象一棵树突然被雷击中，disambar petir。抓住“突然扑来并接触目标”的画面，可串起叼走、抢走和雷击。

etymology.historical_story: DBP identifies the legal sense of sabit as an Arabic borrowing associated with certainty and established guilt. Malay adds its own affixes to form mensabitkan, disabitkan and sabitan. The word therefore illustrates how a borrowed base becomes productive within Malay grammar, while remaining distinct from the homonymous word for a sickle. [DBP: sabit](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=sabit)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 di- 的“被”和 sabit 的“证实”：罪责被证实，人就可能被 disabitkan（定罪）。

senses.ms_definition: Pelantar beroda yang menyokong kamera dan membolehkannya digerakkan dengan lancar semasa penggambaran.
senses.nuances: 这里采用影视器材义。dolly 是英语拼写，马来文技术写作宜采用 doli；本条马来文释义为说明性编写。DBP 术语资料收录 kamera doli，参见 [DBP：kamera](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=kamera)。Dolly 的人名用法不属于此器材义；dolly 移动改变摄影机位置，zoom 则通过镜头调整画面范围。

etymology.historical_story: Here dolly is an English filmmaking term used within Malay production talk. Its Malay counterpart doli appears in DBP's technical expression kamera doli. The paired spellings illustrate how a specialist term can circulate in its source-language form while also receiving a Malay spelling for terminology and formal writing. No specific date of borrowing is established here. [DBP terminology](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=kamera)

morphology.pattern_note: 纠正输入包的自动分析：这是 satu 的派生被动动词。di- 标示被动，-kan 构成使成为一体的及物动词；词根 s 保留。circumfix 在此按给定分类表示前后附加结构，并非声称 di- 与 -kan 不可分别分析。音节为规则分析所得；Jawi 保留输入包的 null。[DBP：satu](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107200&keyword=satu)

senses.nuances: 这是婚姻语境中的婉辞。仅指恋爱、交往或同住时，不应自动使用此义。DBP 的 Kamus Pelajar 以 Mereka telah disatukan 举例。[DBP：satu 的婚姻义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107200&keyword=satu)

etymology.historical_story: Disatukan illustrates how Malay builds an abstract action from the ordinary numeral satu, meaning one. The suffix -kan helps form the action of making things one, while di- presents that action from the receiving side. Dictionaries also record marriage as a figurative joining. The word therefore connects administrative consolidation and personal union through the same transparent idea of becoming one.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住中间的 satu“一”：di- 表示“被”，-kan 表示“使成为”，合起来就是“被合成一体”。

morphology.pattern_note: 沿用输入包的整词标记。本条暂按德语连词解释，尚不能确定输入词在原语料中的身份。德语 ss 表示 /s/，前面的 a 为短元音；没有可据此生成的马来语派生词。

senses.zh_definition: 德语从属连词：引出陈述内容的从句，表示“……这一事实”或“……的内容”；常对应马来语 bahawa、英语 that，中文通常不单独译出。
senses.en_definition: German that, introducing a clause expressing the content of a statement, thought or fact.
senses.ms_definition: Kata hubung bahasa Jerman yang memperkenalkan klausa isi; lazimnya berpadanan dengan bahawa dalam bahasa Melayu.
senses.nuances: 这是暂定的德语释读，并非已核实的马来语词条或 DBP 官方释义。德语 dass 从句通常将限定动词置于句末；须区别于冠词或代词 das。下列 ms 是德语结构的马来语对应表达，德语原式标在 en 中。参见 [Duden：dass](https://www.duden.de/rechtschreibung/dass)。

collocations.en: I know that … (German: ich weiß, dass …)
the fact that … (German: die Tatsache, dass …)

senses.zh_definition: 德语：用于表示原因、结果、方式或目的的从句及复合连接结构，具体关系由上下文和搭配决定。
senses.en_definition: German conjunction used in clauses of cause, consequence, means or purpose, including compound connective expressions.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Jerman, memperkenalkan klausa sebab, akibat, cara atau tujuan, termasuk dalam rangkai kata penghubung tertentu.
senses.nuances: 此义也仅属于德语；不能把所有 dass 都逐字译为 bahawa。

senses.zh_definition: 德语：引出独立使用、但保留从句语序的感叹或祈愿表达，可表示愿望、警告或遗憾。
senses.en_definition: German conjunction introducing an independent wish, warning or exclamation with subordinate-clause word order.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Jerman, memperkenalkan ungkapan mandiri yang menyatakan harapan, amaran atau kekesalan dengan susunan kata klausa subordinat.
senses.nuances: 依语境和语调翻译，通常没有固定的马来语单词对应。

collocations.en: There had better be no complaints! (German: Dass mir keine Klagen kommen!)

collocations.zh: 没想到事情竟到了这个地步
collocations.en: That it should have come to this! (German: Dass es so weit kommen musste!)

dual_scenarios.context: 教学报告 / 德语语法说明
dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam bahasa Jerman, kata hubung 'dass' lazimnya memperkenalkan klausa subordinat yang meletakkan kata kerja finit pada akhir klausa.
dual_scenarios.zh: 在德语中，连词 dass 通常引出限定动词位于句末的从句。
dual_scenarios.en: In German, the conjunction 'dass' commonly introduces a subordinate clause with the finite verb at the end.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 同学讨论德语作业
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku dah faham dah, dass tu lebih kurang bahawa dalam ayat ni.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya sudah faham. Kata hubung Jerman 'dass' lebih kurang berpadanan dengan 'bahawa' dalam ayat ini.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我懂了，这句里的 dass 大概就是 bahawa 的意思。
dual_scenarios.en: I get it now. In this sentence, German 'dass' roughly corresponds to Malay 'bahawa'.
spoken_features: dass 是被讨论的德语词，并非马来语连词
dah 对应 sudah，重复使用可加强领会后的语气
tu、ni 分别对应 itu、ini

messages.speaker: Farah (同学)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku nak semak ayat ni. Lepas dass, kata kerja kat hujung, kan?
messages.ms_standard: Saya hendak menyemak ayat ini. Dalam klausa yang diperkenalkan oleh 'dass', kata kerja finit berada pada akhir klausa, bukan?
messages.zh: 我想检查一下这句。dass 引出的从句里，限定动词在句末，对吧？
messages.en: I want to check this sentence. In a dass-clause, the finite verb goes at the end, right?

messages.ms_spoken: Ya, betul. Aku dah semak contoh dalam buku tu.

etymology.historical_story: German dass developed from the same historical form as das, through constructions in which a demonstrative introduced a following statement. Duden traces it to Old and Middle High German daʒ. The spelling reform of 1996 replaced the former spelling daß with dass. This history identifies a German conjunction; it does not determine what the unexplained token meant in the source corpus. See [Duden](https://www.duden.de/rechtschreibung/dass).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 在德语学习中，把 dass 想成通向“所说内容”的桥：ich weiß, dass …＝我知道……；桥后的限定动词通常移到句末。

etymology.historical_story: Django grew out of web development work at a newspaper operation in Lawrence, Kansas, and was released as open-source software in 2005. Its creators named the framework after jazz guitarist Django Reinhardt. The name thus carries a musical reference into programming; it is not formed from Malay roots or affixes. See the [official history](https://docs.djangoproject.com/en/dev/faq/general/).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Django 开头听成“jang”，D 不另读；把爵士吉他手的名字与 Python 网页开发框架连起来记。

etymology.historical_story: Ramal carries an older connection between sand and foretelling: Kamus Dewan marks it as Arabic and records both sand and materials used to read fortunes. Modern Malay also uses this family for ordinary prediction. Diramalkan therefore serves weather reports and economic forecasts as well as stories about foretold destinies. [DBP ramal](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=ramal)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读成 di-ra-mal-kan：中间 ramal 是“预测”，两侧 di-…-kan 把镜头转向“被预测的事”。

etymology.historical_story: Malay dukung connects physical carrying with several abstract kinds of support. A child rests against the caregiver's body; a cause, responsibility, or meaning can likewise be described as something carried. These established senses offer a useful cultural image of support as active effort. This is a semantic connection, not a claim about a documented historical sequence. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=mendukung)

etymology.historical_story: Diancie belongs to Pokémon’s invented naming tradition rather than Malay word formation. In the official 2014 film, it rules the underground Diamond Domain and must learn to create a replacement Heart Diamond. This narrative explains its strong cultural association with jewels; it does not establish the linguistic derivation of its name. etymology.historical_story: The senses recorded under cetak connect printed impressions with moulds and casting. This offers a useful conceptual bridge: a surface receives a pattern, or material receives a shape. Dicetak adds the productive Malay passive prefix di-, placing the affected object in focus. This explains its present structure without asserting an unverified ultimate borrowing history. [DBP entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=cetak)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: cetak 是“印”，di- 把镜头转向承受动作的东西：borang dicetak＝表格被打印。

senses.ms_definition: Diatur atau disusun mengikut sesuatu program atau rancangan.
senses.nuances: 用于课程、活动及工作安排，是 memprogramkan 的被动形式；日常交谈也常用 dirancang 或 dijadualkan，但后者更侧重时间安排。马来文释义依据词典主动形式转写，并非原文引述。[DBP：program](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=program%201)

senses.zh_definition: 被编入程序或设置程序指令，使计算机或设备执行指定任务。
senses.en_definition: To be supplied with programmed instructions for performing a specified task.
senses.ms_definition: Dimasukkan program atau diberikan arahan beratur cara supaya sesuatu tugas dapat dilaksanakan.
senses.nuances: 常见结构为 diprogramkan untuk + 动作。表示程序控制，不一定表示人工智能，也不自动包含“已经”的时态意义；完成与否须结合 telah、sudah 等词和语境判断。[DBP：memprogramkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=program%201)

etymology.historical_story: The history visible in this word is a meeting between an international technical vocabulary and Malay grammar. Program names both an organised plan and computer instructions. Malay builds memprogramkan for the action and diprogramkan for its passive counterpart. Consequently, the same form can describe activities arranged beforehand or a machine instructed to act. [DBP: program](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=program%201)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到中间的 program，就想到“程序或计划”；开头 di- 把视角转向承受动作的一方：设备被编程，活动被安排。

morphology.pattern_note: 马来语交谈中的英语夹用，按整词记忆；不能拆成马来语前缀 de- 与词根 tail。所列 IPA 为英语名词的一种标准读法。未将英语变化形式列为马来语派生词。

senses.en_definition: A particular fact, item of information, or set of particulars, used in Malay-English code-switching.
senses.ms_definition: Butir atau maklumat khusus tentang sesuatu perkara; perincian.
senses.nuances: 马来西亚口语中的 detail 常对应 butiran、maklumat lanjut 或 perincian。PRPM 的主要 detail 词条属于英马词典；此处马来语释义为编写释义，不应视为 DBP 对该夹用形式的独立马来语定义。[DBP 英马词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=detail)

senses.en_definition: Detailed or thorough, in informal Malay-English code-switching.
senses.ms_definition: Terperinci atau diterangkan dengan menyebut butir-butirnya.

etymology.historical_story: English detail comes from French détail, linked to an older verb meaning to cut into pieces. The semantic image is useful: a whole account becomes understandable when divided into its individual parts. In Malay conversation, the English word can similarly point to the small facts that make a booking, payment, or explanation complete. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/detail)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 借英语 detail 的熟悉读音记“细节”；正式写作时换成 butiran，强调完整展开时用 perincian。

etymology.historical_story: Diane is the French form of Diana and is also used as a feminine given name in English. Its pronunciation differs between those languages, so its spelling alone does not establish a Malaysian pronunciation. This name history supports a possible interpretation of the input; it does not establish diane as a standard Malay vocabulary item. Source: [Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/diane).

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries distinguish several tunda entries, including postponement, towing, and pushing, with additional figurative uses. The passive prefix di- produces ditunda without selecting among those meanings. A meeting notice and a roadside conversation therefore activate different interpretations. Their shared spelling alone does not prove that every sense developed from one historical source. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=menunda).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先认 di-＝被，再看“拖”的对象：会议被“拖后”是延期，汽车被“拖走”是拖曳。这是助记联想，不是两义同源的断言。

etymology.historical_story: The root kait names a hook, giving this word a concrete image: two things become connected when one catches the other. Malay also uses that physical relationship to describe connections between ideas, people, and events. Dikaitkan presents the connection passively, which helps explain its usefulness in reporting associations without naming the person making them. [DBP: kait family](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=menghubung)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kait 想成一个钩子：di- 表示被，-kan 表示使之连接；dikaitkan 就是被钩到一起，进而表示被联系起来。

etymology.historical_story: Daftar means a register or ordered list. Its word family captures several parts of administrative life: pendaftar names the registrar, pendaftaran names registration, and berdaftar describes registered status. Didaftarkan shifts attention to the person or item entered in the record. The same vocabulary works with a paper register or an online registration system. [DBP: daftar family](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=mendaftar)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 daftar 是名册：di- + daftar + -kan，就像把名字放进名册的动作转成被动——被登记了。

etymology.historical_story: Derajat survives in Malay reference works beside the more familiar Malaysian form darjat. Traditional sayings about climbing steps and descending a staircase use the vocabulary of rank to describe ordered social conduct. This cultural imagery makes status resemble a position on a staircase, while modern Malaysian usage distinguishes social darjat from measurement darjah. [DBP: derajat](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=derajat); [DBP: darjah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=378040&keyword=darjah).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 derajat 中间较弱的 e 暂时收起，就容易联想到 darjat“等级”；马来西亚量温度、量角度则记 darjah。

morphology.pattern_note: diper- 保留词基 setuju 的首音 /s/；词尾 -i 可与前面的 /u/ 分读。此词是 mempersetujui 的被动式；数据包将完整派生词误列为词根，现校正为直接词基 setuju。

etymology.historical_story: The underlying Malay image is shared direction: tuju concerns direction or purpose, while setuju can mean having the same direction or opinion. Dipersetujui packages that agreement into a passive verb, placing the proposal or arrangement first. This helps explain its usefulness in recording decisions and negotiated terms. [DBP: tuju](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=tuju)

etymology.historical_story: The useful story here is grammatical rather than a securely dated borrowing history. Malay banding connects comparison with equivalence and a matching counterpart. Adding di- presents someone or something as receiving the comparison. The shorter dibanding occurs in informal expression, while dibandingkan provides the fuller form normally preferred in formal Malaysian writing.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 banding 想成“两样并排比较”；前面加 di-，主角就变成“被拿来比较”的对象。

morphology.pattern_note: di- 表示被动，-kan 保留相应及物动词的构词形式；词根 salah 不发生音变。输入将整个派生词标作词根，应纠正为 salah。此处 circumfix 按给定分类表示前后缀组合，di- 与 -kan 的语法作用仍须分别理解。

etymology.historical_story: Disalahkan is built transparently from salah, the Malay word associated with wrongness and fault. Its passive prefix shifts attention towards whoever receives the blame. DBP's proverb material includes the image of someone blaming an uneven floor for poor dancing, showing how misplaced blame is criticised through an everyday scene rather than an abstract lecture. etymology.historical_story: Dagu belongs to everyday Malay body vocabulary, but it also appears in traditional imagery. A beautiful chin can be compared to a hanging bee, while the proverb about a beard returning to the chin describes something being exactly where it belongs. The dictionary also extends the body-part image to a chin-shaped section of a keris. [DBP: dagu](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=dagu).

etymology.historical_story: Dahulunya is transparently formed from dahulu and -nya. Its cultural usefulness lies in telling the story of change: an institution acquires a new name, a building gains another purpose, or someone changes occupation. DBP accepts both dahulu dikenali sebagai and dahulunya dikenali sebagai. This illustrates how the longer form preserves the earlier-time meaning while fitting retrospective narration. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=dahulunya)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dahulu 放在时间轴左端，再接 -nya：dahulunya＝‘说到以前那会儿’。

etymology.historical_story: Diajak illustrates Malay's productive voice system rather than a separate historical root. Ajak supplies the idea of inviting or urging participation; di- places the invited person in subject position. Compare Sara mengajak Amir with Amir diajak oleh Sara. The invitation remains the same, but the sentence changes whose experience it foregrounds.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: ajak＝邀人一起做；di-＝被。Sara mengajak Amir → Amir diajak oleh Sara：邀请者与受邀者换了句子位置。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 用于描述操作过程时语气中性。请求别人翻面可说 Tolong balikkan ikan itu，以 tolong 表示礼貌。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合烹饪或物品翻面的描述。正式文件应区分 dibalik、di balik 和 di sebalik，避免把被动动作与方位、隐藏因素混写。

etymology.historical_story: Malay connects returning, reversing direction, and exposing another side through the word balik. Its dictionary family includes membalik, whose transitive meaning concerns turning something over. Adding the passive prefix di- shifts attention to the object receiving that action. The separate expression di balik belongs to spatial description, so a small written space distinguishes two grammatical constructions. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=sebalik)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: balik 想成“转到另一面”；di- 表示“被” → dibalik＝被翻面。看到空格 di balik，就改想“在后面”。

etymology.historical_story: Digantikan belongs to the Malay family built around ganti, expressing replacement. Its structure illustrates how Malay describes an event from the viewpoint of the person or object affected. In an office notice, the old machine can become the sentence topic, while its replacement follows later. This is a grammatical explanation, not a claim about the root's earliest origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 ganti＝换：前加 di-，镜头转向“被换掉的那个”；di- + ganti + -kan＝被替换。

morphology.pattern_note: di- 构成被动式，词根 m 保留，不发生鼻音替换；u 与 a 分属相邻音节。headword.jawi 按输入保留 موات，但该拼写实际对应词根 muat；含 di- 的完整形式应为 ديموات。

senses.zh_definition: 被装入或装载到车辆、船舶等运输工具中。

senses.ms_definition: Dibawa sebagai muatan atau dimasukkan ke dalam kenderaan, kapal atau bekas.

senses.zh_definition: 被收录或刊登于报刊、书籍、报告等载体中。

senses.ms_definition: Dimasukkan sebagai kandungan atau disiarkan dalam akhbar, buku, laporan dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: 此义把“承载内容”延伸到文字与图像。马来西亚正式文本也常使用 dimuatkan 或 termuat；dimuatkan 强调刊入动作，termuat 常着重已经收录的状态。不要将 dimuat 单独解释为“上传”。

senses.zh_definition: 在 dimuat naik 和 dimuat turun 中，分别表示文件被上传及被下载。
senses.en_definition: In dimuat naik and dimuat turun, to be uploaded and downloaded, respectively.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam rangkai kata dimuat naik dan dimuat turun, dipindahkan melalui rangkaian masing-masing ke pelayan atau dari pelayan ke peranti pengguna.
senses.nuances: 这是完整术语的组合义，方向由 naik 或 turun 决定；dimuat 本身不区分上传与下载。DBP 实际使用 Dimuat Naik，见 [DBP 用户手册](https://bukuteks.dbp.gov.my/media/media/0zbNKydzvz.pdf)。

etymology.historical_story: Dimuat is a transparent Malay formation: the passive prefix di- attaches to muat. Its vocabulary links physical cargo with published content, while computing adds the directional expressions muat naik and muat turun. A learner can therefore picture a carrier receiving goods, a report receiving information, or a server receiving files. This explains the modern semantic connections without claiming an unverified ancient origin for muat.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: di- 表示“被”，muat 联想“装载”：dimuat＝被装入；加 naik“上”就是上传，加 turun“下”就是下载。

morphology.pattern_note: di- 标示被动，-kan 构成及物动词；词根 t 保留。对应主动式为 meN- + tewas + -kan → menewaskan，其中 t 脱落。此处 circumfix 按字段归类表示前后缀组合；数据包的词根标记已修正。

etymology.historical_story: Ditewaskan is best understood through Malay grammar rather than a separate borrowing story. The base tewas expresses defeat and also occurs in descriptions of wartime death. Adding -kan produces a transitive action; di- presents that action from the affected participant's perspective. Context therefore distinguishes an ordinary sporting defeat from the much stronger combat sense.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: tewas＝败；menewaskan＝击败别人；ditewaskan＝自己被击败。看到 di-，先找谁承受这个动作。

morphology.pattern_note: 纠正输入包的词根识别：词根为 alih。di- 标记被动，-kan 构成及物或使动用法；词根不发生鼻音同化。circumfix 在此仅表示前后均有附加成分，di- 与 -kan 可分别分析。动词前缀 di- 连写，有别于分写的方位介词 di。

word_family.gloss: 移动；转移某物或注意力
转移；改道的行为或过程

senses.zh_definition: 被移至别处；某物的位置、所在地点或安置地点被改变。
senses.en_definition: To be moved or transferred to another position or location.
senses.ms_definition: Dipindahkan atau diubah kedudukannya dari satu tempat ke tempat yang lain.
senses.nuances: 是 mengalihkan 的被动形式，主语为被移动的对象；本身不表示过去时，时间由 telah、sedang、akan 或上下文表达。马来语释义依据词根义项编写，并非输入包所提供的官方原文。词根及相关义项见[DBP：alih](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=alih)。

senses.zh_definition: 被改变行进方向、流向或接通去向；被改道或转接。

senses.nuances: 常用于交通、车辆、水流和来电等。译成“改道”“引流”还是“转接”，取决于主语；不一定涉及实体物品搬迁。该用法与 alih 的转向、改变义相连，参见[DBP：alih](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=alih)。

senses.zh_definition: 注意力、视线、讨论或工作重心等被转向另一对象或事项。
senses.en_definition: For attention, a gaze, discussion, or effort to be shifted to something else.
senses.ms_definition: Ditukar tumpuan atau arah perhatian, pandangan, perbincangan atau usaha kepada perkara yang lain.
senses.nuances: 表示抽象对象的转移。perhatian dialihkan 可以是有意转换焦点，也可以是注意力受到干扰；不能一律理解为蓄意掩饰。相关搭配获[DBP 语言咨询说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=beralih)支持。

etymology.historical_story: Dialihkan illustrates a productive Malay grammatical pattern rather than a separate borrowed root. Alih expresses movement or change; -kan builds a transitive use, while di- presents the affected object as the subject. The same pattern connects moving a desk with redirecting traffic or attention, allowing physical displacement to describe changes in direction and focus. See [DBP’s alih entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=alih).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 alih＝移、换；di- 把镜头对准承受变化的对象：meja dialihkan＝桌子被移走。

morphology.pattern_note: 资料包将 disakiti 标为词根有误；其词根是 sakit。di- 表示被动，-i 构成相关及物动词；此处 circumfix 用于容纳前后缀组合，不主张二者必须同时派生。di- 不引起鼻音同化，s 保留；末尾 t 接 -i 后成为后一音节的声母。

senses.zh_definition: 受到使身体疼痛的伤害；被弄痛。
senses.en_definition: To be hurt physically or subjected to an action that causes bodily pain.
senses.ms_definition: Dikenai perbuatan yang menyebabkan tubuh berasa sakit; bentuk pasif bagi menyakiti.
senses.nuances: 强调承受他人行为造成的疼痛，不等同于患病；单纯“生病了”通常说 sakit。被动形式本身不表示过去时。释义根据 [DBP 对 menyakiti 的说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=menyakitkan) 编写，并非独立词条的逐字引文。

senses.zh_definition: 感情或内心受到言语、行为等伤害；受到伤心或痛苦的对待。
senses.en_definition: To be hurt emotionally or made to suffer through someone's words or actions.
senses.ms_definition: Dibuat berasa sedih, pilu atau tersinggung oleh kata-kata atau perbuatan seseorang.
senses.nuances: 常见于人际关系、倾诉和抒情表达，可以省略造成伤害的人。被伤害的是某人时，可说 dia disakiti；强调内心时，可说 hatinya disakiti。情感义依据 [DBP 对 menyakiti 的说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=menyakitkan)。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku dah penat disakiti macam ni. Aku nak tenangkan diri dulu.
messages.ms_standard: Saya sudah penat disakiti seperti ini. Saya mahu menenangkan diri terlebih dahulu.
messages.zh: 老是这样被伤害，我真的累了。我想先让自己静一静。

messages.en: Take the time you need. If you want to talk, I'm here.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 对方说自己 disakiti 时，宜先倾听并承认其感受；直接说 jangan sensitif“别那么敏感”容易让人觉得被轻视。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合描述身体或情感伤害。正式投诉中，应进一步说明具体言语、行为和影响；私人倾诉中则应尊重对方是否愿意透露细节。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 对方说自己 disakiti 时，宜先倾听并承认其感受；直接说 jangan sensitif“别那么敏感”容易让人觉得被轻视。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合描述身体或情感伤害。正式投诉中，应进一步说明具体言语、行为和影响；私人倾诉中则应尊重对方是否愿意透露细节。

etymology.historical_story: Disakiti grows from sakit, the Malay vocabulary of pain and illness, through passive di- and verbal -i. Its emotional meaning follows the same vocabulary used for bodily suffering. This makes the expression culturally expressive in personal narratives: the speaker presents someone as the recipient of hurt, while the person responsible may remain unnamed. [DBP: menyakiti](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=menyakitkan).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 sakit“痛”，看到 di- 就转向承受者：disakiti＝被别人弄痛、伤了心。

morphology.pattern_note: di- 构成被动式，与词根连写；词根起首的 b 保留，不发生鼻音同化。数据包将 dibalas 标为词根有误，实际词根为 balas。未提供的 Jawi 保留为 null。

senses.zh_definition: 得到回复或应答，指信件、消息、问候等被对方回应。
senses.en_definition: To be answered or replied to, especially of a message, letter, or greeting.
senses.ms_definition: Dijawab atau disahut, khususnya berkenaan surat, mesej atau salam.
senses.nuances: 是 membalas 的被动式，本身不表示过去时；时间由 sudah、telah、belum、akan 或上下文表达。释义依据 DBP 的 membalas 义项改写为被动式。[DBP：balas](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=254640&keyword=balas)

collocations.en: a message that has not yet been answered

senses.zh_definition: 得到回报、酬答或相应的情感回应。
senses.en_definition: To be repaid, rewarded, or reciprocated.
senses.ms_definition: Diberi sesuatu sebagai imbangan atau tanda penghargaan; disambut dengan perasaan yang sepadan.
senses.nuances: 适用于善意、恩情、付出和感情。回报不一定是金钱；cinta tidak dibalas 指感情得不到回应。具体评价取决于后接内容，例如 kebaikan dibalas dengan kejahatan 表示善意反遭恶意。

senses.zh_definition: 遭到还击、报复或与先前行为相应的惩罚。
senses.en_definition: To be retaliated against, countered, or punished in return for an earlier action.
senses.ms_definition: Dikenakan tindakan sebagai tindak balas terhadap serangan, kezaliman atau kesalahan yang terdahulu.
senses.nuances: 常见于冲突、军事报道及道德评价。serangan dibalas 是攻击遭还击；kejahatan dibalas 可以指恶行受到惩罚，不必然涉及私人复仇。

dual_scenarios.ms: Semua pertanyaan pelanggan akan dibalas dalam tempoh dua hari bekerja.
dual_scenarios.zh: 所有客户咨询将在两个工作日内得到回复。
dual_scenarios.en: All customer enquiries will be answered within two working days.

dah、kat 分别对应 sudah、di。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 正式催办宜说 Mohon agar mesej ini dibalas apabila berkesempatan，意为“烦请方便时回复此消息”。直接说 Kenapa belum dibalas? 可能显得质问。

etymology.historical_story: The base balas connects answering with giving something back. Malay expressions about repaying kindness and exchanging pantun reveal this shared idea of reciprocity. Dibalas applies the passive prefix di-, placing the recipient or earlier action in focus. A message receives an answer just as a kindness receives a return. [DBP: balas](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=254640&keyword=balas)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 balas 记成一个折返箭头：消息发出去，回复折回来；前加 di-，就是“被回复、被回报”。

morphology.pattern_note: di-…-kan 构成与 memadamkan 对应的被动式，词根起首 p 保留；-kan 在此使动作指向被熄灭、清除或平息的对象。数据包的 dipadam 已含被动前缀，并非最终词根，实际词根为 padam。未提供的 Jawi 保留为 null。

word_family.gloss: 熄灭、清除或删除的过程

senses.zh_definition: 被扑灭、熄灭或关闭，指火焰、灯光等被人为或外力使其不再燃烧、发亮。
senses.en_definition: To be extinguished or switched off, especially of a fire or light.
senses.ms_definition: Dijadikan tidak bernyala atau tidak menyala lagi, khususnya api atau lampu.
senses.nuances: 强调对象受到使其熄灭的作用；单独的 padam 则可直接陈述火或灯已经熄灭的状态。释义依据 DBP 的 memadamkan 义项改写为被动式。[DBP：padam](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=113780&keyword=padam)

senses.zh_definition: 被擦除、抹去或删除，指文字、记录、文件等被清除。
senses.en_definition: To be erased, wiped away, or deleted, especially of writing, records, or files.
senses.ms_definition: Dihilangkan atau dilenyapkan, seperti tulisan yang dipadam atau fail yang dihapus daripada simpanan.
senses.nuances: 既可用于实际擦掉字迹，也可用于数码资料的删除。被删除不一定等于无法恢复，永久删除通常需要明确说 dipadamkan secara kekal。

senses.zh_definition: 被消除、压下或浇灭，指感情、欲望、希望、记忆等逐渐或受到作用而消退。
senses.en_definition: To be suppressed, extinguished, or effaced, of a feeling, desire, hope, or memory.
senses.ms_definition: Dihilangkan atau ditenangkan, berkenaan perasaan, keinginan, harapan atau ingatan.
senses.nuances: 属于比喻用法，常带情感或文学色彩。kenangan tidak dapat dipadamkan 指记忆难以抹去，并非真的删除数码资料。

senses.zh_definition: 被平息或镇住，指骚乱、动荡或冲突受到控制。
senses.en_definition: To be quelled or brought under control, of unrest or disorder.
senses.ms_definition: Diredakan atau ditenteramkan, berkenaan rusuhan, kekacauan atau pergolakan.
senses.nuances: 用于新闻、历史叙述或较庄重的表达。现代直接表达也常采用 diredakan、dikawal 或 ditamatkan，具体取决于冲突是否只是缓和还是已经结束。

collocations.en: disorder is brought to an end

senses.zh_definition: 口渴得到解除；渴意被消解。
senses.en_definition: To be quenched, of thirst.
senses.ms_definition: Dihilangkan atau dilegakan, berkenaan dahaga.
senses.nuances: DBP 将“解渴”列为 memadamkan 的义项，但此被动用法较少见，偏文学表达；日常更常说 dahaga hilang 或 menghilangkan dahaga。以下为说明该义的自然短语，不应视为高频固定搭配。

collocations.en: the feeling of thirst is quenched

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Menurut pihak bomba, kebakaran itu berjaya dipadamkan sepenuhnya sebelum tengah malam.
dual_scenarios.zh: 据消防部门表示，大火已于午夜前成功完全扑灭。
dual_scenarios.en: According to the fire service, the fire was completely extinguished before midnight.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Fail tu dah dipadamkan ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah fail itu sudah dipadamkan?
dual_scenarios.zh: 那个文件已经删掉了吗？

句末 ke 表示口语的是非问句。
tak、je 分别对应 tidak、sahaja。
聊天中可保留完整被动式 dipadamkan；更简略时也可能使用 dipadam。

messages.speaker: Farah (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Fail lama tu dah dipadamkan ke?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah fail lama itu sudah dipadamkan?
messages.zh: 那个旧文件已经删掉了吗？

messages.en: No, I only renamed it. The file is still there, don't worry.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 请求同事删除资料时，可说 Boleh tolong pastikan fail ini dipadamkan?，意为“能请你确认这个文件已删除吗？”涉及他人资料时应明确所指文件。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 消防报道、设备使用及文件管理中均常见。讨论记忆、希望或斗志时属于比喻；谈论骚乱时属于较庄重的表达。避免把 dipadamkan 一律译成“删除”，应根据对象选择“扑灭、关闭、擦除、删除或平息”。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 请求同事删除资料时，可说 Boleh tolong pastikan fail ini dipadamkan?，意为“能请你确认这个文件已删除吗？”涉及他人资料时应明确所指文件。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 消防报道、设备使用及文件管理中均常见。讨论记忆、希望或斗志时属于比喻；谈论骚乱时属于较庄重的表达。避免把 dipadamkan 一律译成“删除”，应根据对象选择“扑灭、关闭、擦除、删除或平息”。

etymology.historical_story: Padam links the disappearance of fire or light with the disappearance of writing and other traces. Its derived verb memadamkan means causing that disappearance; dipadamkan presents the affected thing as the subject. Applying this vocabulary to computer files illustrates how a familiar Malay word can describe an activity involving newer technology. [DBP: padam](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=113780&keyword=padam)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 padam 想成“让它消失”：火光消失是扑灭，字迹消失是擦除，文件消失是删除；di-…-kan 表示对象“被这样处理”。

morphology.pattern_note: di- 表示被动，-kan 在常见义中表示使役；词根 malu 不发生音变。输入包将整个派生词标为词根，此处依据实际构词纠正。音节为规则分析结果；Jawi 保留输入包的 null。

word_family.gloss: 羞耻；亦指生殖器，须辨语境

senses.zh_definition: 被弄得羞愧、难堪或丢脸；受到羞辱。
senses.en_definition: To be embarrassed, shamed, or humiliated by someone or something.
senses.ms_definition: Dibuat berasa malu atau aib oleh seseorang atau sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 这是 memalukan 的被动形式，不只是自己感到害羞；是否带有蓄意羞辱，须由语境判断。马来语释义为编辑概括，依据 [DBP PRPM：memalukan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=memalukan)。

collocations.en: be humiliated in front of other people

collocations.zh: 被自己的朋友弄得难堪
collocations.en: be embarrassed by one's own friend

senses.zh_definition: 被视为可耻或令人难为情的事情；被拿来引以为耻。
senses.en_definition: To be regarded as something to feel ashamed of.
senses.ms_definition: Dianggap sebagai sesuatu yang menyebabkan seseorang berasa malu.
senses.nuances: 此义对应 memalukan 的“因某事而感到羞耻”义，较少见，须与“某人遭到羞辱”区别。现代交流中，malu akan 或 berasa malu kerana 往往更明确。依据 [DBP PRPM：memalukan，第二义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=memalukan) 作编辑概括。

collocations.zh: 不是需要引以为耻的事
collocations.en: not something to be ashamed of

collocations.zh: 没有什么需要感到羞耻的
collocations.en: there is nothing to be ashamed of

etymology.historical_story: The root malu links embarrassment with shame and social dignity. Its derivatives show how Malay grammar changes perspective: memalukan presents the person or event causing embarrassment, while dimalukan presents the person affected. This is productive Malay word formation, rather than a separate borrowed word. The deeper historical origin of malu is not established here.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 malu 记成“害羞”；看到 di-...-kan，就想到“被弄得害羞、难堪”。

morphology.pattern_note: di- 构成被动动词，bungkus 的词首 b 保留。这里的 di- 必须连写；表示地点的介词 di 则分写，如 di kedai。输入包将整词标作词根，现按明确构词关系更正；缺失的音节与爪夷文按构词补全。

senses.zh_definition: 被纸、布、叶片等材料包住或包装起来。

senses.ms_definition: Dibalut atau dikemaskan dengan bahan seperti kertas, kain, daun atau bahan pembungkus lain.

senses.ms_definition: Disembunyikan atau dirahsiakan supaya perkara sebenar tidak diketahui.
senses.nuances: 比喻或文学用法，频率低于实物包装义。下列为说明性的搭配；一般公文表达“隐瞒”时，disembunyikan 或 dirahsiakan 更直接。

senses.nuances: 对应词典中 membungkus 的“抓捕”义，属于较少见的延伸用法。正式警务报道宜用 ditangkap 或 diberkas；以下搭配用于辨义，不视为主要高频表达。

etymology.historical_story: Bungkus belongs to the everyday vocabulary of wrapping and carrying goods. Banana leaves provide a familiar Malaysian illustration: a covering can hold rice while making it convenient to carry. Dibungkus adds the productive passive prefix di-, shifting attention from the person doing the wrapping to the food or object receiving it. This explains its formation without assigning an unsupported ancient origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 bungkus＝包，di-＝被：dibungkus 就是“被包起来”。再接 dah，就是口语里常听到的“已经打包好了”。

morphology.pattern_note: di- 标记被动，-kan 构成及物动词；两者分别附加，按本条分类归入 circumfix。词根 bayang 不变，ng 发 [ŋ]。输入把整个派生词标成词根，应改为 bayang；主动对应形式为 membayangkan。

etymology.historical_story: Bayang names a shadow or reflected image and also a picture in the mind. This connection links something seen indirectly with something mentally pictured. Membayangkan develops the ideas of imagining, hinting, and reflecting; dibayangkan shifts attention to what receives that representation. The meanings therefore share an image-based connection rather than three unrelated origins.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: bayang 是“影子、影像”；di- 表示被动：画面被放进脑海，就是“被想象”；话只露出影子，就是“被暗示”。

etymology.historical_story: Davy belongs to the English naming tradition rather than to Malay affix formation. It is used as a familiar form of David, while the same spelling also occurs as a surname. In a Malay biography or news report, its appearance identifies a person; that occurrence alone does not establish a separate Malay common noun.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 David 和昵称 Davy 连在一起记：看到大写 Davy，先识别人名，不拆成马来语词根与词缀。

morphology.formula: ∅ + derrick → derrick（英语整词；马来语对应形式为 derik）
morphology.pattern_note: 没有可分析的马来语词缀。英语 rr、ck 不表示马来语的辅音延长；derik 是另一个拼写形式，不应静默替换输入词头。

senses.zh_definition: 转臂式起重装置：利用支撑杆、吊臂及滑轮绳索吊起和移动重物的设备。
senses.en_definition: A lifting apparatus with a supported boom and a system of ropes and pulleys.
senses.ms_definition: Alat pengangkat yang menggunakan lengan yang disokong serta sistem tali dan takal untuk mengangkat atau memindahkan beban.
senses.nuances: 这是英语 derrick 的工程义，马来语定义为编辑释义，并非 DBP 原文。DBP 术语资料使用 derik，以及 kren derik 等组合；derrick 不能据此直接标为官方马来语拼写。以下搭配采用马来语对应形式。

senses.zh_definition: 钻井井架：竖立在井口上方，用于支撑钻井设备及起落钻具的塔架。
senses.en_definition: A tower over a well that supports drilling equipment and the raising or lowering of drilling tools.
senses.ms_definition: Menara di atas lubang telaga yang menyokong peralatan penggerudian serta kerja menaikkan dan menurunkan alat gerudi.
senses.nuances: 主要用于石油等钻井语境。井架是钻井设施的一部分，不等同于整套钻机或整座海上平台。马来语可用 derik 或说明性的 menara penggerudian。

etymology.historical_story: The English engineering word has an unexpected connection with a person's name. Merriam-Webster traces it through an obsolete word for a hangman or gallows, associated with an English executioner named Derick. Its later meanings concern lifting machinery and drilling towers. Malay reference material records the adapted spelling derik for the drilling structure.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 derrick 和 derik 配对，再联想油井上高高的井架；整词记忆，不把结尾误认作词缀。

morphology.formula: ∅ + dobby → dobby（英语纺织术语，整词记忆）
morphology.pattern_note: 没有马来语词缀；英语参考读音为两个音节。结尾 y 不是马来语后缀，dobby 也不能直接等同于表示洗衣相关概念的 dobi。

senses.zh_definition: 多臂开口装置：安装在织机上，通过控制综框运动织出小型花纹的机构。
senses.en_definition: A loom mechanism that controls harness movements to weave small patterns.
senses.ms_definition: Mekanisme pada alat tenun yang mengawal pergerakan bingkai benang lungsin untuk menghasilkan corak kecil.
senses.nuances: 这是英语纺织义的编辑释义，未核实为 DBP 对 dobby 的官方马来语定义。以下马来语组合保留英语术语，用于专业说明；不代表已认证的规范译名或高频搭配。

collocations.zh: 配有多臂开口机构的织机
collocations.en: a loom fitted with a dobby mechanism

senses.zh_definition: 多臂织物或多臂组织：利用多臂装置织成的带有小型重复花纹的织物或织物组织。
senses.en_definition: A patterned weave, or a fabric made with a dobby mechanism, typically featuring small repeated motifs.
senses.ms_definition: Struktur tenunan atau fabrik bercorak kecil berulang yang dihasilkan dengan mekanisme dobby.

etymology.historical_story: Dobby names both a weaving mechanism and the patterned cloth associated with it. Merriam-Webster records its textile use from 1878 and cautiously suggests a connection with Dobby, a nickname for Robert. The origin remains uncertain. etymology.historical_story: Ditujukan belongs to the tuju family, whose dictionary meanings connect direction with purpose and a target. Malay combines the passive prefix di- with tuju and the suffix -kan. The resulting form can describe physical direction or the recipient of a letter, question or broadcast, linking spatial orientation with communication. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=tuju).

etymology.historical_story: The bangun family connects rising with development. Malaysian dictionaries distinguish membangun, meaning to rise or develop, from membangunkan, which can mean constructing, developing, or waking someone. Indonesian dibangun illustrates how closely related languages can distribute familiar roots differently. Recognizing the shared root helps comprehension, while checking regional verb patterns prevents awkward transfers into Malaysian writing. [DBP: bangun family](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=pembangun)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: di- 提醒你“被……”，bangun 联想“立起来”：建筑被立起来。但写马来西亚标准语时，房屋通常用 dibina，开发项目通常用 dibangunkan。

etymology.historical_story: Dunia comes from Arabic dunyā, referring to the earthly world. In Malay, it also names someone's life or sphere of activity. Adding the Malay clitic -nya makes that world personal: his, hers, or its. The expression thus combines an Arabic-origin noun with Malay grammar to describe an individual's surroundings and experience. [IKIM](https://www.ikim.gov.my/the-world-of-nature-as-alam-and-as-dunya/)

etymology.historical_story: The underlying base is muat, associated with fitting into available space. etymology.historical_story: English dream has a surprisingly puzzling history. Old English drēam referred to joy, music, or merriment, while related Germanic words denoted visions during sleep. Scholars debate how these meanings connect. For Malay learners, the practical distinction is straightforward: English dream corresponds to mimpi in sleep and impian when discussing ambitions. [Oxford University Press](https://blog.oup.com/2019/03/perchance-dream-part-one/)

etymology.historical_story: Dermawan combines derma, a charitable gift, with -wan, a suffix identifying someone associated with a quality or possession. DBP explicitly includes dermawan among examples of this pattern. The suffix belongs to Malay’s inherited stock of Sanskrit-derived affixes, illustrating how an older linguistic resource remains useful for describing generosity in contemporary social life. [DBP：-wan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=wan)；[DBP：Sanskrit affixes](https://jendeladbp.my/app/uploads/woocommerce_uploads/2022/07/DEWAN-SISWA-OGOS-2022-compressed-e5h3j9.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: Ditanda tells its story through Malay word formation: tanda names a sign or identifying mark, while di- places the marked object at the centre of the sentence. The same family includes bertanda, penanda and penandaan. Labels on envelopes, symbols in dictionaries and marks on objects show how one familiar idea supports many practical uses. [DBP: tanda and its word family](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=tanda)

etymology.historical_story: This entry concerns a spelling boundary rather than a newly derived word. Malay combines the independent location marker di with tengah, meaning the middle, to form di tengah. The distinction matters because passive di- attaches to verbs, whereas locative di remains separate. DBP records the spatial expression under tengah. Source: [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=206468&keyword=tengah).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: di 表示“在”，tengah 表示“中间”：在中间 → di tengah。想象在两词中间留一个空位，同时记住词义和分写规则。

etymology.historical_story: Danvers is an English surname of Norman origin. The Dictionary of American Family Names connects it with Anvers, the French name for Antwerp in present-day Belgium. The preposition de became attached to the place name, preserving a geographical connection within a family name. This surname history does not establish a Malay common-word meaning. [Source](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/danvers)

senses.en_definition: Deadshot, the alias of Floyd Lawton, a fictional DC marksman and assassin.
senses.ms_definition: Nama samaran Floyd Lawton, watak fiksyen DC yang merupakan penembak sangat tepat dan pembunuh upahan.
senses.nuances: 专名应写作 Deadshot，保留输入的小写形式仅为词条索引。此义由 [DC 官方人物介绍](https://www.dc.com/characters/deadshot)确认；尚未核实其为 DBP 正式马来语词头，因此不标为 official。马来语释义与例句为本条编写。下列为自然的专名组合，未经语料频率验证。

senses.zh_definition: 神枪手；射击极准的人。此为相关英语表达 dead shot 的普通名词义。
senses.en_definition: An exceptionally accurate marksman; the ordinary English expression is dead shot.
senses.ms_definition: Orang yang sangat mahir menembak dan amat tepat bidikannya; padanan bahasa Melayu ialah penembak tepat.
senses.nuances: 此义用于说明英语背景，不证明连写的 deadshot 已成为马来语普通名词。英语通常分写为 dead shot；正式马来语可用 penembak tepat。参见 [Webster 英语词典的 dead shot 释义](https://www.gutenberg.org/cache/epub/662/pg662-images.html)。下列组合保留英语表达，并非已核实的马来语高频搭配。

etymology.historical_story: English dead shot describes an exceptionally accurate marksman, with dead conveying certainty or precision. DC's character Deadshot turns that association into a memorable alias for Floyd Lawton, whose defining skill is extraordinary aim. DC records his first appearance in Batman #59 in 1950. This history concerns English and popular culture, not an established Malay derivation. [DC character history](https://www.dc.com/characters/deadshot); [Webster: dead shot](https://www.gutenberg.org/cache/epub/662/pg662-images.html).

senses.zh_definition: 被修改、调整、改装或翻修，使其适合特定需要、用途或条件；是 mengubah suai 的被动形式。
senses.en_definition: To be modified, adapted or renovated to suit particular needs, uses or conditions.
senses.ms_definition: Dibuat perubahan pada sesuatu supaya sesuai dengan keadaan, keperluan atau kegunaan tertentu; bentuk pasif bagi mengubah suai.
senses.nuances: 用于房屋时常译“被翻修、改建”，用于车辆或设备时常译“被改装”，用于文本或方法时常译“被改编、调整”。di- 表示被动态，不表示过去时；telah、sedang、akan 分别补充完成、进行或将来的时间意义。马来文释义依据 DBP 的主动词释义改写为被动态。[DBP《ubah suai》](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=ubah+suai)

etymology.historical_story: The expression combines ubah, 'change', with suai, associated with suitability. Its passive prefix places the altered object at the centre of attention. The spelling preserves the compound's two parts: diubah suai remains separated, while pengubahsuaian joins them when a prefix and suffix surround the compound. This pattern makes Malay word formation visible in everyday renovation vocabulary. [DBP compound and derivative forms](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=ubah+suai)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: ubah＝改，suai 联想 sesuai＝合适，di-＝被：diubah suai 就是“被改得更合用”。记住中间留空格。

senses.zh_definition: 被出版、刊登或发布，供公众阅读或获取；用于书籍、文章、报告等内容。
senses.en_definition: To be published or made publicly available, especially as a book, article, or report.
senses.ms_definition: Dikeluarkan untuk bacaan atau rujukan orang ramai dalam bentuk penerbitan bercetak atau digital.
senses.nuances: 最常见义。被动结构突出出版物；出版者可由 oleh 引出。该词本身不表示过去时：akan diterbitkan 是“将出版”。出版与印刷不同，同一著作可以出版一次而重印多次。马来语释义为编写性释义，依据 [DBP 出版指南](https://dbp.gov.my/panduan-penyerahan-manuskrip-ke-dewan-bahasa-dan-pustaka/)，并非官方逐字引文。

senses.zh_definition: 被制作成影视、广播或其他视听作品。
senses.en_definition: To be produced as a film, broadcast programme, or other audiovisual work.
senses.ms_definition: Dihasilkan sebagai karya filem, rancangan penyiaran atau bahan audiovisual.
senses.nuances: 用于制作环节；“被制作”不自动等于“已上映”或“已播出”，后两者通常分别用 ditayangkan、disiarkan。此用法见 [DBP《Rampak Serantau》](https://dbp.gov.my/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/Rampak-Serantau-2021.pdf)。马来语释义为编写性释义。

senses.zh_definition: 证券、股票或债券等被发行。
senses.en_definition: To be issued, especially of shares, bonds, or other securities.
senses.ms_definition: Dikeluarkan sebagai saham, bon atau sekuriti lain oleh sesuatu penerbit.
senses.nuances: 金融专业用法；此处不能译成“出版”。仅表示发行，不必然表示已上市或已由投资者认购。参见 [马来西亚证券监督委员会年度报告](https://www.sc.com.my/bm/api/documentms/download.ashx?id=c9d95243-c7e1-4451-baa2-59a9edf57298)。马来语释义为编写性释义。

senses.zh_definition: 被产生、引发或形成；可指能量、声音、情绪、后果，也可用于语言形式的派生。
senses.en_definition: To be generated, brought about, or derived, as energy, sound, a feeling, an effect, or a linguistic form.
senses.ms_definition: Dihasilkan, dibangkitkan atau diwujudkan oleh sesuatu punca atau proses.
senses.nuances: 这是使动义的被动形式，语体通常较书面；日常表达常改用 dihasilkan、ditimbulkan 或 disebabkan。词根条目另记录 menerbitkan 的旧式“拿出钱款”用法，但不宜据此创造现代常用搭配。语义依据 [DBP：terbit](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1/cari1/Cari1/Cari1?d=74812&keyword=terbit)；语言学中的派生用法参见 [DBP：kata terbitan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kata+terbitan)。马来语释义为编写性释义。

etymology.historical_story: The underlying Malay word terbit connects emergence with publication: the sun appears, a feeling arises, and a book comes out. Diterbitkan places the resulting work or effect at the centre of the sentence. This is a semantic explanation, not a dated origin claim. The meanings are documented in [DBP’s terbit entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1/cari1/Cari1/Cari1?d=74812&keyword=terbit).

senses.zh_definition: 候选义：道；中国哲学中关于万物根源、自然运行及人生道路的概念，在道家思想中尤为重要。
senses.en_definition: Candidate sense: the Dao, the fundamental Way or underlying principle of existence, especially in Daoist philosophy.
senses.ms_definition: Takrif editorial bagi makna calon: konsep Dao dalam falsafah Cina yang merujuk kepada dasar kewujudan dan perjalanan alam serta kehidupan.
senses.nuances: 此义有马来文学术文献依据，通常写作 Dao；但输入没有上下文，无法确认目标 dao 就是该术语，也无法据此标为 official。以下搭配和例句仅适用于此候选义，马来文释义为编辑释义，并非 DBP 官方定义。[UKM：Laozi atau Daodejing (Bahagian Dao)](https://www.ukm.my/terjemah/images/terjemah/makalah/Jilid4-Bil1-Dis12-05.pdf)。

A Malay translation published by Universiti Kebangsaan Malaysia in 2012 retains Dao while discussing Laozi and Daoist thought. morphology.formula: dijangka + -kan → dijangkakan；完整构形：di- + jangka + -kan → dijangkakan
morphology.pattern_note: 按数据包保留 dijangka 为分析基形；严格意义上的词根是 jangka。相对 dijangka，新增后缀 -kan；完整词形是 menjangkakan 的被动形式。词根音段不变，词根末尾的 ka 与后缀 kan 分属两个音节。

senses.zh_definition: 被预料；被预计；根据判断、迹象或资料推测某事将发生或呈现某种结果。
senses.en_definition: To be expected, anticipated, or predicted to happen or have a particular outcome.
senses.ms_definition: Diduga atau disangka akan berlaku atau menghasilkan sesuatu; bentuk pasif bagi menjangkakan.
senses.nuances: 表达预期而非保证，常见于 dijangkakan akan…、seperti yang dijangkakan 和 tidak dijangkakan。日常交流也常使用较短的 dijangka；两者在表示预期时通常意义接近。马来文释义为依据词典整理的被动式释义，并非逐字引文。[DBP：menjangka／menjangkakan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=menjangka)。

senses.zh_definition: 被估定时间、期限或数量；根据计划或估算确定某事预计所需的时间或规模。
senses.en_definition: To be estimated or projected with respect to timing, duration, or amount.
senses.ms_definition: Dianggarkan atau ditentukan waktu, tempoh atau ukurannya berdasarkan perancangan atau perkiraan.
senses.nuances: 侧重计划与估算，例如工程何时竣工或所需开支；实际结果仍可能改变。与第一义相关，区别在于此义突出可估算的时间或数量。[DBP：menjangka／menjangkakan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=menjangka)。

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries record jangka in the vocabulary of time and planning, alongside menjangka, menjangkakan, and jangkaan. Dijangkakan belongs to this family and presents an expectation in the passive voice. Its place in forecasts and project reports illustrates how Malay uses affixes to express perspective. This is a morphological account, rather than a claim about the root's ultimate origin. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=jangka)。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住中间的 jangka：想到 jangka masa（期限），再想到“事先估计”；di- 提示被动，因此 dijangkakan 就是“被预计”。

senses.zh_definition: 人、职责或需要未得到应有的关注、照顾或履行；被忽视，被疏于照料。
senses.en_definition: To be neglected or receive insufficient attention or care.
senses.ms_definition: Tidak diberi perhatian atau penjagaan yang sewajarnya; dicuaikan atau dilalaikan.
senses.nuances: 强调应尽的照顾或责任没有落实，未必出于故意。属于 mengabaikan 的被动形式；马来语释义依据 DBP 义项改写，并非官方原文引述。参见 [DBP：mengabaikan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=mengabaikan)。

senses.zh_definition: 意见、劝告、警告或信息未被理会或认真考虑；被置之不理。
senses.en_definition: To be ignored, disregarded, or treated as unimportant.
senses.ms_definition: Tidak diendahkan atau dianggap tidak penting.
senses.nuances: 常用于劝告、警告和投诉；可表达有意不理会，也可表达未受重视。具体意图须看上下文。义项依据 [DBP：mengabaikan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=mengabaikan)。

senses.en_definition: To be left unused or allowed to go to waste, especially an opportunity.

senses.nuances: 强调未加利用；用于 peluang 时不必然表示当事人没有注意到机会。义项依据 [DBP：mengabaikan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=mengabaikan)。

etymology.historical_story: The key to diabaikan is its Malay construction: abai supplies the lexical base, -kan forms the transitive stem, and di- marks the passive. The same family covers neglected duties, disregarded advice, and unused opportunities. No deeper historical origin is established here; the memorable connection is how one familiar base supports several related meanings. [DBP: mengabaikan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=mengabaikan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 di-，先想“被”；认出 abai“忽视”：di- + abai + -kan → 被忽视。

etymology.historical_story: Devereaux is recorded as a variant of Devereux, a Norman habitational surname associated with Évreux in France. Such names originally linked a person to a place; later generations could inherit the surname without living there. For Malay readers, that geographical history explains the name's background, while the modern form remains an intact foreign proper name. [Devereaux](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/devereaux?geo-lang=en), [Devereux](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/devereux?geo-lang=en-US)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把Devereaux当作完整姓名标签记住，并联想到其相关拼写Devereux；不要按马来语词缀拆读，发音跟随本人。

senses.zh_definition: 账户、资产等被限制使用或处置；资金流动被暂停。

etymology.historical_story: Dibekukan is a transparent Malay formation from beku, with causative -kan and passive di-. Its dictionary meanings link physical solidification with stopping an activity: movement ceases when something freezes. [DBP records both uses](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=membekukan). This offers a useful semantic bridge between food preparation and administrative language, without implying a documented date for the metaphor's emergence.

etymology.historical_story: Tamat belongs to Malay's Arabic-derived vocabulary and is associated with Arabic tammat, expressing completion. Malay then applies its own morphology: -kan forms a verb meaning to bring something to an end, while di- presents it passively. The modern word thus combines a borrowed base with productive Malay grammatical structure. [Arabic–Malay borrowing study](https://journals.iium.edu.my/arabiclang/index.php/jlls/article/download/403/207/905)

etymology.historical_story: Dipadam is a transparent Malay formation: passive di- attaches to padam. Its dictionary meanings connect extinguished flames with disappearing marks and fading feelings. Modern file deletion extends that familiar idea into computing: something previously visible or available is removed. This is a semantic connection, rather than evidence for a particular ancient origin of padam. Sources: [PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=15740&keyword=padam), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=padam).

etymology.historical_story: Dihubungkan is transparently formed from hubung using Malay passive di- and verbal -kan. The dictionary records connections between objects, places, ideas and people within this word family. A useful cultural image is a bridge joining communities: the same grammatical form can describe physical infrastructure or people being brought into contact. See [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=hubung).

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 人名首字母应大写。区分现代同名人物与宗教人物；不能仅因某人名叫 Daud，就给他加上 Nabi 这一称号。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 称呼现代人物时，根据关系使用 Encik Daud、先生本人认可的职衔或姓名；提及先知时，马来穆斯林语境常用 Nabi Daud a.s.。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 人名首字母应大写。区分现代同名人物与宗教人物；不能仅因某人名叫 Daud，就给他加上 Nabi 这一称号。

etymology.historical_story: Daud belongs to the religious naming tradition familiar to Malay speakers. DBP identifies Nabi Daud as a prophet associated with the Zabur, while also documenting Daud in the names of Malay-world scholars. These associations explain its cultural familiarity; they do not establish a separate everyday meaning for lowercase daud. Sources: [DBP: Zabur](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=zabur), [DBP: Syeikh Daud](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=syeikh).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Daud 的 da.ud 两拍与人名“大卫／达乌德”配对记忆；这是姓名联想，不是普通词义或构词分析。

senses.zh_definition: 英语词：支配、控制他者或占据主导地位的人或事物。

senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, orang atau sesuatu yang menguasai pihak lain atau mempunyai kedudukan yang dominan.

etymology.historical_story: The English noun dominator belongs to the family of dominate. That verb traces to Latin dominari, meaning to rule or govern, from dominus, a master or owner. The connection explains the central idea of control. It does not establish when, or whether, dominator became an accepted Malay borrowing. [Merriam-Webster word history](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/dominator)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 用英语词族联想：dominate＝支配，dominator＝实施支配的人或事物；不要把它当作马来语词缀练习。

morphology.formula: di + situ + -lah → di situlah；输入连写形式：disitulah
morphology.pattern_note: root_word 保留输入包的 disitu，但规范基础短语为 di situ。di 是分写的处所介词；-lah 是附着于 situ 的强调小品词，并非派生后缀，因此 affix_type 标为 none。规范拼写为 di situlah。

word_family.gloss: 就是那里；具体功能依句法而定

senses.zh_definition: 就在那个地方；强调前文提到或双方已经明确的地点。规范写作 di situlah。
senses.en_definition: Right there; at that very place, with emphasis on the location.
senses.ms_definition: Di tempat yang dirujuk itu, dengan penegasan pada tempat tersebut; bentuk bakunya ialah di situlah.
senses.nuances: 这里的 adverb 表示整个短语作处所状语的功能；di situlah 在结构上是介词短语。不能将 di 当作被动前缀，也不能把 -lah 一律译为“啦”。规范拼写依据：[DBP 马来语拼写指南](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ejaan.pdf)；小品词性质依据：[DBP：partikel](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=partikel)。

collocations.en: that is exactly where it belongs

senses.zh_definition: 问题、关键、差别等恰恰就在所述之处；把空间指向引申为论述中的焦点。
senses.en_definition: At precisely that point in an argument or situation; used to identify where an issue or distinction lies.
senses.ms_definition: Pada perkara atau keadaan yang disebut itulah terletaknya sesuatu masalah, perbezaan atau kepentingan.
senses.nuances: 这是处所表达的抽象用法，并非任何情况下都等于“因此”。翻译时可用“关键就在这里”或“问题恰恰在于这一点”，须保留实际指向。

that is where the difference lies

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 这里的 -lah 主要强调地点，本身不表示不耐烦或不礼貌；语气仍取决于上下文和说话方式。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 作文、公文及教学材料应写 di situlah。给陌生人指路时，配合明确地标比只说 di situlah 更容易理解。

etymology.historical_story: This expression combines the Malay locative preposition di, the place word situ, and the emphatic particle -lah. Its spelling makes the grammatical relationships visible: di remains separate, while -lah attaches to situ. A run-together corpus spelling therefore needs normalization, not a newly invented root or a separate historical origin. References: [DBP spelling guidelines](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ejaan.pdf), [DBP on particles](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=partikel).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“两块”：di｜situlah。di 留空格，lah 紧跟 situ；意思是“就是在那里”。

morphology.formula: di- + lucut + -kan → dilucutkan；主动式melucutkan → 被动式dilucutkan
morphology.pattern_note: 实际词根是lucut。root_word依要求保留输入解析值dilucutkan，但该值不代表语言学词根；输入is_root=true已纠正。di-标示被动，-kan保留于动词基底，拼写连写且词根声母l不变；两部分功能不同。

word_family.gloss: 脱离、除去等意义的词根

senses.zh_definition: 被撤销或被剥夺职务、权力、资格、国籍等；也指某人被解除有关职务或身份。
senses.en_definition: To be revoked or withdrawn, or to be stripped of an office, power, status, or entitlement.
senses.ms_definition: Ditarik balik atau dibatalkan, seperti jawatan, kuasa atau kerakyatan; disingkirkan daripada sesuatu jawatan.
senses.nuances: 是melucutkan的被动形式，常见于行政或新闻语体。可说jawatan itu dilucutkan，也可说pegawai itu dilucutkan jawatan。词形本身不标示过去时；是否已发生由telah、sudah或上下文确定。释义据[DBP的lucut词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=lucut)编写。

senses.zh_definition: 衣物、饰物等被脱下或取下；绳索、束缚等被解开或解除。
senses.en_definition: To be taken off or removed, as clothing or jewelry, or to be released, as a fastening or restraint.
senses.ms_definition: Ditanggalkan atau dikeluarkan, seperti pakaian dan perhiasan; dilepaskan, seperti tali dan ikatan.
senses.nuances: 这是具体的移除义。应区分动作对象与承受者：pakaian dilucutkan强调衣物被脱下；描述某人被脱去衣物时，常用orang itu dilucuti pakaiannya。不能把所有“拆除”都直接换成此词。参见[DBP的lucut词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=lucut)。

etymology.historical_story: The lucut family links physical removal with the withdrawal of status. A ring can be slipped off a finger, while a position or citizenship can be taken away institutionally. This connection is documented in Malay dictionary definitions. Dilucutkan uses passive di- with the -kan verb base, presenting the removal from the affected side. [DBP reference](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=lucut)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把lucut记成“卸下”：卸下戒指，也能卸下职务。前面di-提示“被”，dilucutkan就是“被卸下、被撤掉”。

morphology.pattern_note: di- 构成被动动词，词根起首 p 保留；主动式 meN- + pimpin → memimpin 则发生鼻音替换。di- 与词根连写。headword.jawi 按数据包保留，但所供 ڤيمڤين 实为 pimpin；完整 dipimpin 应写作 ديڤيمڤين。

etymology.historical_story: DBP records pimpin in both physical and social settings: leading someone by the hand, directing an organization, and training someone towards independence. These meanings offer a useful cultural image of leadership as guidance. Dipimpin adds the productive Malay passive prefix di-, placing the person or group receiving that guidance at the centre of the sentence. Source: [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=pimpin).

etymology.historical_story: Disedut is formed within Malay from sedut and the passive prefix di-. The same root connects breathing, drinking through a straw, and mechanical suction through a shared inward movement. Dictionary usage also extends that image to extracting passages or draining money. etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries connect rantai with both physical chains and figurative bonds. The derived verb merantai consequently covers fastening with a chain and restricting freedom. Adding the productive passive prefix di- yields dirantai. This literal-to-figurative connection lets the same form describe a secured bicycle or a person constrained by circumstances. [Dictionary evidence](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=rantai+1)

etymology.historical_story: Dunia is an Arabic loanword, related to dunyā, meaning the world or earthly life. Malay combines this borrowed noun with its own pronoun clitic -ku to create duniaku. The expression brings a world-sized idea into a personal frame: the speaker’s life, surroundings, or emotional universe. See [University of Malaya: Arabic loan nouns](https://ejournal.um.edu.my/index.php/JIS/article/download/22518/11208/48729).

etymology.historical_story: Dadar connects two familiar preparations through their thin cooked layers. In kuih dadar, a flour-and-egg wrapper encloses a usually coconut-based filling; in telur dadar, beaten egg becomes the thin layer itself. The supplied dictionary entry documents this culinary pairing but establishes neither a particular inventor nor an ultimate donor language for the word.

etymology.historical_story: Donnelly is an English form of the Irish surname Ó Donnghaile, indicating descent from a person called Donnghal. Woulfe's surname dictionary connects a prominent family bearing the name with Ulster and the O'Neills. This history explains the surname's background, but it cannot identify an unspecified modern bearer or establish that person's ancestry. [Woulfe: Ó Donnghaile](https://libraryireland.booksulster.com/names/od/o-donnghaile.php)

morphology.pattern_note: di- 标记被动语态，-i 保留于派生动词；词根 hantu 不变，/u.i/ 可分读。按给定字段归入 circumfix，严格说是被动前缀 di- 与后缀 -i 的组合。headword.jawi 按要求保留资料包的 هنتو，但该形式只拼写词根 hantu，并非完整 dihantui；不得视作完整词形的已核实爪夷文。

etymology.historical_story: Dihantui is built transparently from hantu, the Malay word for a ghost or frightening supernatural being. The related verb menghantui shifts that unsettling image into mental experience: memories and fears can disturb someone as if an unwelcome presence kept returning. The passive prefix di- places the affected person or mind in focus, while the suffix -i remains attached. [DBP: hantu](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=hantu)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: hantu 是“鬼”；di- 表示“被”。把 dihantui 想成“被回忆像鬼影一样缠住”，就能记住“被反复困扰”。

etymology.historical_story: Dino shows how a long scientific animal name can become a short, friendly label in public communication. Malaysia's National Science Centre has used pameran dino on a Malay exhibition webpage. This supports a local promotional use linked to dinosaur, but it does not establish when the shortening entered Malay or whether it arrived directly through English.

etymology.historical_story: Godam names a large hammer, while menggodam covers both forceful striking and unauthorized entry into computer systems. The connection makes digital intrusion imaginable as breaking through a barrier. Digodam adds the passive prefix di-, placing the affected account, website, or physical object at the centre of the sentence. This explains the recorded meanings without claiming a particular inventor or date for the computing usage. [PRPM: godam](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=godam).

etymology.historical_story: Diangkat is formed within Malay from the passive prefix di- and angkat. The root links physical lifting with carrying, appointment, and adoption. Literary reporting also uses the passive for stories brought to the stage or screen. These related uses offer a useful semantic bridge from physical movement to social elevation and creative adaptation. Sources: [DBP dictionary](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=angkat) and [usage records](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=diangkat).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: angkat＝抬起；di-＝承受动作：箱子“被抬起”，人物“被抬到某个职位”，故事“被搬上银幕”。

etymology.historical_story: Dipersilakan grows from the courteous invitation word sila through Malay passive morphology. Its cultural force is easy to hear when an emcee invites guests to sit or a host welcomes someone inside. DBP lists this invitation word separately from sila meaning cross-legged sitting and sila referring to moral conduct; identical spelling alone does not establish a shared origin.

etymology.historical_story: Denyut takes a bodily movement as its central image: the recurring expansion and contraction felt in a pulse or heartbeat. Malay also uses it for electrical pulses, linking a familiar physical rhythm with technical description. Its derivatives keep the image visible: berdenyut describes pulsating, while denyutan names the pulsation or an individual beat.

etymology.historical_story: Malay pantun often places benci beside kasih, contrasting dislike with affection in the language of relationships. That cultural pairing helps explain its emotional force. Dibenci is the regular passive formation of benci, shifting attention from the person feeling hatred to its target. This explains its modern structure without claiming an undocumented ancient borrowing.

etymology.historical_story: Gugur evokes something falling away, as leaves or fruit do. Its derived forms also cover removal from teams, texts, and continuing proceedings. This shared image offers a useful cultural and conceptual connection: something no longer remains in place. It is a memory framework, rather than a claim about the historical order in which these meanings developed.

etymology.historical_story: The root timbang connects weighing objects with weighing alternatives. DBP records both the physical and reflective meanings, making the image of a balance useful for understanding consideration. Dipertimbangkan places the proposal or application in the passive position: it receives that evaluation. This is a semantic connection, not a claim about when the figurative meaning first arose. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=timbang).

etymology.historical_story: Dorong provides a physical image for an abstract experience: movement produced by an outside force. DBP records both pushing something forward and influencing someone to act. The family extends that connection through dorongan, encouragement or impetus, and pendorong, a motivating person or factor. This explains the recorded meaning network without assigning an unsupported ancient origin. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=dorong).

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 中性商业用语，适用于供应商沟通、贸易报道和工作汇报。熟人聊天中，若不需强调商业属性，常直接说 barang 或 stok。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 商品语境译为“货物／商品”，财经语境译为“交易”。不要把所有 dagangan 都解释为肩挑物，也不要将指人的表达机械理解为正常商品交易。

etymology.historical_story: The dagang word family connects commerce with travel: Malay dictionaries record meanings involving outsiders, wandering and buying and selling. Dagangan names the merchandise, while perdagangan names commerce. A separate Minangkabau-marked dagang family concerns carrying loads. The packet preserves that narrower load sense, but modern learners also need the widely used commercial meanings.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: dagang 是经商，dagang + -an → dagangan：做买卖所涉及的“货物”，也可指“交易”。

英语同族名词：分歧；发散

senses.zh_definition: 向不同方向分开或延伸的；呈发散状的。
senses.en_definition: Extending or moving apart in different directions.
senses.ms_definition: Bergerak atau menghala ke arah yang berlainan sehingga semakin berjauhan; mencapah.
senses.nuances: 这是英语形容词。DBP 将其列在英马词典中，并按语境提供 capah、menyimpang、berbeza 等对应词；这不等于确认 divergent 是标准马来语词形。以下 ms_definition 为马来语释义，搭配给出马来语对应表达。[DBP 英马词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?d=175768&keyword=divergent)

senses.zh_definition: 在观点、利益或发展方向上存在明显差异的；有分歧的。
senses.en_definition: Differing substantially in opinion, character, interest, or direction.
senses.ms_definition: Berbeza antara satu sama lain dari segi pendapat, kepentingan atau arah perkembangan.
senses.nuances: 强调彼此之间的差异，不必然表示敌对。教育语境中的 divergent thinking 通常对应 pemikiran bercapah，指探索多种可能答案的思考方式。[DBP 英马词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?d=175768&keyword=divergent)

senses.zh_definition: 偏离某一既定方向、标准或常态的。
senses.en_definition: Departing from an established course, standard, or norm.
senses.ms_definition: Menyimpang daripada arah, piawai atau kebiasaan tertentu.
senses.nuances: 这一义项需要一个作为参照的方向或标准；用于行为时可能带评价色彩，不能一概理解为中性的多样性。[DBP 英马词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?d=175768&keyword=divergent)

collocations.ms: laluan yang menyimpang daripada laluan asal
collocations.en: a path divergent from the original route

senses.zh_definition: 数学上不收敛于有限极限的；就无穷级数而言，指其部分和序列不收敛的。
senses.en_definition: Not converging to a finite limit; of a series, having partial sums that do not converge.
senses.ms_definition: Tidak menumpu kepada suatu had terhingga; bagi siri, jumlah separanya tidak menumpu.
senses.nuances: 数学对应词为 mencapah。发散可以表现为无界增长或振荡，并非一定趋向正无穷。[马来西亚理科大学双语微积分试卷](https://eprints.usm.my/44525/1/MAT201%20-%20Advanced%20Calculus%20January%202019.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: English divergent comes from a Latin participial form associated with divergere, meaning to move in different directions. Its early spatial image was separation from a common point. Later uses extended that image to opinions and departures from a standard. Malay dictionaries translate these relationships according to context rather than treating every occurrence as one fixed Malay word. [Etymology](https://www.etymonline.com/word/divergent)

etymology.historical_story: Dit elan is not the morphological division: the word is di- plus telan. Malay extends the bodily act of swallowing into images of money consumed, humiliation endured, and heritage disappearing. The familiar expression ditelan zaman pictures time as a devouring force, giving cultural preservation a vivid everyday metaphor.

etymology.historical_story: Defendan is the Malay adaptation of English defendant, a legal term whose older history leads through French to the idea of defending. Its meaning concerns a person's position in proceedings, rather than the outcome. That distinction provides a useful historical bridge between the everyday act of defending oneself and the specialized vocabulary of courts. [Etymology of defendant](https://www.etymonline.com/word/defendant).

etymology.historical_story: Dinyalakan is a transparent Malay formation rather than an independent historical root. Nyala names a flame; menyalakan makes something burn or shine, and dinyalakan presents that action from the receiving object's perspective. Dictionary examples extend this imagery to conflict and strong feeling. The expression therefore links an actual flame with the familiar image of emotions catching fire. See [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=273844&keyword=nyala).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: nyala 是“火光”，-kan 是“使它亮”，di- 把镜头转向承受动作的东西：灯被打开，蜡烛被点燃。

morphology.formula: disaat → pada + saat → pada saat（标准时间表达）
morphology.pattern_note: 输入包将 disaat 自动判为词根，不能据此确立其规范性。此处 di 不是构成被动动词的前缀；表示时间时，DBP 明确推荐 pada saat。无规范词头读音可据，故不补写 IPA。

senses.zh_definition: 非规范连写形式，通常意在表达“在……时刻”；马来西亚标准马来语应改用 pada saat。
senses.en_definition: A nonstandard joined spelling intended to mean “at the moment or time of”; standard Malaysian Malay uses pada saat.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk tidak baku yang biasanya dimaksudkan sebagai pada ketika atau pada waktu tertentu; bentuk yang disarankan ialah pada saat.
senses.nuances: 词性标签仅对应其意图表达的介词结构功能，不表示 disaat 是获认可的单词。仅拆成 di saat 仍未解决规范时间介词的选择。下列搭配均展示纠正后的形式，而非认可原拼写。DBP 对 disaat 与 di saat 的直接答复采用 pada saat。来源：[DBP：saat 用法咨询](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=saat)。

etymology.historical_story: This item illustrates an editorial problem rather than an established word origin. Writers may run a short grammatical element together with the following noun, producing disaat. However, Malaysian standard usage also requires the appropriate temporal preposition. DBP answers this exact spelling question by recommending pada saat, so separating the letters alone is insufficient.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 saat，先想到“时刻”：时间用 pada saat。把“时间”与 pada 绑定，不把 disaat 当成一个词背。

etymology.historical_story: Disney entered Malay usage as an international proper name rather than through Malay affixation. The company traces its beginning to a contract signed on 16 October 1923, when Walt and Roy Disney established their animation venture. Their surname became the name associated with the company's films, characters and entertainment businesses. [Disney company history](https://thewaltdisneycompany.com/news/disney100-anniversary-disney-contract/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Disney 就是熟悉的“迪士尼”：看到这个名字，联想电影和角色；首字母 D 要大写。

morphology.pattern_note: 省略元音字母及 ng 中的 n，形成短信缩写；朗读时还原为 datang，IPA 标示还原后的读音。is_root 与 root_word 保留输入记录的分析，不表示 dtg 是独立的马来语词根。

word_family.gloss: 到来；抵达，来自完整形式 datang
前往；到访，来自完整形式 datang

senses.zh_definition: datang 的短信及网络书写缩略形式，表示来、到来或抵达。
senses.en_definition: A messaging abbreviation of datang, meaning to come or arrive.
senses.ms_definition: Singkatan tulisan bagi datang, iaitu bergerak ke tempat yang dituju atau tiba di situ.
senses.nuances: 这是书写缩略形式，不是独立口语词。是否表示已经到达、打算来或正在来，须由 dah、nak、sedang 等成分及上下文确定；dtg 本身不等于“正在路上”。DBP 的短信指南列有 datang → dtg；official 在此仅表示有官方短信指南依据，不表示适合一般正式行文。[DBP《Panduan Singkatan Khidmat Pesanan Ringkas》](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/khidmatsms.pdf)

collocations.en: want to come; plan to come

dual_scenarios.context: 职场通知：正式行文还原完整形式
dual_scenarios.ms: Semua peserta diminta datang ke dewan sebelum pukul sembilan pagi.
dual_scenarios.zh: 请所有参与者在上午九点之前到礼堂。
dual_scenarios.en: All participants are requested to come to the hall before nine in the morning.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 朋友约见
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Kau nak dtg kat rumah aku petang ni?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah kamu mahu datang ke rumah saya petang ini?
dual_scenarios.zh: 你今天下午要来我家吗？
dual_scenarios.en: Do you want to come over to my place this afternoon?

nak 对应 mahu，ni 对应 ini。
kat 在此用于表达目的地，标准语改用 ke。
kau 和 aku 适用于关系熟悉的朋友。

messages.ms_spoken: Kau nak dtg kat rumah aku petang ni?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah kamu mahu datang ke rumah saya petang ini?
