cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 适合熟人短信和轻松群聊。联系客户、长辈或上级时，写完整的 datang，并按关系选择称呼。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 正式通知、公函和考试作文使用 datang。给陌生人发邀请时，Sila datang 或 Jemput datang 通常比单独写 dtg 更周到。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 适合熟人短信和轻松群聊。联系客户、长辈或上级时，写完整的 datang，并按关系选择称呼。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 正式通知、公函和考试作文使用 datang。给陌生人发邀请时，Sila datang 或 Jemput datang 通常比单独写 dtg 更周到。

etymology.historical_story: The form dtg belongs to abbreviated Malay writing rather than to a separate spoken vocabulary. DBP's 2008 SMS guide explicitly pairs datang with dtg, documenting its place in mobile communication. Readers recover the full word from context. Its history therefore illustrates how an established word acquires a compact written form without acquiring a new pronunciation. [DBP SMS guide](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/khidmatsms.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 dtg，就把完整的 datang“请回来”：字母缩短，意思仍是“来”。

morphology.formula: kalang II + -an → kalangan; di + kalangan → di kalangan; 表示群体范围时规范表达为 dalam kalangan
morphology.pattern_note: 修正输入中的词根判定：此处 di 是介词，不是被动前缀，不能与 kalangan 连写。kalang + -an 的 ng 保持 /ŋ/，不读成 /ŋɡ/；表示社会群体时，DBP 推荐 dalam kalangan。

word_family.gloss: kalangan 所属的词根条目；须区别表示垫物的同形词

senses.zh_definition: 在某一群体、阶层或圈子中；dikalangan 是非规范连写，规范表达通常为 dalam kalangan。
senses.en_definition: Among or within a particular group; a nonstandard joined spelling corresponding to di kalangan, for which dalam kalangan is preferred in standard usage.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk ejaan tidak baku bagi frasa di kalangan, yang merujuk lingkungan sesuatu golongan; bagi maksud ini, bentuk baku yang disarankan ialah dalam kalangan.
senses.nuances: 词性标签表示整个对应短语的介词功能，不表示 dikalangan 是规范单词。di kalangan 在实际使用中常见，但正式写作和考试宜用 dalam kalangan。下列搭配和例句采用规范表达。依据：[DBP 用法说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?d=175768&keyword=dikalangan)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Program ini bertujuan meningkatkan kesedaran tentang keselamatan siber dalam kalangan kakitangan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 这项计划旨在提高员工的网络安全意识。
dual_scenarios.en: This programme aims to raise cybersecurity awareness among staff members.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Dalam kalangan kawan kita, ramai dah guna aplikasi ni.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Dalam kalangan kawan kita, ramai yang sudah menggunakan aplikasi ini.
dual_scenarios.zh: 咱们朋友里，已经很多人在用这个应用了。
dual_scenarios.en: Lots of our friends are already using this app.
spoken_features: dah 是 sudah 的口语缩略形式。
ni 对应 ini；guna 在口语中代替 menggunakan。
规范对应句补出关系词 yang；口语自然表达不必保留错误连写。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dalam kalangan kawan kita, ramai dah guna aplikasi ni ke?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah ramai dalam kalangan kawan kita yang sudah menggunakan aplikasi ini?
messages.zh: 咱们朋友里，已经很多人在用这个应用了吗？
messages.en: Are lots of our friends using this app already?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Ya, ramai dah guna. Aku je yang belum cuba.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, ramai yang sudah menggunakannya. Saya sahaja yang belum mencubanya.
messages.zh: 对啊，很多人都用了。就我还没试。
messages.en: Yeah, loads of them are. I'm the only one who hasn't tried it yet.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 谈论群体时措辞应客观，避免把个别人的行为概括为整个族群、宗教群体或阶层的特点。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 正式报告、学校作业和考试使用 dalam kalangan。纠正朋友的 dikalangan 时可私下温和说明，避免在群聊中公开羞辱对方。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 谈论群体时措辞应客观，避免把个别人的行为概括为整个族群、宗教群体或阶层的特点。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 正式报告、学校作业和考试使用 dalam kalangan。纠正朋友的 dikalangan 时可私下温和说明，避免在群聊中公开羞辱对方。

etymology.historical_story: Kalangan connects the idea of a circle or enclosed area with that of a social circle. This relationship offers a useful cultural image: people belong within overlapping groups of friends, colleagues, and communities. Dikalangan is a spelling error rather than a separate historical word. DBP recommends dalam kalangan when referring to membership or activity within such groups.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kalangan 想成一个人际圈：人在圈子里面，所以用 dalam kalangan；di 要分开写，不能黏成 dikalangan。

morphology.pattern_note: di- 标示被动，-kan 构成及物动词；词根 bukti 不变。此处按给定分类将前后词缀组合归入 circumfix。词包把 dibuktikan 标为词根，已据实际构词修正。

senses.zh_definition: 某项说法、事实或判断被证据、论证或检验确立为真实或成立。
senses.en_definition: To be proved or established as true by evidence, reasoning or testing.
senses.ms_definition: Dinyatakan atau disahkan kebenarannya dengan mengemukakan bukti.
senses.nuances: 是 membuktikan 的被动形式，主语通常是待证明的事项。dibuktikan 本身不表示过去或完成；telah dibuktikan 表示已经证明，perlu dibuktikan 表示仍须证明。terbukti 更突出事实已显明的结果。释义据 [DBP：bukti](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=bukti) 的主动词义转为被动表述，并非独立词条的逐字引文。

senses.zh_definition: 能力、品质或承诺等通过行动或成果得到展现、印证。
senses.en_definition: To be demonstrated or borne out through actions or results.
senses.ms_definition: Diperlihatkan atau ditunjukkan melalui perbuatan, pencapaian atau hasil.
senses.nuances: 用于 keupayaan（能力）、keberanian（勇气）或 komitmen（承诺）时，强调实际表现，不一定涉及正式举证。此义由 [DBP：membuktikan 的 memperlihatkan 义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=bukti) 转述。

collocations.zh: 能力通过成绩得到证明
承诺通过行动得到体现

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Keberkesanan kaedah ini perlu dibuktikan melalui kajian yang lebih menyeluruh sebelum dilaksanakan secara meluas.
dual_scenarios.zh: 这项方法的有效性须通过更全面的研究加以证实，才可广泛推行。
dual_scenarios.en: The effectiveness of this method must be established through more comprehensive research before it is widely implemented.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Cerita tu belum dibuktikan lagi, jangan percaya dulu lah.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Cerita itu belum dibuktikan kebenarannya, jadi jangan mempercayainya dahulu.
dual_scenarios.zh: 那件事还没证实呢，先别信啦。
dual_scenarios.en: That story hasn't been verified yet, so don't believe it just yet.
spoken_features: tu 对应 itu。
belum...lagi 是日常口语中强调“尚未”的常见表达。
dulu 对应 dahulu。
句末 lah 在此缓和提醒语气，不必逐字翻译。

messages.speaker: Mei (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Cerita dalam grup tu dah dibuktikan ke?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah kebenaran cerita dalam kumpulan itu sudah dibuktikan?
messages.zh: 群里那件事已经证实了吗？
messages.en: Has that story in the group chat been verified?

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Belum lagi. Jangan kongsi dulu lah, kita semak sumber asal.
messages.ms_standard: Belum. Jangan kongsikannya dahulu; mari kita semak sumber asal.
messages.zh: 还没呢。先别转发啦，我们查一下原始来源。
messages.en: Not yet. Hold off on sharing it—let's check the original source.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 在会议中，Perkara ini perlu dibuktikan（此事仍须证明）比直接指责对方撒谎更克制，也更聚焦证据。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合研究、汇报、事实核查及日常求证。belum dibuktikan 仅表示“尚未证实”，不能自动理解为“已经证伪”。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 在会议中，Perkara ini perlu dibuktikan（此事仍须证明）比直接指责对方撒谎更克制，也更聚焦证据。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合研究、汇报、事实核查及日常求证。belum dibuktikan 仅表示“尚未证实”，不能自动理解为“已经证伪”。

etymology.historical_story: The useful story here is grammatical: Malay builds an evidence-related verb from bukti, then changes its voice. Membuktikan presents someone proving a claim; dibuktikan places the claim in the foreground. This contrast helps explain its usefulness in reports and academic writing, where the proposition under examination often matters more than the person presenting evidence.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: bukti＝证据；bukti + -kan＝证明；前加被动 di-，dibuktikan＝被证明。

headword.status_note: official 沿用所要求的词条状态标签，不表示 destiny 获认定为标准马来语词。此项是英语词条；标准马来语对应词为 nasib 或 takdir。

morphology.pattern_note: 作为英语整词学习，不按马来语词缀拆分；词首 de- 和词尾 -y 在此不作为马来语词缀。

word_family.gloss: 多个个体或群体的命运
注定的；预定要走向某种结果的

senses.zh_definition: 个人、群体或事物未来的命运或归宿，尤指被认为已注定的发展结果。
senses.en_definition: The future course or outcome of a person's or thing's life, especially one considered predetermined.
senses.ms_definition: Nasib atau perjalanan masa hadapan seseorang atau sesuatu, terutama yang dianggap telah ditentukan.
senses.nuances: 英语名词，此义可数，复数为 destinies。马来语依语境译为 nasib 或 takdir；这里的 ms_definition 是马来语释义，不是 destiny 作为马来语词的官方定义。参见 [DBP 英马词典：destiny](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?k=takdir) 与 [Cambridge：destiny](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/destiny)。

senses.zh_definition: 被认为超越个人控制、决定未来事件的命运力量或天命。
senses.en_definition: A power believed to determine future events beyond human control.
senses.ms_definition: Kuasa atau ketentuan yang dipercayai menentukan kejadian masa hadapan di luar kawalan manusia.
senses.nuances: 英语中此义通常不可数。马来语常译 takdir；在宗教语境中，takdir 可涉及神的安排，具体含义须尊重说话者信仰。参见 [DBP：destiny 与 takdir](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?k=takdir)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam teks bahasa Inggeris itu, perkataan "destiny" merujuk kepada nasib sesebuah negara pada masa hadapan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 在该英语文本中，destiny 一词指一个国家未来的命运。
dual_scenarios.en: In that English text, the word "destiny" refers to a nation's future fate.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Mungkin ni destiny kita, kan?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Mungkin inilah takdir kita, bukan?
dual_scenarios.zh: 也许这就是我们的缘分吧，对吗？
dual_scenarios.en: Maybe this is our destiny, right?
spoken_features: destiny 是嵌入马来语句子的英语词，属于语码混用。
ni 对应 ini。
kan 用于征求认同。
纯标准马来语在此使用 takdir。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kita dah tiga kali terserempak kat sini. Destiny kot!
messages.ms_standard: Kita sudah tiga kali terserempak di sini. Mungkin ini takdir!
messages.zh: 我们都在这儿偶遇三次了，可能真是缘分吧！
messages.en: We've bumped into each other here three times. Maybe it's destiny!

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Haha, mungkin kebetulan je. Kita kan selalu datang sini.
messages.ms_standard: Ha ha, mungkin ini hanya kebetulan. Bukankah kita selalu datang ke sini?
messages.zh: 哈哈，可能只是巧合啦，我们本来就常来这里嘛。
messages.en: Haha, maybe it's just a coincidence. We both come here all the time.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 熟悉的双语朋友之间可以混用 destiny；正式马来语写作应按语境选择 nasib、takdir 或 masa hadapan，讨论英语词本身时可加引号。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 朋友谈偶遇时可轻松表达“缘分”；面对丧失、疾病或挫折，直接说“这就是你的命”可能显得冷漠。不要把个人对天命的理解强加给不同信仰的人。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 熟悉的双语朋友之间可以混用 destiny；正式马来语写作应按语境选择 nasib、takdir 或 masa hadapan，讨论英语词本身时可加引号。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 朋友谈偶遇时可轻松表达“缘分”；面对丧失、疾病或挫折，直接说“这就是你的命”可能显得冷漠。不要把个人对天命的理解强加给不同信仰的人。

etymology.historical_story: English destiny came through Old French destinée, related to a verb meaning to destine, and ultimately Latin destinare, meaning to establish or determine. Its historical image is something already settled. That background connects its modern senses: a person's future course and the supposed power directing events. [Etymonline: destiny](https://www.etymonline.com/word/destiny).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 destiny 想成“人生将走向的归宿”：英语 destiny，马来语 nasib 或 takdir，中文“命运”。

morphology.pattern_note: di- 是被动前缀，与词根连写；ancam 的拼写不变，不发生 meN- 类鼻音变化。词包将整词标为词根，此处依据实际构词更正。

senses.zh_definition: 受到恐吓或威胁；有人扬言伤害当事人，或使其遭受损失。
senses.en_definition: To be threatened or intimidated with harm or adverse consequences.
senses.ms_definition: Dikenakan ugutan bahawa sesuatu yang membahayakan, menyusahkan atau merugikan akan dilakukan.
senses.nuances: 这是 mengancam 的被动形式，突出受威胁的一方。可用 oleh 引出威胁者，如 saksi diancam oleh suspek。规范书面语中，第一、第二人称施事通常采用 saya ancam、awak ancam 等结构。此处释义按被动形式转述，依据 [DBP：ancam](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=ancam)。

senses.zh_definition: 受到某种危险、灾害或不利因素的威胁；面临受损或毁灭的风险。
senses.en_definition: To be endangered or placed at risk by a harmful condition, event, or process.
senses.ms_definition: Diletakkan dalam keadaan menghadapi bahaya, kerosakan, kemusnahan atau kesusahan akibat sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 威胁来源可以是洪水、污染或其他非人为因素，不要求有人故意恐吓。diancam 强调受到某因素威胁；terancam 更直接描述危险状态。不要把 mengancam 在口语中表示“很吸引人”的用法机械套到 diancam。依据 [DBP：ancam](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=ancam)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Beberapa spesies hidupan liar di kawasan itu diancam kepupusan akibat kehilangan habitat.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该地区的数种野生动物因栖息地流失而面临灭绝威胁。
dual_scenarios.en: Several wildlife species in the area are threatened with extinction because of habitat loss.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Dia dah diancam dalam mesej tu, sebab tu dia takut nak keluar.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Dia sudah diancam melalui mesej itu; oleh sebab itu, dia takut untuk keluar.
dual_scenarios.zh: 他已经在那条信息里受到威胁了，所以不敢出门。
dual_scenarios.en: He was threatened in that message, so he's scared to go out.
spoken_features: dah 对应 sudah
tu 对应 itu
sebab tu 对应 oleh sebab itu
nak 对应 hendak 或表示意愿的 untuk 结构

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)

etymology.historical_story: Diancam belongs to the Malay ancam family rather than being an independent root. The passive prefix di- places the threatened person or thing in focus. DBP records both intimidation and exposure to danger under mengancam, explaining how the same family describes a threatened witness and a community endangered by a volcanic eruption. [Source: DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=ancam).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先认 di-＝“被”，再认 ancam＝“威胁”：diancam 就是“被威胁”。和主动式 mengancam 配对记。

senses.nuances: 表示算术加法，不是材料混合。数学教学中 ditambah 通常更明确。DBP 释义中可见 satu dicampur satu 一类结构，参见 [DBP 对 dua 的释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=jumlah+nya)。

etymology.historical_story: Dicampur is transparently formed from campur and the Malay passive prefix di-. Its everyday cultural setting includes drinks, cooking and the combining of ingredients, while arithmetic uses the same base for addition. Familiar expressions such as nasi campur make the underlying idea easy to recognize: separate things brought together, with the passive form foregrounding what receives the action.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: campur＝混合；di- 把视角转向接受动作的东西：sirap dicampur dengan air＝糖浆被兑入水中。

etymology.historical_story: Doyle is an anglicized form of the Irish surname Ó Dubhghaill, meaning a descendant of Dubhghall. The personal name contains elements meaning dark and foreigner. This history belongs to Irish naming traditions, not Malay word formation. Its appearance in Malay writing can simply reflect a person's name. [Source: Dictionary of American Family Names via Ancestry](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/doyle).

etymology.historical_story: English borrowed Dutch from Middle Dutch duutsc. Historically, its reference overlapped with broader Germanic peoples and languages before becoming associated chiefly with the Netherlands. That history explains its relationship to German deutsch, but modern Dutch and German name different languages. In standard Malay, the corresponding name is Belanda. [Source: Oxford English Dictionary](https://doi.org/10.1093/OED/6201645168).

etymology.historical_story: Diingini illustrates productive Malay word formation rather than a separate borrowing. The base ingin expresses wanting; mengingini presents someone as wanting something, while diingini presents that thing as wanted. In a phrase such as hasil yang diingini, this shift places the intended result at the centre of attention, making the form useful in planning and evaluation.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: ingin＝想要；di- 把视角转向对象：hadiah yang diingini＝被想要的礼物，也就是心仪的礼物。

etymology.historical_story: Dik comes from adik by dropping its initial vowel. The shortened form carries the familiarity of sibling address into conversations with other younger people. Malay speakers also use family terms beyond actual family relationships, so context determines whether dik identifies a sibling or simply makes an interaction sound warmer and more personal.

etymology.historical_story: This form illustrates Malay's productive word-building system rather than a separately borrowed word. The base sembuh describes recovery; the suffix -kan creates a causative meaning, and di- presents it in the passive voice. The word itself does not indicate that healing has already happened. See [DBP's sembuh entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=sembuh).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: sembuh＝康复；-kan＝使康复；di-＝被：合起来就是“被治好”。

morphology.pattern_note: di- 标记被动，-kan 构成相应及物形式；词根首音 /b/ 保留，不发生 meN- 的鼻音前缀变化。输入中的 بيمبڠ 是词根 bimbang 的 Jawi，本条完整词形补写为 دبيمبڠکن。此处 circumfix 按接口归类，实际包含被动前缀和后缀。

etymology.historical_story: The documented family around bimbang shows how Malay builds related perspectives through affixes. Bimbang names the feeling of worry, membimbangkan describes causing concern, and kebimbangan names the concern itself. Dibimbangkan supplies a passive perspective, placing the feared matter in focus. This account explains the transparent formation; it makes no unsupported claim about the root's prehistoric origin. [DBP: bimbang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=15740&keyword=bimbang)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: bimbang 是担心；看到 di-，把镜头转向“被担心的事”：perkara yang dibimbangkan＝心里一直挂着的那件事。

morphology.formula: di- + nilai → dinilai（被评估；被估价）
morphology.pattern_note: 修正材料中的整词误判：dinilai 是 nilai 加被动前缀 di-，不是词根。前缀与词干连写，不发生鼻音同化；末尾 -ai 属于词干，不是后缀。被动形式本身不表示过去时。

word_family.gloss: 可估量价值的，常见于否定结构

senses.zh_definition: 被考察、评定或评价其质量、表现、适合程度或重要性。
senses.en_definition: To be assessed or evaluated for quality, performance, suitability, or significance.
senses.ms_definition: Ditaksir atau dipertimbangkan mutu, prestasi, kesesuaian atau kepentingannya berdasarkan ukuran tertentu.
senses.nuances: 这是 menilai 的被动形式，主语是受到评估的人或事物。dinilai 不等于“获得好评”，也不表示评估已完成；时间和阶段由 akan、sedang、telah 等表达。正式马来语中，第三人称施事可用 oleh 引出。马来语释义为依据 DBP 所列义项作出的被动形式释义。[DBP：menilai](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=7120&keyword=menilai)

senses.zh_definition: 被估定价格或价值；被衡量其经济价值或抽象价值。

senses.nuances: 常见于房产、资产和物品估价。dinilai pada RM... 表示估价金额，未必是成交价。否定表达 tidak dapat dinilai dengan wang 还可表示某事的价值无法用金钱衡量。[DBP：menilai](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=7120&keyword=menilai)

senses.zh_definition: 数学表达式的数值被求出或确定。
senses.en_definition: Of a mathematical expression, to have its numerical value determined.
senses.ms_definition: Ditentukan nilai berangkanya dalam pengiraan atau penyelesaian masalah matematik.
senses.nuances: 这是数学术语用法，指确定表达式的值，不是给答案评分。释义由 DBP 数学词汇中 menilai 的术语义转换为被动表达。[DBP：数学术语 menilai](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=7120&keyword=menilai)

etymology.historical_story: The useful story here is grammatical rather than a speculative account of ancient borrowing. DBP connects nilai with menilai, bernilai, and penilaian. Dinilai belongs to that family: di- presents something as receiving an assessment. The same formation works for a house, an employee, or a mathematical expression, linking price, judgement, and numerical value through one familiar base. [DBP: nilai word family and menilai](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=7120&keyword=menilai)

etymology.historical_story: Dicat is formed within Malay by attaching the passive prefix di- to cat, meaning paint. Its connection with mengecat makes the change in viewpoint easy to see: a worker performs the painting, while a wall receives it. The formation remains transparent in present-day Malay, so no speculative story about the distant origin of cat is needed.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: cat 是漆；前面加 di-，镜头转向被刷的东西：dinding dicat＝墙被刷漆。

morphology.pattern_note: 原始数据误将本词标为词根；实际词根为 kosong。di- 表被动，-kan 表使成空的状态，词根首辅音 k 保留。此处 circumfix 是按给定字段归类，两个词缀的功能可以分别分析。音节与 IPA 为规则分析，非输入包原有资料；爪夷文未提供，保留 null。

senses.zh_definition: 被清空；里面的物品、内容或障碍物被移除。

senses.ms_definition: Dijadikan kosong dengan mengeluarkan isi atau menyingkirkan halangan.
senses.nuances: 强调外力造成的清空，不能直接等同于表示现状的 kosong。di- 本身不表示过去时；完成、将来或义务须由 telah、akan、hendaklah 等表达。释义依据词根及其派生词作编辑性归纳，并非 DBP 对本词的逐字独立释义。[DBP：kosong](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=kosong)。

senses.zh_definition: 建筑物、房间或区域被腾空；人员被安排离开。

etymology.historical_story: Malay regularly builds verbs from words describing states. Kosong names emptiness; mengosongkan describes causing that state, while dikosongkan presents the affected container, building, or position as the grammatical subject. This productive pattern connects everyday housekeeping with administrative language: a bin can be emptied, a room vacated, and an office left vacant.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 ko-song＝空：di- 表被动，-kan 表使成某状态；dikosongkan 就是“被弄空、被腾空”。

etymology.historical_story: This word belongs to the sembah family, whose vocabulary connects respectful communication, offerings, and public presentation. DBP records both deferential reporting to rulers and the presentation of entertainment. Modern dipersembahkan retains that range: a matter can be respectfully reported, while a song can be performed. Its di- prefix marks passive voice, not past tense. [Source: DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=mempersembahkan).

etymology.historical_story: Dusta is traced to Sanskrit duṣṭa, associated with badness or wrongdoing. Malay developed its familiar connection with falsehood, while modern derivatives distinguish lying, deceiving someone, and declaring something false. Its history therefore links an inherited moral evaluation with the practical vocabulary of truthfulness used in Malay today. [Source: Tom Hoogervorst, Indic origins of Malay legal terms](https://pure.knaw.nl/portal/files/1708896328/Legal_diglossia_lexical_borrowing_and_mixed_juridical_systems_in_early_Islamic_Java_and_Sumatra_24_11_19_14_19_08.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按 dus-ta 两拍记：“堵住真话，吐出假话”。这是声音联想，不是词源拆分；核心意思是“虚假、谎言、说谎”。

etymology.historical_story: The Austronesian Basic Vocabulary Database lists dama alongside nama and ngaran under the meaning name for Brunei Malay. This makes the word useful evidence of regional vocabulary diversity. The record supports its meaning and dialect association, but does not establish when it arose or the sound changes responsible. A more detailed origin story would therefore require additional historical evidence.

etymology.historical_story: Denver's name preserves a nineteenth-century political gesture. In 1858, William Larimer named the settlement after James W. Denver, hoping to gain favour with the Kansas territorial governor. Denver had already left that office, but the name endured. In Malay, it functions as a borrowed place name, without Malay affixes. See [VISIT DENVER: Early Denver History](https://visitdenver.com/about-denver/denver-history/early-denver-history/).

etymology.historical_story: Does belongs to the English verb do, whose history reaches back to Old English don. English later developed extensive auxiliary uses for this everyday action verb. The form does displaced older doth in standard usage. Its appearance in a Malay conversation may therefore be an English quotation or language switch, rather than evidence of Malay verb inflection. [Etymonline: do](https://www.etymonline.com/word/do)

senses.zh_definition: 被致伤；身体因他人的行为或其他外力而受到损伤。
senses.en_definition: To be injured or physically harmed by someone or something.
senses.ms_definition: Dibuat menjadi cedera, seperti mengalami luka atau patah tulang; bentuk pasif bagi mencederakan.
senses.nuances: 突出承受伤害的一方，常见于新闻、报告和叙述。被动形式本身不表示施害者一定出于故意，也不编码过去时；时间由 telah、sedang、akan 等成分或语境表达。若只需说明事故中有人受伤，cedera 或 tercedera 通常更自然。此处马来文释义根据主动词义改写，并非独立词条的逐字引文。依据：[DBP：cedera](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=206468&keyword=cedera)。

senses.ms_definition: Dikhianati; bentuk pasif bagi mencederakan dalam pengertian tidak setia atau mungkir janji.
senses.nuances: 属于 cedera 的旧义，主要用于旧文献或文学语境；当代日常表达通常用 dikhianati。以下搭配用于展示旧义，不代表现代高频搭配。依据：[DBP：cedera III](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=206468&keyword=cedera)。

senses.zh_definition: 遭暗算；被人以秘密行动或诡计袭击，乃至杀害。

senses.ms_definition: Diserang atau dibunuh secara diam-diam atau dengan tipu daya.
senses.nuances: 这是词典收录的旧义。现代新闻中通常按具体行为写成 diserang hendap、diserang secara sulit 或 dibunuh；不能仅凭现代句中的 dicederakan 推断受害者已经死亡。以下为旧义的说明性搭配。依据：[DBP：cedera III](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=206468&keyword=cedera)。

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries preserve several older meanings of cedera, including a defect, bodily injury, betrayal, and a treacherous attack. These meanings explain why an older narrative may require a different translation from a modern news report. Dicederakan combines this inherited vocabulary with productive Malay grammar: the injured participant becomes the sentence's focus through passive di- and causative -kan. [Source: DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=206468&keyword=cedera).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 di-，先找“谁承受动作”；看到 cedera，想到“受伤”；再加 -kan：被别人弄伤。

etymology.historical_story: The base perangkap names a device for catching animals, a concrete image that also supports the figurative sense of deception. Diperangkap adds the Malay passive prefix di-, placing the captured or deceived participant at the centre of the sentence. This explains the modern relationship between physical traps and conversational or social entrapment.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 perangkap＝陷阱，再把 di- 当作“被”：diperangkap＝被设局、被捕获。看到 di-pe-，不要误拆成 diper-。

etymology.historical_story: Dibangkitkan belongs to the Malay family centred on bangkit, meaning to rise, wake or come into activity. Its meanings connect physical upward movement with feelings coming alive and issues entering discussion. The passive prefix di- places the affected person or thing in focus, while -kan forms the corresponding transitive construction. Religious usage also preserves the sense of being raised from death. [DBP：bangkit](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=254640&keyword=bangkit)

etymology.historical_story: The spelling daley illustrates why context matters in lexicography. Capitalized Daley occurs as a personal name, while a Kelantan oral-history transcript independently records daley for standard Malay dalam. These are separate identification possibilities, not evidence of shared ancestry. Without the original corpus sentence, assigning either history to this particular frequency-list item would be premature. [UiTM transcript](https://ir.uitm.edu.my/98342/2/98342.pdf), [surname reference](https://surnames.behindthename.com/name/daley)

etymology.historical_story: Diesel takes its name from the engineer Rudolf Diesel, whose work produced a functioning engine in 1897. His surname became the name of an engine technology and subsequently of its fuel. The Malay dictionary preserves both meanings, connecting one inventor's name with everyday conversations about engines, transport and refuelling.

etymology.historical_story: The base adil belongs to Malay's Arabic-derived vocabulary of fairness and justice. Malay morphology makes that base productive: mengadili means to judge, while diadili places the person, case, or contest under judgment in subject position. Its uses connect courtroom decisions with sporting and artistic adjudication, although undergoing judgment does not itself imply guilt. See [UKM research on Arabic loanword spelling](https://ejournal.ukm.my/jmelayu/article/download/4969/2523).

senses.zh_definition: 被提醒、告诫或叮嘱，使注意某事、履行责任或避免危险。

etymology.historical_story: The root ingat connects remembering with being mindful and cautious. The traditional proverb ingat sebelum kena urges people to take care before trouble strikes. Diingatkan applies Malay passive morphology to this semantic core: someone receives a reminder or has a memory awakened. Its structure reflects ordinary Malay word formation rather than a separate borrowed origin. [DBP: ingat](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=273844&keyword=ingat)

etymology.historical_story: For the Northern Irish place name, Derry is associated with the Irish name Doire and the meaning oak grove. The city's visitor centre presents this origin through an oak-tree centrepiece. The name therefore offers a compact landscape memory: an urban destination whose name preserves an image of trees. This account concerns the place name, not every person named Derry. [Visit Derry](https://www.visitderry.com/blog/read/2021/09/visit-derry-visitor-information-centre-marks-its-first-birthday-b252)

etymology.historical_story: The word belongs to the Malay laku family, which connects action, conduct and validity. Dictionaries preserve an older use in which royal commands are carried out and wishes are granted. In the treatment sense, the passive construction places the affected person at the centre: the grammatical focus becomes what happens to someone. etymology.historical_story: Dicatat is transparently formed from catat with the Malay passive prefix di-. Its lexical story connects writing with public achievement: the supplied dictionary entry moves from making notes to achieving victories and making history. A result can therefore be dicatat because it is recorded or because it is achieved. This semantic link is more useful than inventing an unsupported ancient origin for catat.

etymology.historical_story: The family begins with sengat, the sharp, venomous apparatus of a stinging animal. Malay then shifts perspective through morphology: menyengat presents the animal's action, while disengat presents the experience of its victim. The same physical image extends to cutting remarks, making emotional hurt understandable through the familiar sensation of a sting.

etymology.historical_story: Draco illustrates how international scientific names travel into Malay texts without becoming ordinary Malay vocabulary. Astronomy uses the name for the Dragon constellation, while zoology uses it for a lizard genus represented in Malaysia. The shared spelling therefore requires context: a star chart and a biodiversity catalogue point to different referents.

etymology.historical_story: Digerakkan illustrates how Malay builds related meanings around gerak, movement. The active form menggerakkan can describe moving an object, activating an organisation or stirring someone's willingness to act; digerakkan presents the affected participant as the subject. This is a transparent grammatical formation, not a separate root or a special past-tense form. [DBP word family](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=gerak)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: gerak 是“动”，-kan 加上“使它动”，di- 把视角转向承受者：digerakkan＝“被使动、被推动、被动员”。

etymology.historical_story: Duncan is an English form of Gaelic Donnchadh. [Scottish National Dictionary](https://www.dsl.ac.uk/entry/snd/snds4738)

etymology.historical_story: Deanna belongs to English naming traditions rather than Malay word formation. It is associated with Diana or with the feminine use of Dean. Actress and singer Deanna Durbin helped popularize it. Its appearance in Malay texts therefore reflects people, personal identity and international cultural contact, rather than the creation of a new Malay common noun. [Name history](https://www.behindthename.com/name/deanna)

etymology.historical_story: Anugerah comes from Sanskrit, a linguistic legacy associated with the Malay world's earlier cultural contacts. Its meanings encompass valuable gifts, honours, and blessings, including divine gifts in later religious usage. Dianugerahkan adds Malay grammatical marking to that borrowed base, turning the idea of a valued gift into something formally bestowed. [DBP encyclopaedia](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=anugeraha).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先抓住 anugerah“奖赏、恩赐”，再看 di- 的“被”：dianugerahkan 就是“被授予、被赐予”。

etymology.historical_story: Dihadapi illustrates a productive Malay relationship between physical orientation and abstract experience. Hadap concerns the front or direction; menghadapi can mean facing a person, opponent, or difficulty. The passive form brings that person or difficulty into focus. This semantic connection explains the word without requiring a speculative ancient origin. See [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=hadap).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: hadap 是“面对”，di- 把镜头转向被面对的事：masalah dihadapi，就是“问题被面对／所面临的问题”。

etymology.historical_story: English diary comes from Latin diarium, connected with dies, meaning day. Its everyday association with dated personal records preserves that connection. Diaries is simply the English plural, not a Malay formation. Malay uses diari for the corresponding book or record, so an English plural ending should not be carried into an otherwise standard Malay sentence. See [Merriam-Webster: diary](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/diary) and [PRPM: diari](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=diari).

etymology.historical_story: Dubur is borrowed from Arabic dubr, meaning the back or rear. Malay uses the word for a specific anatomical opening, rather than the whole backside. This offers a memorable example of semantic narrowing: a broad spatial meaning becomes a precise body term. Its Arabic ancestry does not make its ordinary anatomical use religious. [Etymological reference](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/dubur).

etymology.historical_story: Darahmu is not a separate historical borrowing: it joins darah with the bound pronoun -mu, meaning your. Malay dictionaries connect blood with family descent, natural talent, and personal spirit as well as the bodily fluid. These figurative associations explain why the same form fits both a donation slogan and a poetic address. [DBP senses of darah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=259120&keyword=darah)

etymology.historical_story: The story of diberhentikan is visible in its layers: henti supplies stopping, berhenti names the act, and further morphology makes someone or something undergo it. The same family connects a roadside stop with the end of a job. This is a grammatical explanation, rather than a claim about an undocumented ancient origin. [DBP: henti](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=370084&keyword=henti)

dual_scenarios.en: The report evaluates the implementation of the New Economic Policy (DEB) in efforts to eradicate poverty and restructure society.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku dah baca pasal DEB, tapi nak faham tujuan dia lagi.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya sudah membaca tentang DEB, tetapi saya masih mahu memahami tujuannya dengan lebih mendalam.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我已经看过新经济政策的资料了，不过还想再弄清楚它的目的。
dual_scenarios.en: I've read about the NEP, but I still want to understand its aims better.
spoken_features: dah 是 sudah 的口语缩略形式。
pasal 在此表示 tentang，即“关于”。
nak 对应 mahu；tujuan dia 在此对应 tujuannya。
aku 用于关系熟悉的同辈之间。

messages.speaker: Farah (同学)
messages.ms_spoken: Kau dah baca bab DEB ke? Aku nak bincang tujuan dia.
messages.ms_standard: Adakah kamu sudah membaca bab tentang DEB? Saya mahu membincangkan tujuannya.
messages.zh: 你看过新经济政策那一章了吗？我想聊聊它的目的。
messages.en: Have you read the chapter on the NEP? I want to discuss its aims.

messages.speaker: Amir (同学)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah. Kita tengok dua matlamat utama dia dulu, senang sikit nak faham.
messages.ms_standard: Sudah. Kita teliti dua matlamat utamanya terlebih dahulu supaya lebih mudah difahami.
messages.zh: 看了。我们先看它的两个主要目标，这样比较容易懂。
messages.en: Yes. Let's look at its two main aims first; that'll make it easier to understand.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 讨论 DEB 涉及马来西亚经济史及族群关系。宜使用客观、具体的政策用语，区分政策目标、执行措施与实际成效。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于历史课堂、政策研究、新闻和公共讨论。避免把政策名称当作对某一族群的标签，也不要预设谈话对象支持或反对该政策。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 讨论 DEB 涉及马来西亚经济史及族群关系。宜使用客观、具体的政策用语，区分政策目标、执行措施与实际成效。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于历史课堂、政策研究、新闻和公共讨论。避免把政策名称当作对某一族群的标签，也不要预设谈话对象支持或反对该政策。

etymology.historical_story: DEB was formed from the initials of Dasar Ekonomi Baru. Its letters carry the history of Malaysia's New Economic Policy, implemented from 1971 to 1990. The policy linked poverty eradication with restructuring society to reduce the identification of ethnicity with economic function, making the abbreviation a recurring term in Malaysian historical discussion. [Ministry of Economy](https://ekonomi.gov.my/sites/default/files/2020-02/Bab%201.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把三个字母接回三个词：D＝Dasar（政策），E＝Ekonomi（经济），B＝Baru（新）；合起来就是“新经济政策”。

morphology.pattern_note: 外来整词，不能拆成马来语前缀 di- 和所谓词根 namit。派生时，meN- 在 d 前变为 men-，保留 d：mendinamit；动作名词可按 peN-…-an 构成 pendinamitan。

word_family.gloss: 用达纳炸药炸毁或爆破
使用达纳炸药进行爆破的过程

senses.zh_definition: 达纳炸药；一种爆炸力很强、可用于炸碎岩石等作业的炸药。
senses.en_definition: Dynamite, a powerful explosive used for blasting rock and similar work.
senses.ms_definition: Bahan letupan yang kuat dan boleh menghancurkan batu-batu.
senses.nuances: 指特定种类的炸药，不是所有 bahan letupan（爆炸物）的统称，也不等同于 bom（炸弹）。条状包装常用量词 batang；不把英语 dynamite 表示“极精彩”的俚语义直接套入马来语。

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 涉及事故或伤亡时宜用克制、准确的措辞。在机场、车站和安检场合，不宜拿持有或使用炸药开玩笑。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 这是中性的技术名词，适用于新闻、工程和历史讨论；正式表达应区分 dinamit、bom 与一般的 bahan letupan。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 涉及事故或伤亡时宜用克制、准确的措辞。在机场、车站和安检场合，不宜拿持有或使用炸药开玩笑。

etymology.historical_story: Dinamit belongs to the international word family of dynamite. Alfred Nobel patented dynamite in 1867, and its name draws on Greek dynamis, meaning power. This history explains the word's association with forceful industrial blasting. In Malay, the borrowed form functions as a complete noun and supports the derived verb mendinamit. [Nobel Prize](https://www.nobelprize.org/alfred-nobel/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dinamit 和英语 dynamite 对照着读，联想采石场被炸碎的岩石；开头的 di 是词的一部分，不是被动前缀。

morphology.formula: meN- + erti → mengerti; di- + mengerti → dimengerti
morphology.pattern_note: meN- 在元音起首的 erti 前取 meng-，e 读 /ə/。被动式保留 meng-，再加 di-；这是特殊形式，不能套成 dierti。语法 di- 与后词连写。[马来语重复加缀研究](https://mlcs.moe.edu.sg/files/Kertas2_Dian2.pdf)。

senses.zh_definition: 被理解；其含义、目的、意图或重要性得到领会。
senses.en_definition: To be understood in meaning, purpose, intention, or significance.
senses.ms_definition: Difahami atau diketahui erti, tujuan, maksud atau kepentingannya.
senses.nuances: mengerti 的被动形式。mudah dimengerti 表示容易理解，不表示已经有人理解。马来西亚日常交流常用 difahami 或 faham；dimengerti 在书面、文学或较郑重的表达中也合用。

etymology.historical_story: The story here is an unusual piece of Malay word formation. Erti supplies the idea of meaning, and mengerti expresses understanding. When the passive form is made, meng- remains inside dimengerti instead of disappearing. A study of repeated affixation explicitly records this sequence, making the word a memorable exception to the usual active–passive pattern. [Morphological study](https://mlcs.moe.edu.sg/files/Kertas2_Dian2.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mengerti 想成整块“理解”，前面再贴 di-，就成“被理解”；听到 /ŋ/ 时记住里面的 meng- 没有消失。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于新闻、公文和日常交流。disambut 不自行表示过去时，时间由上下文或 telah、sudah、akan 等说明。正式马来语中，第一、第二人称施事通常采用 Tetamu itu telah saya sambut、Tetamu itu perlu anda sambut 等结构。

etymology.historical_story: Disambut is formed within Malay from the passive prefix di- and sambut. The dictionary records physical receiving alongside welcoming people, reacting to proposals and answering challenges. These meanings offer a useful shared image: something arrives and is met. Celebrations extend that image to special occasions, while the passive form places the person, object or occasion being received first.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: di- 提醒“被”，sambut 联想“接”：人被迎接、球被接住、建议被接受、节日被迎来庆祝。

morphology.pattern_note: di- 标记被动，-kan 构成及物动词；词根 kumpul 的首音 k 保留，无鼻音同化。此处 circumfix 表示前后缀组合；被动前缀 di- 必须连写。输入中的词根判断已修正。

senses.zh_definition: 被收集、归拢或汇集到一起，指分散的物品、资料等受到有意收集。

etymology.historical_story: Dikumpulkan is transparently formed within Malay rather than borrowed as a complete word. Its base, kumpul, supports a family of words for gathering, groups and collection. DBP illustrates this semantic range with scattered objects, assembled people and accumulated money. The passive form places the collected items or assembled people at the centre of the sentence. [Source: DBP, Kamus Dewan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=mengumpulkan).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: kumpul 想成“聚到一堆”；di- 把对象放到被动位置：borang dikumpulkan＝表格被收集起来。

morphology.formula: di + jalan → di jalan；表示地点时不写作 dijalan
morphology.pattern_note: 此分析以原文意为 di jalan 为前提。di 是独立的地点介词，不是被动前缀；规范短语可读作 /di dʒalan/。没有上下文时，不能排除原词是其他词形的截断。

senses.zh_definition: 若原意为规范短语 di jalan，表示在路上、在道路处；dijalan 本身不宜作为这一意义的规范单词。
senses.en_definition: If intended as di jalan: on the road or in the street; the joined spelling is nonstandard for this meaning.
senses.ms_definition: Jika yang dimaksudkan ialah di jalan: berada atau berlaku di kawasan jalan; ejaan berangkai dijalan tidak baku bagi maksud tempat ini.
senses.nuances: 本义项是有条件的拼写纠正说明，不是 DBP 对 dijalan 的独立释义。pos 标记对应规范表达中的 di；整个 di jalan 是介词短语。不能把 dijalan 自动解释为 dijalankan（被执行）或 dijalani（被经历）。地点介词须分写，依据 [DBP 拼写说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=terpisah+1)。词根及词族参见 [DBP jalan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=jalan)。

etymology.historical_story: The useful story here concerns spelling rather than a separate word origin. Malay distinguishes the independent location marker di from the attached passive prefix di-. A missing space can therefore disguise a phrase as a derived word. Read as a location expression, dijalan should be restored to di jalan; its original context is still needed to confirm that interpretation.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: di 表示“在”，jalan 表示“路”：在路上，两个词也要各走各的，写成 di jalan。

morphology.pattern_note: 作为完整借词记忆，不拆成 dan 与 sa；构成 berdansa 时，ber- 与词干均保持原形。

etymology.historical_story: Dansa is an established loanword whose Western dance sense preserves a clue to its foreign connections. Wiktionary identifies Portuguese dança or Spanish danza as possible sources, leaving the immediate route unresolved. Malay treats the borrowed noun as a complete base and adds its own prefix in berdansa, meaning to dance. Source: [Wiktionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/dansa#Malay).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: dansa 听起来接近英语 dance；看到 dansa 想西式舞蹈，加 ber- 就是亲自下场跳。

This offers a possible cultural identification, not a verified history of the word or proof of its adoption into standard Malaysian Malay. The packet provides no definition, and its proposed base did does not establish a historical or morphological derivation.

morphology.pattern_note: 数据包将 ditemani 标为词根有误；实际词根为 teman。此处 circumfix 表示前后词缀组合：di- 标记被动，-i 构成及物动词，并非不可分割的单一环缀。词根首音 t 保留，末辅音 n 与后缀 -i 连读为 ni；主动对应形式为 menemani。原包未提供完整词的 Jawi，保留 null。

senses.zh_definition: 由某人陪伴或陪同；有人相伴。
senses.en_definition: To be accompanied or kept company by someone.
senses.ms_definition: Diiringi atau disertai oleh seseorang yang menjadi teman.
senses.nuances: menemani 的被动形式，主语是受到陪伴的人。可表示陪同出行或留下相伴，不必涉及正式护送，也不自动表示恋爱关系。此处马来语释义依据词根词条作被动改写。[DBP：teman／menemani](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=132088&keyword=teman)

senses.zh_definition: 与某种食物搭配供应或食用；以某物相佐。
senses.en_definition: To be served or eaten with an accompanying food.
senses.ms_definition: Disertai makanan lain sebagai pelengkap atau lauk yang dimakan bersama.
senses.nuances: 属于食物搭配的引申用法，常见于餐饮介绍，带有把配菜视作伙伴的拟人色彩。不是食物主动陪人的字面意思。[DBP：menemani 的食物搭配义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=132088&keyword=teman)

messages.en: Sure, I've finished work. Just wait at home and I'll pick you up.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 请求陪伴时，可说 Boleh temankan saya?；与长辈、不熟悉的人或服务人员交谈时，使用 saya，并以适当称呼代替 aku、kau。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于就医、出行、探访或表达需要陪伴。它只说明相伴关系；是否为家人、朋友、伴侣或工作人员，应由上下文说明。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 请求陪伴时，可说 Boleh temankan saya?；与长辈、不熟悉的人或服务人员交谈时，使用 saya，并以适当称呼代替 aku、kau。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于就医、出行、探访或表达需要陪伴。它只说明相伴关系；是否为家人、朋友、伴侣或工作人员，应由上下文说明。

etymology.historical_story: Ditemani grows from teman, a companion or something that goes together with something else. Malay extends this relationship from people to food: a dish can be accompanied by another dish. The passive form places the person or food receiving that company at the centre of the sentence. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=132088&keyword=teman)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: teman 是伙伴；di- 把镜头转向被陪的人：Saya ditemani ibu＝我由妈妈陪着。记住“伙伴在旁，我被陪伴”。

morphology.formula: denga + -nya → denganya（仅为依据输入的暂定切分）
morphology.pattern_note: 保留输入给出的词根 denga，但尚未核实该词形的来源及意义。若末尾确为 -nya，它可能是附着代词，而非派生后缀；不能仅凭字母相接确认构词。也不能未经上下文便改为 dengannya。

senses.zh_definition: 待核实的书写形式；现有材料不足以确定其作为马来语词语的意义。
senses.en_definition: An unidentified written form whose Malay lexical meaning cannot be established from the supplied evidence.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk tulisan yang makna dan penggunaannya sebagai perkataan bahasa Melayu belum dapat dipastikan berdasarkan maklumat yang diberikan.
senses.nuances: 此处 noun 仅表示把 denganya 作为被讨论的字符串来指称，不是确认其实际词性或词义。可能涉及误拼、方言记录或其他来源，须查看原句。若原句确实意为“与他／她一起”，可考虑核对 dengannya，但这只是条件性校对建议。以下搭配均为讨论拼写的元语言表达，不是该形式的已证实常用搭配。

etymology.historical_story: No reliable origin can be assigned to this isolated form. Its ending resembles Malay -nya, but resemblance alone does not establish a valid word or its history. An original sentence could reveal a typing error, a regional spelling, or another explanation. The dialogue illustrates one possible correction only; it does not prove that every occurrence means dengannya.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先把 denganya 标成“等原句”。若确实想表达“跟他／她”，再检查 dengan + -nya → dengannya：词根末尾 n 与 -nya 开头 n 都须保留。

morphology.pattern_note: 纠正资料包将 didenda 标为词根的分析：它是 denda 的被动动词形式。di- 与词根连写，无鼻音同化，词根首音 d 保留；音节可分析为 di.den.da。IPA 为根据词根读音推导的宽式标音，采用词末 a 的读法，并非 DBP 提供的音标。词根读音参见 [denda](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/denda#Malay)。

word_family.gloss: 对某人处以罚款或处罚
处以罚款或处罚的行为

senses.zh_definition: 因违法或违反规定而被处以罚款。

senses.ms_definition: Dikenakan hukuman membayar sejumlah wang kerana melakukan kesalahan atau melanggar peraturan.
senses.nuances: 被动动词，主语是受罚者。di- 本身不表示过去时，实际时间由 sudah、akan 或上下文表达。马来语释义依据 DBP 的 denda、mendenda 词义编写，非 DBP 对 didenda 的逐字释义；例句和金额均为教学设定。[DBP：denda](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=denda)

senses.ms_definition: Dikenakan hukuman kerana kesalahan yang biasanya agak kecil, tanpa semestinya melibatkan bayaran wang.
senses.nuances: 学校或家庭语境中可以指罚站、额外任务等处罚，不能一概译为被罚款。对应 DBP 对 denda 和 mendenda 所列的非金钱处罚义。

etymology.historical_story: Didenda combines the Malay passive prefix di- with denda, a word belonging to the Sanskrit borrowing layer of Malay. That older vocabulary reflects sustained contact with South Asian languages and traditions. Modern Malay uses the root for monetary fines and lesser punishments; adding di- shifts attention from whoever imposes the penalty to whoever receives it. [Sanskrit borrowing evidence](https://mlcs.moe.edu.sg/files/dian_bahasa_6.pdf), [modern meanings](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=denda)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: di- 想成“被”，denda 想成“罚”：didenda 就是“被罚”。再看上下文，判断是罚钱还是其他处罚。

morphology.pattern_note: di- 构成被动式并保留词根词首 p；此处不能拆为 diper- + intah。主动式 memerintah 中，meN- 与词首 p 结合时发生鼻音替代。输入包将整个词标为词根，现按实际构词修正。

senses.zh_definition: 受某位统治者、政府或执政集团统治或治理。
senses.en_definition: To be ruled or governed by a ruler, government, or governing group.
senses.ms_definition: Berada di bawah kuasa dan pentadbiran seseorang pemerintah atau sesuatu kerajaan.
senses.nuances: memerintah 的被动形式，主语是受统治的国家、地区或人民。它本身不表示过去时，时间由上下文或曾经、已经等时间成分表达。释义依据 [DBP 的 perintah 词条](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?d=10&k=perintah) 及被动构词改写。

senses.zh_definition: 受到命令或指示，被要求服从或采取行动。
senses.en_definition: To be ordered or directed to act.
senses.ms_definition: Menerima arahan atau suruhan daripada pihak yang mempunyai kuasa.
senses.nuances: 强调接受命令的一方。法律文字中可见 sebagaimana diperintah；明确接续具体行动时，现代马来语也常用 diperintahkan supaya 或 diarahkan untuk。实际用例见 [雪兰莪州议会文本](https://dewan.selangor.gov.my/enakmen/kuasa-untuk-me%C2%ADmerintah-saksi-saksi-hadir/)。

etymology.historical_story: Diperintah is built within Malay from the passive prefix di- and perintah, a word covering orders and authority. That connection links two settings: a person receiving commands and a country being governed. The word family preserves both meanings, while pemerintahan names governance and pemerintah identifies the governing person or body. [Dictionary reference](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?d=10&k=perintah).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: perintah 是命令，前加 di- 就转向承受者：人被命令，国家被统治。

morphology.formula: di- + per- + kenal + -kan → diperkenalkan；主动式 memperkenalkan → 被动式 diperkenalkan
morphology.pattern_note: 输入包将整词标为词根，应更正为 kenal。此处依给定分类将 diper-…-kan 归入 circumfix，结构上包含被动前缀 di-、per- 和后缀 -kan。kenal 的 k 保留；di- 与动词连写，且不自行表示过去时。词族关系见 [DBP：kenal](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=kenal)。

senses.zh_definition: 被介绍给别人，使对方知道自己的姓名、身份或背景。
senses.en_definition: To be introduced to another person or an audience by name or identity.
senses.ms_definition: Dinyatakan nama atau maklumat diri seseorang kepada orang lain supaya orang itu dapat mengenalinya.
senses.nuances: 这是 memperkenalkan 的被动式。被介绍者作主语，介绍对象通常由 kepada 引出，介绍人可由 oleh 引出。须区分 diperkenalkan kepada seseorang“被介绍给某人”和 dikenali“被认识／为人所知”。据 [DBP：kenal 词条下的 memperkenalkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=kenal) 转述。

collocations.en: be introduced by the master of ceremonies

senses.zh_definition: 某种事物、概念、产品或方法被介绍、推广、引入或开始采用。
senses.en_definition: To be made known, brought into a setting, or put into use, especially as a new product, concept, or method.
senses.ms_definition: Diusahakan supaya sesuatu diketahui orang, atau dibawa masuk untuk digunakan dalam sesuatu bidang atau keadaan.
senses.nuances: 可指让人认识某事物，也可指引入新制度或做法；不一定意味着正式发布。telah diperkenalkan 表示已引入，akan diperkenalkan 表示将引入。相关用法见 [DBP：introduce](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=399108&keyword=introduce)。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于社交介绍、产品推广及制度引入。若要直接提出自我介绍，可说 Izinkan saya memperkenalkan diri；diperkenalkan 则用于叙述某人或某物受到介绍。

etymology.historical_story: At the centre of diperkenalkan is kenal, meaning to know or recognise. Memperkenalkan turns recognition into an act performed for someone else: introducing a person or making something known. The passive form shifts attention to whoever or whatever receives that introduction. Its uses range from personal introductions to new systems, without requiring a separate borrowed verb for each setting.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 kenal“认识”：memperkenalkan＝让别人认识；换成被动 diperkenalkan＝被介绍、被引入。

senses.zh_definition: 流动或运动非常迅疾的；湍急的。

senses.zh_definition: 迅速地；赶快地，表示动作进行得快。

etymology.historical_story: Deras evokes the force of moving water, a recurring image in Malay expressions. The dictionary preserves deras seperti anak panah, meaning extremely fast, and the proverb deras datang dalam kena, warning that haste can bring loss. These expressions connect physical speed with human conduct. They document cultural usage without establishing the word’s ultimate prehistoric origin. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=82736&keyword=deras)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 跟读 də-ras，想象河水急冲、雨水猛落：同一幅“来势很猛”的画面，分别记住 arus deras 和 hujan deras。

morphology.pattern_note: 输入包的根词标记予以保留，但 dibahagian 实际是 di bahagian 的非规范连写，并非独立根词。di 是表示处所的介词，须与 bahagian 分写；它不是被动前缀 di-。上述 IPA 对应规范短语。status 沿用指定标签，不表示此拼写获规范认可。

senses.zh_definition: 规范写法为 di bahagian，表示在某个部分、区域或部门；后面通常须接具体说明。
senses.en_definition: Nonstandard joined spelling of di bahagian: in or at a specified section, area, or division.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk tidak baku bagi frasa di bahagian, yang menunjukkan tempat dalam sesuatu bahagian, kawasan atau unit organisasi.
senses.nuances: 词性按规范短语中介词 di 的功能标注，整个结构属于介词短语。di bahagian belakang 表示“在后部”，di Bahagian Kewangan 表示“在财务部门”。不要与 dibahagikan（被分配、被划分）混淆。DBP 的处所用例采用分写形式：[DBP 介词用法说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=pada+di)。

dual_scenarios.en: You wrote dibahagian belakang in that message; di and bahagian need a space between them, right?

kau 是熟人之间的第二人称称呼
kena 在此表示“需要、得”

messages.en: Just put a space between di and bahagian: di bahagian belakang.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 纠正同事拼写时，可说 Boleh jarakkan di dan bahagian?（可以把 di 和 bahagian 分开吗？），避免当众用 Salah! 直接否定。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 公文、学校作业和工作邮件均应写 di bahagian。引用 dibahagian 时应说明是在讨论原文拼写，避免让学习者误认为规范词。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 纠正同事拼写时，可说 Boleh jarakkan di dan bahagian?（可以把 di 和 bahagian 分开吗？），避免当众用 Salah! 直接否定。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 公文、学校作业和工作邮件均应写 di bahagian。引用 dibahagian 时应说明是在讨论原文拼写，避免让学习者误认为规范词。

etymology.historical_story: This form illustrates an important distinction in Malay writing: di can introduce a location or mark a passive verb. In di bahagian, it introduces a location and remains separate. Bahagian belongs to the bahagi family, associated with dividing and portions. The joined spelling reflects confusion between two grammatical uses, rather than a separate historical word.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先问“在哪里？”：答案若是“在某部分”，di 就单独站。di｜bahagian，空格像部门之间的一道门。

morphology.pattern_note: 被动前缀 di- 直接接在 proses 前，词根不变音；这里的 di- 必须连写。输入包将 diproses 标为词根，应更正为派生词。

senses.zh_definition: 被依照规定程序办理、审核或处理。
senses.en_definition: To be dealt with according to an established procedure.
senses.ms_definition: Dikenakan tindakan mengikut tatacara yang ditetapkan, misalnya bagi mengurus permohonan atau dokumen.
senses.nuances: 常见于申请、订单及行政通知。sedang diproses 表示正在办理，不表示已经批准；telah diproses 表示已处理，也不必然表示申请成功。词义依据 [DBP：proses](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243492&keyword=proses)。

senses.zh_definition: 原料、食品等被加工或处理，以改变其性质、制成产品或提高耐用性。
senses.en_definition: To undergo treatment or manufacture that changes a material or product.
senses.ms_definition: Diolah melalui langkah tertentu untuk menghasilkan barangan atau mengubah sifat sesuatu bahan.
senses.nuances: 指实际加工过程。食品领域的 diproses 本身不表示不健康，也不等于高度加工；具体程度须由上下文说明。

senses.zh_definition: 数据、图像或其他信息被系统运算、转换或整理。
senses.en_definition: To be manipulated or transformed by a computational or information-processing system.
senses.ms_definition: Dijalankan operasi terhadapnya oleh sistem untuk mendapatkan hasil atau maklumat tertentu.
senses.nuances: 这是一般“处理”义在信息技术中的应用；不必然涉及人工智能。

etymology.historical_story: Malay proses is identified by DBP as an English borrowing. Its use connects factory production, administrative procedures and computer operations through the idea of ordered steps. Malay then supplies its own grammar: memproses presents the action, while diproses presents what undergoes it. The borrowed vocabulary therefore participates in a productive Malay word family.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 di- 想成“被”：proses 是处理，diproses 就是“被处理”。

morphology.pattern_note: 修正输入将 dituntut 当作词根的分析：di- 是被动前缀，与 tuntut 连写，不引起词根音变，也不表示过去时；与分写的地点介词 di 不同。

word_family.gloss: 提出要求或追索的行为

senses.zh_definition: 被要求交付、偿还或兑现；被追讨、索取或申领。
senses.en_definition: To be demanded, claimed, recovered, or requested in repayment.
senses.ms_definition: Diminta supaya diserahkan, dibayar, dikembalikan atau ditunaikan oleh pihak yang membuat tuntutan.
senses.nuances: 主语通常是欠款、赔偿、权利或应兑现的事项。belum dituntut 是“尚未有人认领／申领”，并不必然表示“尚未支付”。释义据 [DBP：tuntut](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=penuntutan) 整理。

senses.zh_definition: 被要求履行某项义务或达到某种标准；按规范应当做到。
senses.en_definition: To be required or expected to fulfil an obligation or meet a standard.
senses.ms_definition: Dikehendaki atau diwajibkan melakukan sesuatu menurut tanggungjawab, peraturan atau ajaran tertentu.
senses.nuances: 常见于职业、道德或宗教要求。dituntut oleh agama 本身不确定某行为在宗教规范中的具体等级；须结合上下文判断。参见 [DBP：menuntut 的义项](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=mendesak)。

senses.zh_definition: 知识、学问或技能被学习、钻研或求取。
senses.en_definition: Of knowledge or learning, to be sought or studied.
senses.ms_definition: Diusahakan untuk dipelajari atau diperoleh, khususnya ilmu dan pengetahuan.
senses.nuances: 常见结构为 ilmu yang dituntut；“某人在求学”通常说 dia menuntut ilmu，不能机械改为 dia dituntut ilmu。

senses.zh_definition: 被依法追诉或被作为诉讼对象提出要求。
senses.en_definition: To be proceeded against in court or subjected to a legal claim.
senses.ms_definition: Dibawa ke mahkamah untuk diadili atau dikenakan tuntutan melalui proses kehakiman.
senses.nuances: 属于有词典依据的法律用法，但具体报道宜按事实区分 dituntut、disaman 与 didakwa，不应一律译作“刑事起诉”。

senses.zh_definition: 某项权利、目标或自由被争取、主张或维护。
senses.en_definition: Of a right or objective, to be asserted, defended, or pursued.
senses.ms_definition: Diperjuangkan untuk diperoleh atau dipertahankan, seperti hak dan kebebasan.
senses.nuances: 比单纯“提出请求”更强调主动争取；若主语是权利，具体含义可为主张权利或维护权利。

senses.zh_definition: 某种伤害或恶行被寻求报复或讨还。
senses.en_definition: Of a wrong, to be avenged or repaid in kind.
senses.ms_definition: Dibalas dengan perbuatan yang dianggap setimpal dengan kejahatan atau kecederaan yang telah dilakukan.
senses.nuances: 较文学化，常涉及 balas、bela、darah 或 malu；不宜与正常索赔混为一谈。

etymology.historical_story: The tuntut family links demands for payment, assertions of rights, duties, and the pursuit of knowledge. Malay therefore uses related forms for a financial claim and a student's learning. Dituntut presents the person or thing affected by that action through the passive prefix di-. The prefix changes grammatical perspective, rather than marking a past event. [DBP: tuntut](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=mendesak)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: di- 像把镜头转向承受者：menuntut＝提出要求，dituntut＝被要求；钱被申领，责任被要求履行，知识被求取。

morphology.formula: di- + program → diprogram；正式马来西亚马来语通常用 di- + program + -kan → diprogramkan
morphology.pattern_note: di- 是被动前缀，与后面的词连写，不改变 program 的首音。root_word 按要求保留输入包值；实际构词词根是 program，输入包的独立词根判断不成立。

senses.zh_definition: 被编程；被设定为按照指定程序执行任务。
senses.en_definition: To be programmed to perform a specified task.
senses.ms_definition: Diberi atur cara supaya dapat melaksanakan tugas mengikut arahan yang ditetapkan.
senses.nuances: 这是语料中的被动形式。DBP 在 program 词条下列出 memprogramkan；正式马来西亚文本通常相应使用 diprogramkan，也可按语境使用 diatur cara。这里的马来语释义为据该词条归纳的释义，并非 diprogram 的独立官方原文。[DBP：program](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=program+1)

senses.zh_definition: 被规划或编排进预定的活动安排。
senses.en_definition: To be planned or arranged as part of a programme.
senses.ms_definition: Diatur dalam suatu rancangan atau susunan kegiatan yang telah ditetapkan.
senses.nuances: 用于活动或工作安排时表示被规划，不一定涉及电脑。正式文本通常写 diprogramkan；若只表示列入时间表，dijadualkan 往往更直接。释义依据 DBP 对 memprogramkan 的规划义归纳。[DBP：program](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=program+1)

etymology.historical_story: Malay borrowed program from English and incorporated it into its own affix system. The resulting family connects two familiar activities: arranging events and instructing computers. DBP records memprogramkan for these uses. The corpus form diprogram shows the passive prefix di-, while formal Malaysian usage generally favours the corresponding form diprogramkan.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 di-，先想“被”；看到 program，想到程序：diprogram＝被设定程序。正式写作再记住常用完整形式 diprogramkan。

headword.validation_note: 这是标准词 desa 加第一人称领属附着形式 -ku 构成的表达，不是独立派生词。输入的 ديسا 只对应词根 desa；此处按完整词形补写 -ku。音标按构成推导，音节字段保留输入的 null。

morphology.pattern_note: -ku 是 aku 的后附形式，此处表示领属；按题定字段归入 suffix，但并非派生后缀。与前面的名词连写，desa 的 é 读 /e/，不发生元音脱落。

word_family.gloss: 具有乡村或乡民特点的

senses.zh_definition: 我的村庄；语境中也可指我的乡村故里。
senses.en_definition: My village; in context, my home village.
senses.ms_definition: Desa milik atau tempat asal penutur; kampung saya atau kampung aku.
senses.nuances: 这里的 -ku 表示说话者与村庄的归属联系，不必表示法律上的所有权。desa 的乡村义见 DBP；-ku 与前词连写见官方拼写规范。不能把词根的所有历史义项直接当作 desaku 的常用义。[DBP：desa](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=244840&keyword=desa)；[DBP：马来语拼写规范](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ejaan.pdf)

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: desaku 常带个人、文学或抒情语气。正式工作交谈中可用 desa saya 或 kampung saya；对长辈、上司使用 aku 作独立人称代词时须考虑关系和场合。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合讲述故乡、乡村生活或个人归属。村庄未必是出生地；只有上下文明确时，才把 desaku 译作我的出生地或老家。

etymology.historical_story: Desa belongs to Malay's Sanskrit-derived vocabulary, associated historically with place or territory. Desaku adds the attached first-person form -ku, giving the village a personal connection to the speaker. The result can express home and belonging without implying legal ownership, making it useful in personal descriptions of a village. [Sanskrit loanword study](https://plm.org.my/ejurnal/index.php/jurnallinguistik/article/download/135/118)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: desa 是村庄，-ku 是我的：desa + ku → 我的村庄。把 -ku 与 aku 联系起来记。

morphology.pattern_note: di- 构成被动式，直接接词根，不引起鼻音同化，也不脱落词根首辅音 k；与主动式 mengenang 对应，动词前缀必须连写。

senses.zh_definition: 被回想起；被记在心中，常指过去的人、经历或事情。
senses.en_definition: To be remembered or recalled, often with an emotional association.
senses.ms_definition: Diingat atau dibayangkan kembali dalam fikiran, terutama tentang seseorang atau sesuatu yang telah berlalu.
senses.nuances: 这是 mengenang 的被动形式，不是“正在回忆”的主动形式。可用于温馨、悲伤或其他带感情色彩的回忆；并不必然表示追悼死者。释义根据词根条目及其被动构词编写，非独立词条的逐字引文。参见 [DBP PRPM：kenang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=kenang)。

senses.zh_definition: 被铭记、感念或缅怀，尤指某人的恩惠、贡献或事迹。
senses.en_definition: To be remembered with appreciation or commemorated for one's deeds or contributions.
senses.ms_definition: Diingati dengan penghargaan terhadap budi, jasa atau sumbangan seseorang.
senses.nuances: 这是“被记得”在感恩和纪念语境中的常见用法。dikenang 不等于已举行纪念仪式；仍在世的人也可因贡献而被铭记。参见 [DBP PRPM：kenang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=kenang)。

collocations.en: his or her contributions are remembered

dual_scenarios.ms: Sumbangan beliau dalam bidang pendidikan akan terus dikenang oleh masyarakat.

dual_scenarios.en: His contributions to education will continue to be remembered by the community.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Jasa cikgu tu memang dikenang sampai sekarang, kan?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Jasa guru itu memang masih dikenang hingga sekarang, bukan?

kan 用于邀请对方认同

messages.ms_spoken: Jasa cikgu tu memang dikenang sampai sekarang, kan? Dah lama kita habis sekolah.
messages.ms_standard: Jasa guru itu memang masih dikenang hingga sekarang, bukan? Kita sudah lama tamat sekolah.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 正式赞扬长者或受尊敬者时，可用 Jasa beliau akan sentiasa dikenang，其中 beliau 比 dia 更显尊重。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于感谢、回忆和纪念。写给在世者时宜明确指出 jasa 或 sumbangan；某些完整表达如 sentiasa dikenang dalam ingatan 容易让人联想到悼念，需结合场合。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 正式赞扬长者或受尊敬者时，可用 Jasa beliau akan sentiasa dikenang，其中 beliau 比 dia 更显尊重。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于感谢、回忆和纪念。写给在世者时宜明确指出 jasa 或 sumbangan；某些完整表达如 sentiasa dikenang dalam ingatan 容易让人联想到悼念，需结合场合。

etymology.historical_story: Dikenang is transparently formed from kenang with the Malay passive prefix di-. The same root appears in kenangan, a memory, and kenang-kenangan, a keepsake. Its cultural resonance is especially clear in mengenang budi: remembering another person's kindness. The passive form shifts attention from the person remembering to the person, experience or contribution that remains in memory. See [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=kenang).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 di- 当作“被”的提示，把 kenang 联到 kenangan“回忆”：dikenang＝被放进回忆里、被铭记。

morphology.pattern_note: 这是英语词；所列为非卷舌英语读音，美式常为 /dwɔːrf/。保留词首 /dw/ 和词尾 /f/。下列派生词属于英语词族，不是马来语派生词。

word_family.gloss: 矮小症；导致明显矮小身材的状况

senses.zh_definition: 身材因相关生长状况而明显矮小的人；用作对人的称呼时须尊重本人偏好。
senses.en_definition: A person with a condition resulting in markedly short stature.
senses.ms_definition: Orang yang mempunyai keadaan pertumbuhan yang menyebabkan tubuhnya sangat rendah.
senses.nuances: 这是英语义项，不能因 PRPM 提供英马翻译而认定为马来语借词。马来语释义为编写释义；涉及真实人物时宜依本人偏好使用中性表达。义项参见 [DBP《Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan》](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?keyword=dwarf)。以下为英语搭配。

collocations.ms: a person described as a dwarf
collocations.zh: 被描述为身材明显矮小的人
collocations.en: a person described as a dwarf

senses.zh_definition: 神话、童话或奇幻作品中的矮人，通常具有人形及特殊技艺或力量。
senses.en_definition: A small humanlike being in mythology, fairy tales, or fantasy.
senses.ms_definition: Makhluk bertubuh kecil yang menyerupai manusia dalam mitos, cerita dongeng atau karya fantasi.
senses.nuances: 英语奇幻用语；马来语可按作品译作 orang kerdil 或沿用既定译名。此义不应套用于真实人物。参见 [DBP 英马词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?keyword=dwarf)。以下为英语搭配。

senses.zh_definition: 指动植物或品种比同类通常个体明显矮小的；矮生的。
senses.en_definition: Of an animal or plant: substantially smaller or shorter than the usual form.
senses.ms_definition: Bagi haiwan atau tumbuhan, mempunyai saiz atau ketinggian yang lebih kecil daripada bentuk lazimnya.
senses.nuances: 英语定语用法。马来语依对象可用 kerdil、rendah 或具体品种名称，不能机械统一翻译。马来西亚农业资料中的 Malayan Red Dwarf 对应矮生椰子品种。参见 [马来西亚农业局](https://epengembangan.doa.gov.my/en/tanaman/tanaman-industri/)。以下为英语搭配。

senses.zh_definition: 在体积、数量、规模或重要性上远远超过，使另一事物相形见小。
senses.en_definition: To make something appear small or insignificant by comparison.
senses.ms_definition: Menyebabkan sesuatu kelihatan kecil atau kurang penting apabila dibandingkan dengannya.
senses.nuances: 英语及物动词，不表示对象实际缩小。标准马来语按语境可译为 menyebabkan ... kelihatan kecil 或 jauh mengatasi。参见 [Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/dwarf)。以下为英语搭配。

senses.zh_definition: 使生长受抑制，导致个体或植株不能达到正常大小。
senses.en_definition: To stunt growth and prevent normal size from being attained.
senses.ms_definition: Membantutkan pertumbuhan sehingga saiz normal tidak dapat dicapai.
senses.nuances: 英语及物动词，强调实际生长受到限制；与仅表示比较效果的上一义项有别。参见 [DBP 英马词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?keyword=dwarf)。以下为英语搭配。

senses.zh_definition: 天文学中的矮星；用于若干恒星或恒星残骸类别的名称，具体性质由限定词决定。
senses.en_definition: An astronomical object termed a dwarf, with its physical classification determined by the accompanying modifier.
senses.ms_definition: Objek astronomi yang disebut bintang kerdil, dengan jenisnya ditentukan oleh kata penerang yang digunakan.
senses.nuances: 英语天文学用法，不能把所有含 dwarf 的名称视为同一物理类别。red dwarf 是红矮星，white dwarf 是白矮星；dwarf planet 则是另一术语“矮行星”。基本星体义参见 [Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/dwarf)。以下为英语术语搭配。

etymology.historical_story: English dwarf descends from Old English dweorg or dweorh and has relatives in other Germanic languages. Its modern uses extend from people and legendary beings to unusually small organisms and comparative verbs. Its appearance in a Malay conversation may reflect quotation or code-switching; that alone does not establish adoption as standard Malay. [Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/dwarf_1)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先用奇幻游戏里的 dwarf 矮人记住“小”的意象；再想一座巨楼 dwarf 周围房屋——让它们显得很小。

morphology.pattern_note: di- 是被动前缀，与 bentuk 连写，词根不发生鼻音同化；它本身不表示过去时。输入将 dibentuk 判为词根有误。标准音位转写保留词末 /k/，实际发音中常实现为 [ʔ]。

senses.zh_definition: 被加工、弯曲或塑造成某种形状。

senses.ms_definition: Dijadikan mempunyai rupa atau lengkungan tertentu melalui sesuatu proses.

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合行政汇报、制作过程及教育讨论。不要将 dibentuk 一律译成“已经形成”；是否完成须看 telah、sudah、akan 等时间或体貌标记。

etymology.historical_story: DBP records bentuk with meanings involving curves, physical form, arrangement, and style. Its verbal family connects shaping an object with establishing an organization and educating a person. Dibentuk combines this base with the passive prefix di-, placing the material, institution, or person being shaped at the centre of the sentence. [DBP: bentuk](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=bentuk)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: bentuk＝形状；di-＝被：面团被塑形、团队被组建、品格被塑造，都能用 dibentuk。

morphology.pattern_note: di- 构成被动式，词根 berkas 保持完整；其中 ber 不是另一个前缀。可分为 di.ber.kas。输入 Jawi برکس 实为词根拼写；完整派生词应写作 دبرکس。

senses.zh_definition: 被捆扎成束；被绑在一起。
senses.en_definition: To be tied or bound together into a bundle.
senses.ms_definition: Diikat bersama-sama sehingga menjadi satu ikatan.
senses.nuances: 这是 memberkas 的字面义被动式，常用于甘蔗、柴枝等可捆成束的物品。后接成束方式或数量时，可用 dalam ikatan 或 sepuluh-sepuluh 等表达。[DBP：berkas](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=berkas)

senses.zh_definition: 被逮捕；被执法人员拘捕。
senses.en_definition: To be arrested or apprehended.
senses.ms_definition: Ditangkap atau ditahan oleh pihak berkuasa.
senses.nuances: 由“捆住、控制住”的意义引申，新闻报道中常用于嫌疑人被捕。diberkas 本身不表示已被判罪，也不必然表示实际使用绳索或手铐；di- 标记被动，不单独表示过去时。[DBP：berkas](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=berkas)

dah 是 sudah 的口语形式，表示已经发生。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)

messages.ms_standard: Sudah. Saya baru membaca berita itu tadi. Polis masih menjalankan siasatan.

messages.en: Yes, I just read the news. The police are still investigating.

etymology.historical_story: The root berkas names a bundle, such as sticks or sugar cane tied together. Malay also uses memberkas for apprehending someone, linking physical restraint with arrest. Diberkas adds the passive prefix di-, placing the bundled object or arrested person at the centre of the sentence. This semantic connection explains both meanings without requiring an invented origin story. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=berkas)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先想 berkas“一捆”：东西被捆住，人被控制住；加 di-，就是“被捆扎／被逮捕”。

headword.jawi_note: 输入包提供的是词根 banjir 的爪夷文；此处补全派生词 dibanjiri 的拼写。

morphology.pattern_note: di- 表示被动，-i 标示水流或大量涌入所作用的对象；词根不发生音变。circumfix 在此按字段分类表示前后缀组合。

word_family.gloss: 遭受水灾；被大量事物充斥

senses.zh_definition: 被大量积水或洪水淹没、漫灌。
senses.en_definition: To be flooded or inundated with water.
senses.ms_definition: Digenangi atau ditenggelami air yang melimpah.
senses.nuances: 这是 membanjiri 的被动形式，主语通常是受淹的地方、建筑或土地；di- 不表示过去时。马来文释义依据词典义项改写为被动，并非逐字引文。[DBP：membanjiri](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=membanjiri)

senses.zh_definition: 被大量涌来的人、物品或信息挤满、充斥。
senses.en_definition: To be crowded or overwhelmed by a large influx of people or things.
senses.ms_definition: Didatangi atau dipenuhi orang, barang atau perkara lain dalam jumlah yang sangat banyak.
senses.nuances: 比喻洪水般的数量与涌入势头，不一定表示灾害或负面结果；常用于人潮、订单、申请和信息。[DBP：membanjiri](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=membanjiri)

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Kedai kita dah dibanjiri tempahan, sampai tak menang tangan!
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Kedai kita sudah dibanjiri tempahan sehingga kita tidak dapat mengurus semuanya dengan segera.
dual_scenarios.zh: 咱们店订单都涌进来了，忙得根本顾不过来！
dual_scenarios.en: Our shop’s been flooded with orders—we can barely keep up!
spoken_features: dah 是 sudah 的口语缩略形式。
tak 是 tidak 的口语形式。
tak menang tangan 是表示忙不过来的惯用语。

messages.speaker: Farah (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Sejak video tu tular, kedai kita dah dibanjiri tempahan!
messages.ms_standard: Sejak video itu tular, kedai kita sudah dibanjiri tempahan.
messages.zh: 那个视频火了以后，咱们店的订单就涌进来了！
messages.en: Ever since that video went viral, we’ve been flooded with orders!

messages.ms_standard: Ya, saya hendak mengurus tempahan yang diterima lebih awal dahulu. Tempahan baharu perlu menunggu sebentar.
messages.zh: 对啊，我先处理早一点下的单。新单得稍等一下。
messages.en: Yeah, I’ll handle the earlier orders first. The new ones will have to wait a bit.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 用于新闻、公文和日常交流都自然。谈真实水灾时宜保持客观、体恤受灾者。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 形容订单或访客众多通常自然；形容某族群或移民 dibanjiri 某地，可能把人描绘成灾害，应谨慎处理语境。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 用于新闻、公文和日常交流都自然。谈真实水灾时宜保持客观、体恤受灾者。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 形容订单或访客众多通常自然；形容某族群或移民 dibanjiri 某地，可能把人描绘成灾害，应谨慎处理语境。

etymology.historical_story: Malay uses banjir for flooding and also extends the image to overwhelming quantities. Dibanjiri combines that root with passive di- and the suffix -i, placing the affected location or recipient at the centre of the sentence. The same image connects flooded neighbourhoods with shops receiving overwhelming orders. This explains its productive morphology and metaphor, without asserting an undocumented ancient origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: banjir 是洪水；di- 把镜头转向承受者：地方 dibanjiri，就是地方被水或人潮淹没。

morphology.pattern_note: di- 构成被动动词，不改变 bedah 的词首 b；e 读 /ə/。音节可分析为 di.be.dah。di- 表示被动，不单独表示过去时。词根分析依据 [DBP：bedah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=bedah)。

word_family.gloss: 施行手术的人；解剖器械

senses.zh_definition: 被施行外科手术，以切开身体部位来治疗疾病或移除病变组织。
senses.en_definition: To be operated on surgically to treat disease or remove diseased tissue.
senses.ms_definition: Dikenakan pembedahan dengan membelah bahagian badan untuk merawat penyakit atau membuang bahagian yang berpenyakit.
senses.nuances: 主体可为患者或接受手术的身体部位。dibedah 本身不说明手术是否已经完成；akan dibedah 表示将接受手术，telah dibedah 表示已接受手术。马来语释义依据 DBP 的 membedah 义项改写为被动表达。

collocations.zh: 由外科专科医生施行手术

senses.zh_definition: 身体或标本被切开，以观察内部结构或进行教学研究。
senses.en_definition: To be dissected to examine internal structures, especially for teaching or study.
senses.ms_definition: Dibelah bahagian tubuh atau spesimennya untuk melihat dan mengkaji struktur di dalamnya.
senses.nuances: 常见于生物学和解剖教学。dibedah siasat 是表示接受尸检的固定组合；不能把所有 dibedah 都译为“被尸检”。

senses.zh_definition: 作品、观点或问题被逐项深入剖析。
senses.en_definition: To be dissected figuratively through detailed critical analysis.
senses.ms_definition: Dianalisis atau diteliti secara mendalam dengan meneliti bahagian dan unsur yang membentuknya.
senses.nuances: 比喻用法，常用于文学评论与研讨；dianalisis 是更中性的正式表达。此义是实际使用中的延伸，并非上述 DBP 词条单列的义项。马来西亚研究中可见此用法：[UKM 文学研究](https://spaj.ukm.my/jws/index.php/jws/article/download/41/20/)。

collocations.en: a novel’s content is closely analysed

dual_scenarios.context: 医院通报 / 新闻报道
dual_scenarios.ms: Pesakit itu telah dibedah oleh pasukan pakar dan kini berada dalam keadaan stabil.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该患者已由专科医疗团队施行手术，目前情况稳定。
dual_scenarios.en: The patient has undergone surgery performed by a specialist team and is now in a stable condition.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 朋友关心家属的术后情况
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Ayah aku dah dibedah pagi tadi.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Ayah saya telah dibedah pagi tadi.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我爸今天早上已经做完手术了。
dual_scenarios.en: My dad had surgery this morning.
spoken_features: aku 是熟人之间常用的第一人称代词。
dah 对应 sudah 或 telah。
pagi tadi 指今天较早的早晨。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Ayah kau dah dibedah ke?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah ayah awak sudah dibedah?
messages.zh: 你爸爸已经做手术了吗？

messages.zh: 做了，今天早上做的。他现在在病房休息。
messages.en: Yes, this morning. He’s resting in the ward now.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 向患者或家属询问时，Sudah menjalani pembedahan? 通常比追问切开哪里更委婉。向长辈谈论第三者可使用 beliau。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于医疗说明、教学及明确的分析比喻。谈论尸检时使用完整的 dibedah siasat，并尊重家属对细节和隐私的选择。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 向患者或家属询问时，Sudah menjalani pembedahan? 通常比追问切开哪里更委婉。向长辈谈论第三者可使用 beliau。

etymology.historical_story: Malay builds dibedah transparently from bedah and the passive prefix di-. The dictionary records both surgical treatment and dissection under membedah, linking healing with the examination of internal structures. Literary analysis also uses the image of dissection metaphorically: a text is opened up for close examination. These relationships explain its modern senses without establishing a deeper borrowing history.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: bedah 是“动刀切开”，前加 di-：动作落到患者或标本身上，就是“被手术、被解剖”。

morphology.pattern_note: di-...-kan 构成与 memaparkan 对应的被动形式；papar 的词首 p 保留。主动式 meN- + papar + -kan → memaparkan 时发生鼻音替代，词首 p 脱落。音节可分析为 di.pa.par.kan。词根及义项依据 [DBP：papar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=papar)。

senses.zh_definition: 信息、故事、图像或事实被展示、呈现或披露，使人看见、了解或理解。
senses.en_definition: To be presented, shown, or disclosed so that something can be seen, understood, or known.
senses.ms_definition: Ditunjukkan, dibentangkan atau didedahkan supaya dapat dilihat, diketahui atau difahami.
senses.nuances: 可用于新闻、展览、报告和叙事。并不必然表示“泄露秘密”；具体可译为“展示、呈现、刊载、报道”。马来语释义依据 DBP 的 memaparkan 义项改写为被动表达。

senses.zh_definition: 文字、数据、图形或其他内容被显示在电脑、手机等设备的屏幕上。
senses.en_definition: To be displayed on a computer screen or another electronic display.
senses.ms_definition: Diperlihatkan pada skrin komputer atau peranti lain dalam bentuk teks, data, grafik dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: 常见于软件界面、操作指南和技术说明。强调内容出现在显示界面上；其本身不表示内容已经上传或对公众开放。

senses.zh_definition: 被弄平、弄钝或加工成平齐的形状。
senses.en_definition: To be flattened or made blunt or level.
senses.ms_definition: Dijadikan pepat atau rata.
senses.nuances: 对应 DBP 的 papar I，与常用的“展示、显示”义分属不同词义来源。现代一般交流中少见，meratakan 等表达通常更直观；以下为说明该义的组合，不代表高频搭配。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 系统操作通知
dual_scenarios.ms: Keputusan permohonan akan dipaparkan pada portal rasmi selepas proses semakan selesai.

dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Keputusan telah dipaparkan pada portal itu.

dual_scenarios.en: The results are up on the portal now.

kat 泛用于表示位置，标准语在这里用 pada。
tu 是 itu 的口语形式。

messages.speaker: Farah (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Keputusan dah dipaparkan kat portal tu ke?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah keputusan sudah dipaparkan pada portal itu?

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 正式通知中可用 Sila rujuk maklumat yang dipaparkan，语气礼貌明确。熟人聊天常说 dah dipaparkan kat portal。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于公开信息、媒体内容和屏幕显示。dipaparkan 只说明展示行为，不自动表示内容真实、获准公开或适合转发。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 正式通知中可用 Sila rujuk maklumat yang dipaparkan，语气礼貌明确。熟人聊天常说 dah dipaparkan kat portal。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于公开信息、媒体内容和屏幕显示。dipaparkan 只说明展示行为，不自动表示内容真实、获准公开或适合转发。

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary distinguishes papar meaning flat or blunt from papar underlying the verb for presenting information. It also records screen display as a specific sense of memaparkan. This gives modern dipaparkan a natural place in computer instructions as well as public reporting. The shared spelling alone does not establish that these distinct dictionary meanings developed from one another.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 papar 想成“把内容铺开给人看”；di-...-kan 把视角转向内容：内容“被展示、被显示”。这只是记忆图像，不是词源解释。

morphology.pattern_note: 这是有文献记录的方言形式，不是已核实的独立标准语词头。卡邦马来方言材料将 denga /dəŋa/ 对应于标准语 dengar；词末没有 /r/。下列词族列出标准语对应形式的派生词，不表示直接在 denga 后添加词缀。

senses.zh_definition: 听；听见。某些马来方言中与标准语 dengar 对应的形式。
senses.en_definition: A dialectal form of dengar: to hear or listen.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk dialek bagi dengar, iaitu menangkap bunyi dengan telinga atau memberikan perhatian kepada sesuatu yang didengar.
senses.nuances: 不能把此拼写一律视为错误，也不能当作全国通用的标准拼写。正式行文通常使用 dengar 或 mendengar。此处音标依据卡邦方言记录，不代表所有地区的读音。搭配为说明性用例，未经语料频率统计。[卡邦方言研究](https://ir.unimas.my/id/eprint/45370/1/Hubungan%20kekeluargaan%20antara.pdf)

dual_scenarios.context: 语言调查 / 学术汇报；以引述形式使用方言词

dual_scenarios.zh: 该研究报告把方言形式 denga 与标准马来语 dengar 对应起来。
dual_scenarios.en: In the research report, the dialect form denga is matched with the Standard Malay word dengar.

dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Dengar dahulu, saya hendak bercakap sebentar.

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary history of siasat preserves a wider world than modern crime reporting: the noun can also concern politics, strategy, and careful examination. Disiasat selects its investigative use through ordinary Malay passive morphology. This helps explain its institutional tone today: attention falls on the matter or person being examined, while the investigator may remain unnamed.

etymology.historical_story: The base rekod belongs to the vocabulary of documentation and measured achievement. Malay morphology turns it into merekodkan for the recording action and direkodkan when attention falls on what is recorded. In administrative writing, that shift lets a sentence begin with an application, payment, or measurement, while the person making the entry can remain unnamed.

etymology.historical_story: Kurang supplies the everyday idea of being less or insufficient. Malay builds mengurangkan for causing a reduction and dikurangkan for presenting the affected thing as the grammatical subject. The same family includes berkurang and pengurangan. Its usefulness in budgets, fees and workload discussions follows from this productive grammatical system rather than a separate borrowing.

etymology.historical_story: Biaya belongs to the Indic layer of Malay vocabulary and is traced to Sanskrit vyaya, associated with expenditure. Malay subsequently combines this established base with its own affixes: membiayai names providing funds, while dibiayai presents the recipient or activity as funded. The word therefore joins an older financial term to productive Malay grammar. [Source](https://pure.knaw.nl/portal/files/1708896328/Legal_diglossia_lexical_borrowing_and_mixed_juridical_systems_in_early_Islamic_Java_and_Sumatra_24_11_19_14_19_08.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: In library contexts, Dewey commemorates Melvil Dewey, whose classification was published in 1876. The personal name became part of an international system for arranging knowledge by numbered subjects. Malay library terminology retains the name in its designation of that system. John Dewey, the philosopher and educator, was a different person; the shared surname does not connect their contributions. [Original publication](https://www.gutenberg.org/files/12513/12513-h/12513-h.htm)
